tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ga)༄༅/ /rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs so/ /dpal rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa yong
(ga)༄༅/ /rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs so/ /dpal rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa yong

tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs so// dpal rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// lha min bdud sde'i dpung las rnam rgyal ba// srid zhi'i dgrar gyur rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la// gus pas btud de gar gyi brjed byang bri// de la 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs ji skad bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bri ba'i slad du sa sbyong ba'i cho ga gsum rdzogs pa'i mthar/ sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga bya ba la don nyi shus bsdus te/ bdag bskyed lha la snyan gsan dbab// gsol gdab dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg /phyag 'tshal sems bskyed khro bo bsgom// mig gnyis byin brlab lta bas blta// nga rgyal bskyed cing 'gros bzhi bskor// bgegs la bka' bsgo kha sbyor bzhi// rkang stabs bcu gsum kun bskyod dgu// rdo rje 'greng ba la sogs drug /ral gri la sogs tshul bcu gsum// gdan bcu mchod bzlas nyi shu'o// zhes pa ltar/ dang po bdag bskyed bya ba ni/ 'dri bar gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pa dang*/ phyogs bzhir slob ma rnams slob dpon la phyogs par 'dug nas/ dkyil 'khor gang yin pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs par bsgoms la bzlas pa ci nus bya'o// gnyis pa nam mkha'i lha la snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ thams cad kyis dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon dang*/ steng dang*/ 'og dang*/ dbus su pad skor bya ste/ lag pa gnyis kha sbubs nas mdun du brkyangs pa rim gyis nang du bkug pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa rdor sems kyi phyag rgyas bgying ba dang bcas te badzra satwa

rdo rje sems dpa' pa'o// a haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung*/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis phyag rgya bkrol te/ nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsams la/ mchod yon nam chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i spos phor 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas dril bu tshig rkang gsum re'i mthar gsil zhing*/ ma lus phyogs na sogs lan gsum brjod la/ slob dpon sngar bzhin phyag rgya bca'o// gsum pa slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag rgya bkrol te mchod la/ shar phyogs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// sogs lan gsum dang*/ de rdzogs pa na phyogs gzhan gsum nas kyang rim pa bzhin gsol ba btab la/ gsol gdab dang por zin nas rim gyis sngar bzhin phyag rgya bca'o// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs pa ni/ thams cad kyis phyag rgya bkrol te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs la rtse mo sbyar ba mdun gyi sa gzhi nas rim gyis gyen du 'degs la/ spyi bor phyag rgya kha phub la bzung ste/ hūm̐ rdo rje bzhengs shig badzra ttiṣṭha/ zhes pas bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg nas phyag rgya bkrol te/ pad skor dang po la/ rkang pa g.yas pa dang*/ gnyis pa la g.yon gyi skyil krung bshig gsum pa la dal bus langs te mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyis lus g.yo bzhin pas pad skor gnyis bya'o// lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ g.yon sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' bya ste/ de'i tshul ni rkang pa gnyis mnyam par gnas pa de nyid las rkang g.yon g.yas pa'i mdun du sor mo g.yon logs su phyogs pas bzhag cing*/ g.yas cung zad rgyab tu bkyed la/ de'i g.yas su g.yon snga ma ltar bkyed pa'o// 'og nas g.yon gzhi zhes pa rnams kyang 'di bzhin du shes par bya'o// dngos gzhi rkang pa mnyam par gnas la pad skor byas te/

rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bzhag la oṃ pra ṇa mā mi sarba ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu phyag 'tshal bar bgyi'o// thā ga tā na/ yang 'og nas 'byung ba ltar g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang gnyis ka bya ste/ dbus su 'ongs nas snying gar thal mo sbyar la sarba ta thā ga de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la te bhyaḥ zhes brjod nas/ bdag nyid 'bul ba'i phyir lag g.yon snying gar skyabs sbyin lta bu dang*/ g.yas gan rkyal gyis me tog 'grems pa'i tshul byed cing ātma naṃ nirya ta bdag nges par 'bul bar bgyi'o// yā mi/ zhes phyag byas la/ g.yas bsdu bya ste/ de'i tshul ni g.yon gzhi byas la/ rkang g.yon brang ba sa la btsugs nas g.yas pa'i mthe bo g.yon pa'i byin pa la brten cing*/ dku g.yon du cung zad 'bur ba la mig blta bzhin pas/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar thabs/ g.yon dril bu kha nang du bstan nas snying gar 'dzin pa he ru ka'i 'dug stangs lta bu'o// 'og nas g.yas bsdu ba rnams 'di bzhin no// de bzhin du sngar gyi g.yon gzhi las bzlog pa g.yas gzhi dang*/ sngar gyi g.yas bsdu las bzlog pa g.yon bsdu dang*/ g.yon gzhi las g.yas 'gying pa dang bcas pas brkyang ba ni g.yas brkyangs dang*/ g.yas gzhi las g.yon de bzhin du brkyang ba ni g.yon brkyangs pa yin la/ phyag rgya thams cad kyi 'ching 'grol la yang*/ bcings pa ni rang rang gi skabs su 'chad pa ltar yin zhing*/ 'grol ba ni lag pa steng nas 'og tu gnas pa na steng ma steng nas zlum por bskor ba dang*/ 'og mas 'og nas zlum por bskor ba dag dbus su phrad pa na pad skor la gnas pa ste/ gang gis tshe mnyam par gnas pa de'i tshe g.yas 'og dang g.yon steng nas bskor ba dag phrad pa na pad skor la gnas pa'o// drug pa sems bskyed pa ni g.yas brkyang la 'ching 'grol gyi tshul gyis/ lag pa g.yas 'og nas 'ongs te g.yon pa'i steng nas 'debs tshul bya zhing ya

ji snyed pa'i wāntā sarba sems can rnams satwāḥ dbus su g.yas skor dang phyag rgya bdag nyid 'bul ba ltar bya zhing*/ satwa sems can yang dag par 'dzin cing saṃ gra hi ṇaḥ yang dag par bzung ba rnams ni saṃ gra hi ta/ g.yon brkyang la lag gnyis kha phub tu brkyangs pa nang du bsdus te/ gan rkyal la sor mo'i rtse mo rnams bsdus pa sgong skyes kyi tshul du bya zhing*/ sgo nga las skyes pa dang aṇḍa dza wa/ dbus su 'ongs te mnyam pa la lag gnyis gan rkyal du brkyangs pa nang du bsdus te/ kha phub la gsang gnas kyi thad nas sor mo rnams phyir la 'gyed pa mngal skyes kyi tshul du bya zhing*/ mngal las skyes pa dang dza rā yu dza wa/ g.yas brkyang la lag gnyis gru mo gdengs nas sor mo rnams nang du blta ba brla'i thad kar gshog pa rdeb pa lta bu drod gsher las skyes pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ swe da dza drod gsher las skyes pa dang ba/ dbus su mnyam pa la g.yon pa'i lag mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag ste/ sor mo rnams gyen du padma'i rnam par byas pa rdzus skyes kyi tshul bya zhing*/ au pā pā du ka wa/ brdzus te skyes pa'am/ g.yon brkyang la g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub snying gar bcas te g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub mgo bor btsugs pa la gdong phyogs pa dang*/ de las bzlog ste g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub snying gar bya zhing*/ g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub mgo bo'i thad du phyir bkyed de mgo bo g.yas su bsgyur ba gzugs can dang gzugs med kyi tshul du bya zhing*/ rū pā na gzugs dang wa/ a rū pā na gzugs med pa'am wa/ dbus su mnyam pa la g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bcas te/ g.yas mthe bo gung mo srin mdzub bsdams pa kha'i thad nas gyen du phyogs pas tshigs 'dren pa'i tshul dang*/ lag gnyis rked pa'i thad kar kha phub du bsnol nas/ gan rkyal du so sor gyes pa 'du shes yod med kyi tshul du bya zhing*/

saṃ dzña no 'du shes can dang wa/ a saṃ dzña no wa/ 'du shes med pa'am/ g.yas brkyang g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bcas te g.yas sdigs mdzub snying gar bzlog pa spyi bor btsugs pa dang*/ slar yang de nyid gan rkyal du lte ba'i thad ka nas sor mo rnams phyir la 'gyed pa'i rnam pa 'du shes yod min med min gyi tshul du bya zhing*/ nai ba saṃ dzña na 'du shes yod min dang wa/ na saṃ dzña na 'du shes med min nam wa/ dbus su g.yon pa snying gar skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yas pa kha phub ste cung zad brkyangs nas lus g.yas su bskor te mthar g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas khu tshur mthe bo gyen du bslang ba dngos grub kyi phyag rgya bca' zhing*/ sarba satwa ma yi/ sems can thams cad bdag gis/ ma hā mu dra pa daiḥ phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la rab tu dgod par bya'o/ pra tiṣṭha pa yi ta byaṃ/ zhes brjod de g.yas su bsdu'o// de tsam mi spro na/ sems can bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa rnams kyi bdud bsal bar bya'o snyam du bsam pa tsam gyis kyang chog par mngon no// bdun pa khro bo bsgom pa ni/ g.yas brkyang la lag gnyis khu tshur du byas la/ rgyab sprad la mthe'u chung gnyis mdud/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bca' zhing*/ zhes pas/ rang skad cig gis khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser/ g.yon ljang ba'i zhal gsum gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ zhal re re zhing smin ma 'khyog cing khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang gi phyag rgyas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas lhag ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/

phyag rgya drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis spras pa/ mgo bo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs za ba lta bu'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes bsgom zhing gsal gdab bo// brgyad pa mig byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'ching 'grol gyi ngang nas g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bzhag g.yas sdigs mdzub kha gyen du bstan pa mig g.yas la reg cing*/ oṃ aḥm kā re ṇa ma yig gis/ sūrya kṛta sa bya ni tra hūm̐/ nyi mar byas pa'i mig g.yas pa'o// zhes mig g.yas ma las nyi ma/ phyag rgya de las bzlog ste/ oṃ oṃ āḥṭa ṭa yig gis kā re ṇa/ tsand+ra kṛta bā ma zla bar byas pa'i mig g.yon pa'o// ne tre hūm̐/ zhes g.yon ṭa las zla ba dang hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mig gnyis kyi thad kar bstan la mig 'bras gnyis su hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i rdo rjer byin gyis brlab bo// dgu pa rdo rje'i lta bas blta ba ni/ 'ching 'grol dang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya la gnas pas/ hūm̐ kro dha dṛṣṭi khro bo'i lta stangs can/ hriḥ zhes brjod cing phyogs thams cad du bltas nas/ bgegs rnams nyi mas bsreg cing zla bas gsos par bsams la/ g.yas bsdu'o// bcu pa nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ de nas dbus su mchongs la/ g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bsgreng*/ g.yas lag mthil phyir bstan pa'i sor mo dpral bar reg cing*/ a haṃ me nga ni rang bzhin rdo rje can wa swa yaṃ badzrī/ zhes pa dang*/ g.yas brkyang la g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bzung la/ badzra satwa ma haṃ swa rdo rje sems dpa' la rang nyid dang yaṃ/ dbus su mnyam pa la thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ a haṃ buddho ma nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che

hā rā dzā/ g.yon brkyang la lag gnyis steng 'og du bsnol nas gru mo dpung pa'i mtshams nas bzung ste/ g.yo ba dang bcas pas/ a haṃ badzrī ma nga ni stobs chen rdo rje can hā ba la/ dbus su g.yas rol la/ lag gnyis snying gar gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa ltar steng 'og du byas te/ a haṃ nga ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal yo gī shwa ra rā dza/ g.yas brkyang dang lag g.yas cig car brkyang zhing*/ g.yon snying gar sdigs mdzub byas la/ badzra pā ṇi ra haṃ dṛ ḍhaṃ/ phyag na rdo rje brtan pa nga*/ dbus su mnyam pa la g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bcas la/ a haṃ me nga ni bdag po rdo rje che wa ma hā badzra/ g.yon brkyang la lag pa gnyis thugs kar bsnol la/ a dhiṣṭhā byin gyis brlab par mi 'dor ro// na a dhiṣṭhi te'o// zhes brjod cing g.yon bsdu'o// bcu gcig pa 'gros bzhis bskor ba ni/ dang por rtse gcig pa la thog mar rkang pa byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ g.yon pa'i bol gong du g.yas pa'i g.yas zur bzhag pa bsdu ba ltar gyen du bteg la lag pa gnyis sdigs mdzub bsgreng la g.yon pa'i mdzub mo rkang pa g.yon pa dang*/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma la reg cing rked pa smad de lus rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam par byas la/ e ka pā li ka rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje'i rkang stabs badzra pā daḥ g.yon pa rgyab tu bzhag nas gyen du 'degs pa la sogs pa snga ma las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis bya ste/ rkang pa dag rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos par bya'o// de nas rkang pa g.yas pa'i phyi zur g.yon pa'i rting par bzhag ste/ e ka pā li rtse mo gcig pa ka bol gong du bzhag ste/ badzra pā rdo rje'i rkang stabs can daḥ rdo rje dril bu la lan gsum bskor ba'i mthar rdo rje 'og tu bzung ba'i steng du dril bu yun ring du dkrol te/

badzra rdo rje khro bo chen po ma hā kro dha/ lag gnyis phyir la bkyed la rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar lus kun nas g.yo ba dang bcas pas rdo rje 'phyar thabs su gsor zhing*/ dril bu dkur 'dzin pa dang*/ rkang pa g.yas mtho lnga tsam gyi bar/ mdun du bteg pa dang*/ g.yon pa g.yas logs su 'khyog pa dang*/ mig phrag pa g.yas nas rgyab tu blta ba rnams dus mnyam du bya zhing*/ bhañdza bhañdza/ choms shig choms shig sarba duṣṭa a su thams cad du gdug pa can gyi lha ma yin rnams gzir ba rā na hūm̐ khos cig phaṭa/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yon gyi phyi zur g.yas pa'i rgyab dang bol gong du 'jog pa dang*/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkur 'dzin pa dang*/ rkang pa g.yon pa mdun du bteg pa dang*/ g.yas pa g.yon logs su 'khyog pa la sogs snga ma'i rigs pas shes shing*/ mig phrag pa g.yon nas rgyab tu blta ba'i tshul gyis res mos gyi 'gro ba'o// tshul 'dis slob dpon dbus nas dbang ldan gyi bar du 'ong zhing*/ de'i bar phyogs na gnas pa'i slob ma rnams mnyam pa dang*/ rdor sems kyi tshul gyis 'dug la/ slob dpon dbang ldan du sleb pa dang thams cad kyis rtse gcig pas g.yas skor du 'gro zhing slob dpon dbang ldan du slebs kyi bar du bskor ro// de nas rtse gsum pa ni/ byin gyis rlob pa na gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rkang pa g.yas pas mdun gyi rtse mo gsum dang*/ g.yon pas rgyab kyi rtse mo gsum bris nas bteg ste/ tri sū tsi rtse mo gsum pa'i rdo rje'i rkang stabs ka badzra pā daḥ zhes brjod do// rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos par bya'o// de nas lag g.yon dril bu steng du 'khrol ba'i 'og tu g.yas rdo rje gyen du bsgrengs ba bzung ste/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i phyi zur gyi rgyab tu gsum bri zhing*/ oṃ rtse mo gsum pa tri sū tsi ka mdun du gsum bri zhing*/

badzra pā daḥ rdo rje'i rkang stabs can/ rkang pa g.yas mtho lnga tsam gyis mdun du 'dor ba dang*/ lag pa g.yas 'og nas steng dang*/ g.yon steng nas 'og tu 'gro ba'i tshul gyis ri bo 'degs pa ltar lus kun nas g.yo ba dang bcas shing*/ badzra ma hā kro dha/ rdo rje khro bo chen po/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar stabs dang*/ g.yon dril bu snying gar 'dzin cing*/ lus ljid pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du bskur la/ sgyid pa g.yon drang por bsrangs te/ pus mgo g.yon du mig zur blta ba'i sgo nas/ bhañdza bhañdza choms shig choms shig sarba duṣṭa a su rā lha ma yin nam na hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yon pas rgyab gsum dang*/ mdun gsum bris nas/ lag stabs sngar las bzlog ste g.yon steng nas dril bu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yas rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing rkang stabs kyang sngar las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis mig zur g.yas su blta zhing 'gro ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin gyi rigs pas shes par bya'o// rtse lnga pa ni/ byin gyis rlob pa na gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rkang pa g.yas kyis gzhogs g.yon du rtse mo lnga dang*/ g.yon gyis g.yas su rtse mo lnga bris nas bteg ste/ pañdza sū tsi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rkang stabs ka badzra pā daḥ zhes pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos par bya'o// de nas/ mig gnyis lag gnyis de bzhin dku// zhes sogs ltar lus cung zad smad nas mig gnyis dku g.yon pa'i phyogs su blta zhing lag gnyis pad skor yang der byed bzhin pas/ rkang g.yas gzhogs g.yon du rtse mo lnga bri zhing*/ oṃ pañdza sū tsi

rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rkang stabs ka badzra pā daḥ slar yang dku g.yas par blta zhing pad skor byed bzhin pas rkang pa g.yon kyis gzhogs g.yas su rtse mo lnga bris te/ oṃ pañdza sū tsi ka zhes sogs lag gnyis kha phub dang*/ rkang g.yas g.yon phyogs su brdeg cing*/ badzra ma hā kro dha/ zhes rol pa'i spyod pas sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pas g.yas skor du 'gro zhing*/ bhañdza bhañdza/ sogs de bzhin du dku g.yas par blta zhing pad skor byed bzhin pas rkang g.yon gzhogs g.yas su rtse mo lnga bri ba dang*/ dku g.yon par blta zhing pad skor dang rkang g.yas kyi g.yon du rtse lnga bris la g.yon skor du 'gro ba sogs sngar gyi rim pas shes par bya'o// sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ byin gyis rlob pa na rkang g.yas kyis mdun gsum dang*/ g.yas gsum dang*/ g.yon gyis rgyab gsum dang g.yon gsum bris nas bteg te/ bi shā sū tsi ka sna tshogs pa'i rtse mo rdo rje'i rkang stabs can badzra pā daḥ zhes pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos par bya'o// de nas rkang g.yon gyis rgyab gsum dang g.yon gsum bri zhing*/ oṃ bi shwa sū tsi ka sna tshogs pa'i rtse mo rdo rje'i rkang stabs can badzra pā daḥ g.yas kyi mdun gsum dang g.yas gsum bri zhing*/ oṃ bi shwa sogs g.yas bsdu bya zhing*/ badzra ma hā kro dha khro bo'i spyod pas mdun du rngam pa dang bcas pas mchongs te g.yon rol bya zhing*/ bhañdza bhañdza/ sogs de bzhin g.yon mdun du bzhag nas g.yas pas rgyab dang g.yas su bri ba dang*/ g.yon pas mdun dang g.yon du bris nas g.yon rol bya zhing*/ mdun du mchongs te g.yas rol byed pa la sogs sngar gyi rigs pas shes par bya'o// 'dir rdo rje bri ba la ni/ rdo rje'i rkang stabs zhes bya la/ 'gro ba ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang*/ ri bo 'degs pa dang*/ rol pa'i bskyod pa dang*/ khro bo'i bskyod pa ste/ gom pa bzhis 'gro ba yin pas tshul tha dad du shes par bya'o// bcu gnyis pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/

gzhan rnams so so'i phyogs su gnas pa la/ slob dpon sna tshogs rdo rje'i rkang pas dbus su song la dbang ldan du kha phyogs pas g.yon gzhi dang g.yas brkyang la hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya snying gar bca' zhing*/ a haṃ ma nga ni khro bo chen po'o/ hā kro dha/ zhes pas hūm̐ mdzad du gsal bar bsgoms la/ gang su dag lha dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ grib gnon dang*/ rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang*/ 'khor dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig sngags grub pa khyed rnams dengs shig sa phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas sems can thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ slob ma che ge mo zhes bya bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par rdzogs par bya ba'i don du/ dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri bar bya'o// de'i phyir rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'di thos nas myur du dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de'i mgo bo dag hūm̐ mdzad kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'dis rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes pa'am/ yang na/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bka' yi 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni// lus sogs las byung dwags bya ste// gal te kha cig bdag la 'da'// 'dir ni 'jigs 'gyur gzhan du min// zhes pa ste 'di gnyis gang rung lan gsum re byed par bshad pa la/ bla ma dag dang por lhug pa'i bka' bsgo dang*/ bar du dbyangs dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ tha mar sngar gyi lhug pa myur du brjod par mdzad de/ de ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// gang ltar kyang tsham rngams kyi sbyor bas rol mo drag tu bya/

gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ drag sngags bzlas pas bskrad la bsdu'o// bcu gsum pa kha sbyor bzhi bya ba ni/ slob dpon byang du phyogs te sna tshogs rdo rje'i rkang pas byang sgo'i slob dpon gyi mdun gyi bar phyin la/ slob dpon g.yas brkyang dang*/ slob ma de las bzlog pa'i stabs kyis 'ching 'grol dang*/ rdo rje dril bu bsnol mar bzung ste/ slob dpon gyis dril bu slob ma'i rdo rje dang*/ slob ma'i dril bur slob dpon gyi rdo rje bcug la/ oṃ sampu ṭa yang dag par sbyor ba'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi bhi na yaḥ maṇḍa la bhū mi a dhi tiṣṭhi te hūm̐ byin gyis rlobs shig phaṭa/ ces brjod de g.yas bsdu'o// de bzhin du shar la sogs pa'i phyogs gzhan gsum du'ang bya zhing*/ slob dpon slob ma rnams kyis nang rol nas rdo rje rkang pas 'gro/ slob ma rnams ni so so'i gnas su lha'i lta stangs kyis gnas par bya'o// bcu bzhi pa rkang stabs bcu gsum bya ba la/ nges can lnga dang*/ nges med brgyad de gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i bskor ba dang spel la/ shar du g.yas brkyang la pad skor sngon du 'gro bas bca' gzhi rdzogs pa na/ lag g.yas dku g.yas 'bur ba'i phyogs su mchog sbyin gyi rnam pa dang*/ lag g.yon de'i steng du skyabs sbyin lta bur byas nas/ a haṃ ma hā kro dha zhes sib dang po dang*/ rkang g.yon byin pa bskums nas g.yas mtho lnga'i bar du brkyangs te/ lag stabs kyang rkang stabs dang mthun par byas la/ ā lī ḍha pā da/ g.yas brkyang gi rkang stabs/ zhes sim gnyis pa btab nas/ dngos gzhi 'ching 'grol 'gying ba dang bcas pas rdo rje gyen du gsor/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas dril bu snying gar dkrol zhing*/ oṃ g.yas brkyang gi rkang stabs can ā lī ḍha pā da/ badzra ma khro bo chen pos ma hā kro dha/

rnam par myos shig bi ghurṇa ya/ bi ghurṇa ya/ rnam par rmugs su chug cig sarba duṣṭa de ba ā di mā rā lha la sogs pa'i bdud gdug pa can thams cad na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes drag tu brjod de bsdu'o// lhor g.yon brkyang la/ bca' gzhi rdzogs nas dku g.yon 'bur ba'i phyogs su mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin gyi sib dang po dang*/ rkang g.yas byin pa bskum/ g.yon mtho lnga'i bar du brkyangs te/ lag stabs kyang rkang stabs dang mthun par byas la/ pra dyā lī ḍha pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab nas dngos gzhi'i phyag rgya snga ma bzhin bya ste/ oṃ pra dyā g.yon brkyang gi rkang stabs can lī ḍha pā da/ badzra ma khro bo chen po hā kro dha/ bi ghurṇa ya sogs 'dra/ ya ma ā di mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje la sogs pa'i bdud rnams/ ces drag tu brjod de bsdu'o// phyi ma rnams la'ang sib dang po ni snga ma ltar re mos su bya zhing*/ nub du sa ga pa sib dang po dang*/ rkang gnyis sor nyi shu rtsa drug gi rgyar sor mo logs gnyis su bstan cing*/ pus mo gnyis drang por bsrangs te/ lag stabs rkang stabs dang mthun pa la/ bai sha kha pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab nas phyag rgya 'ching 'grol dang bcas pas/ rdo rje dril bu snga ma bzhin steng du byas te/ oṃ bai sha kha pā da/ sa ga'i rkang stabs can/ sogs dang*/ nā ga ā di mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ klu la sogs pa'i bdud rnams/ zhes drag tu brjod de bsdu'o// byang du zlum po la/ sib dang po btab nas/ rkang gnyis sa ga dang 'dra ba las pus mo gnyis ngang pa'i gshog pa ltar khru do'i bar du gdengs nas/ lag stabs gru mo gdengs shing mdzub mo dag brla'i steng du btsugs pa rkang stabs dang mthun pa la/ maṇḍal pā da/ zhes pa'i sib gnyis pa btab nas/ g.yon dril bu steng du 'dzin cing g.yas 'og nas g.yas skor byas pa'i mthar rdo rje dril bu steng 'og nas sngar bzhin bya ste/

oṃ maṇḍal zlum po'i rkang stabs can pā da/ zhes sogs dang*/ yakṣa ā gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i bdud rnams di mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes drag tu brjod de bsdu'o// dbus su mnyam pa la/ sib dang po dang*/ rkang gnyis sor mo mdun du bstan pas gzhibs te lus drang por bsrang zhing lag stabs rkang stabs dang mthun pa la/ sa ma pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab la/ phyag rgya sa ga dang mthun pa la/ oṃ sa ma mnyam pa'i rkang stabs can pā da/ zhes sogs dang*/ sarba duṣṭa trai dhā tu kaṃ sthā sarba ā di khams gsum rab tu gnas pa'i gdug pa can mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud la sogs pa thams cad/ ces drag tu brjod de bsdu'o// gnyis pa nges med brgyad ni/ gnas gang du byas kyang chog mod 'on kyang phyogs mtshams brgyad du mdzad pas/ de ltar na rdo rje rtse gsum pas bskor ba dang spel nas/ byang shar du skyes pa'i rkang stabs ni/ pad skor rdzogs pa dang*/ gar gyi gzhi g.yas brkyang ltar bcas la/ lag gnyis rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul bya zhing*/ a haṃ badzra satwa/ nga ni rdo rje sems dpa'o// zhes brjod de bkrol la/ rkang g.yon drang por gnas pa la/ g.yas sor mo g.yas logs su bstan cing pus mo cung zad bskums nas rting pa gnyis kyi bar du sor bzhi yod par byas te/ dku g.yon sgeg pa dang bcas pas/ lag stabs rkang stabs dang mthun par bya zhing*/ dzā ta skyes pa'i rkang stabs pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab ste bkrol la/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mtheb srin gyis shing lo dku g.yon pa'i thad du 'dzin pa yangs pa can gyi sgrol ma'i phyag rgya ltar bya zhing*/ mgo g.yon du phyogs pas dku g.yon du mig zur blta zhing*/ oṃ skyes pa'i rkang stabs can gyis dzā ta pā da/ badzra ma rdo rje khro bo chen po hā kro dha/ maṇḍal bhū mi/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi/ a dhiṣṭhi te hūm̐

byin rlobs shig phaṭa/ ces brjod de bsdu'o// shar lhor skyes zla'i rkang stabs ni/ pad skor dang*/ g.yas gzhi dang*/ sib dang po btab la/ rkang g.yas drang por 'dug g.yon sor mo g.yon logs su bstan cing pus mo cung zad bskum/ rting pa'i bar du sor bzhi yod par byas te/ dku g.yas sgeg pa sogs dang*/ pra ti dzā ta skyes pa'i zla bo'i rkang stabs pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab la/ dku g.yas su mig blta zhing*/ skyes pa'i zla bo'i rkang stabs can oṃ pra ti dzā ti pā da/ badzra ma hā kro dha/ sogs brjod de bsdu'o// lho nub tu rnam par gtsigs pa ni/ g.yon gzhi dang*/ sib dang po btab la/ rkang g.yas mdun du mtho gsum gyi bar du bzhag pa'i pus mo bskum/ sgyid pa g.yon drang por bsrangs te/ lag stabs de dang mthun par bya zhing*/ bi ka ṭa pā da/ rnam par gtsigs pa'i rkang stabs/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab te bkrol nas/ lag gnyis gru mo brkyangs nas sdigs mdzub gyen du bsgreng ba g.yas g.yon re mos su brkyang bskum byed cing brkyangs pa'i bsdigs mdzub la mig bltas la/ oṃ bi ka ṭa pā da/ sogs brjod de bsdu'o// nub byang du rnam par gtsigs pa'i zla ni/ de las bzlog pa la/ pra ti bi ga ḍa pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab nas/ dngos gzhi la/ oṃ pra ti bi ka ṭa rnam par gtsigs pa zla bo'i rkang stabs pā da/ zhes brjod de bsdu'o// de nas rtse gcig pa'i rkang stabs spel te/ shar du kha sbyor ni g.yon gzhi dang*/ sib dang po btab la/ 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i rkang mthil sbyar te/ lag gnyis kyang sgeg cing rol pas mthil sbyar zhing*/ yang dag par sbyar ba'i rkang stabs sambu ṭa pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab te bkrol la/ 'gying ba dang bcas pas slar rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya dang rdo rje bsdams pa sbyar ba las/ mthe bo gnyis nang du bcug la/ oṃ sambu ṭa pā da/

zhes sogs brjod de bsdu'o// lho rus sbal ni/ g.yas gzhi dang sib dang po btab la bkrol te rkang g.yas kyis g.yon pa'i bol gong mnan cing*/ lag pa'ang g.yon pa'i rgyab tu g.yas pa dgab la/ kurma rus sbal gyi rkang stabs pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab nas bkrol te/ 'gying ba dang bcas pas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel zhing mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs te rtse sbyar la gan rkyal du kha'i thad kar bzung nas ltag pa bcum zhing kos ko dang lag pa mdun du 'dud pa la/ oṃ kurma pā da/ sogs brjod de g.yon bsdu'o// nub tu rkang gcig ni/ g.yon gzhi dang*/ sib dang po btab nas/ lag g.yas mgo la bskor zhing*/ g.yon thur du btsugs pa ltar drang por bsrangs te/ e ka pā da/ rkang pa gcig pa/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab nas/ rkang g.yon btsugs la g.yas bteg cing g.yon nas bskor ba gcig gam gsum bya zhing*/ oṃ e ka pā da/ zhes sogs brjod de g.yas su bsdu'o// byang du bung ba'i drwa ba ni/ g.yas gzhi dang*/ sib dang po btab la/ rkang g.yas drang por bya zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas rim gyis pus gong du bteg la/ de dang mthun pa'i lag stabs kyis/ bhra ma ra bung ba 'dri ba'i rkang stabs dzwā la pā da/ zhes sib gnyis pa btab cing bkrol la/ sgeg cing rol pa'i nyams dang ldan pas gru mo gnyis brkyangs nas mdzub mo gnyis gyen du bsgreng ba kun nas g.yo ba dang rkang gnyis res 'jog tu bya zhing*/ oṃ bhra ma ra dzā la pā da/ zhes sogs/ brjod de g.yon bsdu'o// de tsam mi nus na/ sib rnams dor nas gzhi bca' sngon du 'gro bas rang rang gi rkang stabs rnams byas la/ mthar bsdu ba re byas pas chog par mngon no// bco lnga pa kun bskyod dgu bya ba ni/ de nas slob ma rnams rang rang gi phyogs su gnas shing*/ slob dpon dbang ldan nas rtse gcig pa'i rkang pas dbus su song la thams cad kyis kun bskyod bya ste/

de la dbus su bsnun pa'i kun bskyod ni/ dang po shar du bltas la/ g.yon gzhi dang*/ pad skor bya zhing*/ g.yas brkyang dus kha lhor bltas la/ lag gnyis spyi bor gar bskor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bkrol te g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bsgreng*/ g.yas rdo rje gyen du 'phyar zhing*/ oṃ buddha ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs kyis/ g.yon du sa la 'gyel tshul byas la/ g.yas rdo rje steng 'og tu bsnun zhing*/ badzra ma hā kro dha/ rdo rje khro bo chen po'i/ ākṣe pa ya snun cig ākṣe pa ya/ sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud thams cad/ ces drag tu brjod de g.yas bsdu'o// 'dar bar byed pa'i kun bskyod ni/ shar du bltas la/ g.yon gzhi dang pad skor rdzogs pa nas/ mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyis spyi bor/ gar bskor dang oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bkrol te g.yas rdo rje snying gar bslang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bzung ste/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dku g.yon gyi thad nas phyir bsdigs shing*/ g.yas dbyug pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje bzung ba phrag par bsgreng la/ a he bzhad cing bzhad pa'i

a he/ bkrol te dril bu gsil zhing rkang g.yas g.yon pa'i rgyab dang mdun du rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rwa re bri zhing*/ lag gnyis dril gsil dang*/ gra sa za zhing gra sa za ba'i / rkang pa g.yas g.yon pa'i steng du cung zad bskor te lte bar bri zhing*/ gtsigs pa'i ka rā la/ g.yas sngar shul du bzhag la pus mo cung zad bskum/ g.yon mtho phyed dang gsum du brkyangs la lag pa g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa 'phyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub sngar bzhin la/ pā zhal can gyi da na/ rkang g.yon de nyid las g.yas bskums te rol pa bya/ lag g.yas steng du 'phyar/ g.yon sngar ltar sdigs shing*/ ma khro bo chen po hā kro dha tsa g.yos shig la ya g.yos shig tsa la ya/ sarba mā bdud thams cad rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing*/ mig g.yon btsum/ gdong bskor zhing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la blta ba dang khro gnyer bya ste/ g.yas bsdu'o// skrag par byed pa'i kun bskyod ni/ lhor bltas la/ g.yas gzhi dang mnyam pas rdo rje bslang ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rkang g.yon mtho phyed dang gsum du brkyang*/ lag gnyis bkrol te sngar bzhin bca' zhing*/ laṃ a he a he/ rkang g.yon der bzhag g.yas rang gi mdun dang*/ g.yon g.yas kyi mdun nas mtho phyed dang dos 'phags par bzhag la bsnol/ g.yas mtho phyed dang dos 'phags pa'i rgyab kyi dbus su bzhag pa gru gsum pa'i rnam par bya zhing dril bu dkrol la/ gra sa gra sa/ ka rā la/ rkang g.yas de nyid las g.yon mtho phyed gsum du brkyang*/ lag g.yas gru gsum gyi nang du gdab cing*/ bā da na/ g.yas 'gying ba dang bcas pas rdo rje 'phyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub nu ma'i thad nas phyir sdigs shing*/ ma hā kro dha/ trā sa skrags par gyis shig ya/ trā sa skrags par gyis shig ya/ sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de g.yon bsdu'o// yang dag par dkrug pa'i kun bskyod ni nub tu bltas la/

g.yon gzhi dang mnyam pas rdo rje bslang ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bkrol te g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar stabs/ g.yon sdigs mdzub byas pa la/ mig g.yon blta zhing g.yas btsums la/ laṃ a he a he/ rkang g.yas de nyid las/ g.yon pas g.yas pa'i rgyab mdun du rdo rje rtse gcig pa bri zhing*/ gra sa gra sa/ rkang g.yon sngar bzhin mnyam pa la g.yas bskums la bteg lag gnyis dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub sngar ltar byas la/ lus g.yon du bskor zhing*/ ka rā la bā da na/ rkang pa g.yas sa la bzhag pa'i pus mo bskum zhing*/ g.yon mtho phyed dang gsum du brkyangs la/ bkrol te dbyug sdigs bya zhing*/ ma hā kro dha/ kṣo bha ya/ bskyod par gyis shig kṣo bha ya/ bskyod par gyis shig sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de g.yas su bsdu'o// rnam par rmongs byed kyi kun bskyod ni/ byang du bltas la/ g.yas gzhi las mnyam pa dang*/ rdo rje bslang ba bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bkrol te g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub la mig g.yon blta zhing laṃ rkang g.yas de nyid las/ g.yon bskums te bteg la lus g.yas su bskor zhing*/ a he a he/ g.yon phab ste mnyam pa las lag gnyis dril gsil rkang g.yon mdun dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi mdun nas g.yon du mtho phyed dang dos 'phag par bzhag ste bsnol/ g.yon mtho phyed dang dos 'phag pa'i rgyab kyi dbus su bzhag pa gru gsum du bya zhing*/ gra sa gra sa/ ka rā la/ de las g.yas brkyang dang*/ pā da na/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub byas la/ ma hā kro dha/ ba rnam par rmongs shig ma ha rnam par rmongs shig ya bi mo ha ya/ sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de g.yon du bsdu'o// khyad par du myur ba'i kun bskyod ni/ byang shar du bltas la g.yas gzhi nas gru gsum bri ba'i bar rnam par rmongs byed kyi kun bskyod dang 'dra bar byas la/ bskor ba'i tshe rkang g.yon de nyid las/

g.yas bskums te bteg la lus g.yon du bskor ba dang*/ g.yas mdun du bzhag la gru gsum bris pa'i mthar g.yon brkyang dang*/ pā da na/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar sogs 'dra bar byas la/ ma hā kro dha/ gardzadza sgrogs shig ya/ gardzadza sgrogs shig ya/ sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de g.yon du bsdu'o// kha gdangs pa'i kun bskyod ni/ shar lhor bltas la/ sngar gyis rmongs par byed pa'i kun bskyod las/ kha gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba dang*/ gdong bskor ba rnams byas la/ ma hā kro dha/ zo shig khā hi zo shig khā hi/ sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de g.yon du bsdu'o// kī li kī li'i kun bskyod ni/ lho nub tu bltas la/ g.yon gzhi dang mnyam pa las rdo rje bslang ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bkrol te lag g.yon sdigs mdzub/ g.yas dbyug 'phyar/ rkang g.yas mtho gang tsam gyis bar du g.yas su brkyangs la/ laṃ a he a he/ dril bu gsil zhing dang por mdun du bzhag pas gru gsum bris te/ gra sa gra sa/ ka rā la/ rkang g.yas su mtho gang tsam du bzhag la pus mo bskum zhing*/ pā da na/ pus mo g.yon sa la btsugs pa lus g.yon phyogs su smad de/ lag g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub byas la/ ma hā kro dha/ ghā ta rdungs shig ya/ ghā ta ya/ rdungs shig sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dbyug pa brdeg tshul lan gsum bya/ de'i tshe mig dbyug pa'i rjes su bltas la/ g.yas su bsdu'o// kī li kī la chen po'i kun bskyod ni/ nub byang du bltas la/ sngar gyi kī li kī la ltar byas la/ dbyug pa brdeg pa'i tshe/ g.yas kyi dpung pa nas rgyab tu khyer zhing mdun du bsnun/ mig g.yon btsums/ g.yas dbyug pa la blta zhing rkang g.yas bskyod bzhin pas/ ma hā kro dha/ ā phobs shig bi sha ya/ ā bi sha ya/ phobs shig sarba mā rā na hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod de g.yas su bsdu'o// bcu drug pa rdo rje bsgreng ba la sogs pa drug bya ba ni/ gzhan rnams lha'i stangs stabs kyis gnas shing*/ slob dpon dbus nas dbang ldan du sna tshogs rdo rje'i rkang pas song ste/ der slebs pa dang kha nang du bltas la rdo rje bsgreng ba ni/ g.yas brkyangs la/ g.yas rdo rje 'gying ba dang bcas pas snying gar bsgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dkur bzhag la/ oṃ badzro dā karṣa ṇa bi rdo rje bsgreng ba'i tshul gyis na ya/ tsakra maṇḍa la rakṣa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsrungs dang rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la bsdu'o// shar lhor rdo rje 'phen pa ni/ g.yon brkyang dang*/ lag g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bca'/ g.yas rdo rje phrag gong nas 'phen cing*/ oṃ rdo rje bskyed pa'i badzra kṣe pa bi na tshul gyis ya tsakra/ sogs 'gre g.yon du bsdu'o// lho nub tu rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ g.yas brkyang dang*/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur steng 'og tu drag tu 'phangs shing kha gdangs la bsdigs nas/ oṃ badzra bhai rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ra wa bi na tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod de g.yas su bsdu'o// nub byang du rdo rje 'khyil pa ni/ g.yon brkyang dang*/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rkang g.yon cung zad gyen du bteg pa la bskor zhing*/ g.yon pas kyang rkang g.yas la de bzhin du bskor ba'i mthar lag gnyis dku g.yas g.yon du sgeg tshul byas la/ rkang gnyis smad de lus 'khyil pa ltar byas shing*/ oṃ rdo rje 'khyil ba'i tshul gyis badzra kuṇḍa li bi na ya/ sogs brjod de g.yon du bsdu'o// de nas dbang ldan bar sngar gyi 'gros kyis song la/ de nas rtse lnga pa'i rkang pas shar du phyin te/ rdo rje gar gyis steng phyogs bsrung bar bsams la/ g.yas rol dang lag gnyis mkhrig ma sbyar ba spyi bor bzung la gar bya zhing*/

oṃ badzra nṛ tya bi na rdo rje gar ma'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod de bsdu'o// nub tu bud med sgyu ma byed pa ni/ 'og bsrung bar bsams la/ g.yon rol dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan pa dku gnyis su bzhag cing mgo g.yon du dud par byas la/ oṃ st+rī mā bud med sgyu ma byed pa'i tshul gyis yā ka ra ṇa bi na ya/ sogs brjod de bsdus la dbang ldan gyi bar rtse lnga pa de nyid kyis 'grol bar bya'o// bcu bdun pa ral gri la sogs pa'i tshul bcu gsum ni/ dbang ldan nas shar du rtse gsum pa'i rkang pas phyin la/ der g.yas brkyangs la pad skor sngon du 'gro bas lag pa g.yon khu tshur dkur bzung ba'i sbubs nas g.yas kyi gung mdzub gnyis phyung ste phrag par 'phyar la/ oṃ badzra khaḍga bi na rdo rje ral gri'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pa ral gri'i tshul dang*/ de bkrol te g.yon snying gar sdigs mdzub/ g.yas mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan sor mo gsum brkyang ba 'phyar zhing*/ oṃ tri sū tsi ka rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul gyis badzra bi na ya/ sogs brjod pas rdo rje'i tshul dang*/ de krol te rdo rje bsdams pas bzung ba'i gtun shing gis mdun du bgegs brdung tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra mu rdo rje gtun shing gi tshul gyis sa la bi na ya/ sogs brjod pa rdo rje gtun shing gi tshul te/ gsum byas la bkrol te bsdu'o// lhor g.yon brkyangs la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur la kha gyen du bstan pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis sbrel ba g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ badzra tsakra bi na rdo rje 'khor lo'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pas 'khor lo'i tshul dang*/ bkrol te g.yon sdigs mdzub snying gar bzung ba'i steng nas/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mdzub gnyis brkyangs te 'gying ba dang bcas pas ba dan 'khyog por bri zhing*/

oṃ badzra pā taṃ ga bi na rdo rje ba dan gyi tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pas ba dan gyi tshul dang*/ bkrol te snying gar thal mo sbyar ba padma ltar phye zhing*/ oṃ badzra padmo bi na rdo rje padmo'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pas padma'i tshul te gsum byas la bkrol te bsdu'o// nub tu sa ga'i rkang stabs la/ lag g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzung*/ g.yas khu tshur mdzub mo bsgreng ba phrag gong du 'phyar zhing*/ oṃ badzra daṇḍa bi na rdo rje dbyug pa'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pas dbyug pa'i tshul dang*/ bkrol te g.yon de nyid las g.yas mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar bkug pa phrag gong du 'phyar zhing*/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha bi na rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pas lcags kyu'i tshul dang*/ bkrol te g.yon khu tshur dkur bzung*/ g.yas sor mo rnams kha phub te brkyang ba slar gyen du sor mo rnams bsdus pa/ gdengs ka'am/ 'bras bu 'dzin pa ltar bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra pha la bi na rdo rje 'bru'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pas gdengs ka'i tshul te gsum byas pas bkrol te bsdu'o// byang du zlum po'i rkang stabs la/ lag g.yon dku g.yas nas bskor te g.yon nas gzhu blangs la/ g.yas pas rgyud 'dren pa ltar bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra tsā rdo rje gzhu'i tshul gyis ba bi na ya/ sogs brjod pas gzhu'i tshul dang*/ lag g.yas dku g.yon nas bskor te g.yas nas mda' blangs la snying gar gsor zhing*/ oṃ badzra sha rodā karṣa ṇa bi na rdo rje mda' gsor ba'i tshul gyis ya/ sogs brjod pa mda'i tshul dang*/ bkrol te lag gnyis mda' 'phen pa ltar byas la/ oṃ badzra sha ra prakṣe pa ya rdo rje mda' rab tu 'phen pa'i tshul gyis/ na ya/ sogs brjod pa mda' 'phen pa'i tshul te gsum byas la bsdu'o// de nas dbang ldan du mnyam pa'i stabs kyis thal mo snying gar sbyar la 'dud ba'i tshul bya zhing*/

oṃ badzra pra ṇa rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul gyis mā mi bi na ya/ tsakra maṇḍa la rakṣa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo srungs shig srungs shing rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul te bkrol la bsdu'o// de ltar tshul bcu gsum tshar ba dang slob ma rnams so so'i rang gnas su 'dug la/ slob dpon sngar gyi rtse gsum pa'i 'gros kyis rkang pas song la dbus su 'dug go /bco brgyad pa gdan bcu bya ba ni/ de nas thams cad kyis rdo rje'i skyil krung byas la pad skor sngon du 'gro bas g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag byas la/ oṃ badzra ā rdo rje gdan gyi sa na/ maṇḍal bhū dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi mi badzra swa bhā wa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rdo rje'i gdan dang*/ bkrol te rkang pa de nyid las/ g.yon gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng*/ g.yas gan rkyal du bzhag la/ ā sa mā dhi/ ā sa na bsam gtan gyi gdan maṇḍal/ sogs brjod pas bsam gtan gyi gdan dang*/ bkrol te rkang pa de nyid las/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag byas la/ oṃ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis badzra paryaṃ ka maṇḍal/ sogs brjod pa rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*/ bkrol te byin pa g.yas pa'i steng du g.yon bzhag ste pus mo gnyis smad la/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ padma ā sa na maṇḍal/ padma'i gdan gyi/ sogs brjod pa padma'i gdan dang*/ bkrol te rkang g.yas brla g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag cing g.yon brla g.yas pa'i 'og tu bzhag la/ rdor sems kyi phyag rgya bcing zhing*/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis oṃ satwa paryaṃ ka maṇḍal/ sogs brjod pa sems dpa'i skyil krung dang*/ bkrol te rkang g.yon sems skyil ltar byas pa'i mdun du g.yas rkang mthil sa la bzhag ste pus mo gyen du bslangs la/ lag pa g.yas pus mo'i steng nas brkyang pa'i mchog sbyin dang*/

g.yon mnyam gzhag lte ba'i thad du byas la/ oṃ bī ra ā dpa' bo'i gdan gyi sa na maṇḍal/ sogs brjod pa dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs dang*/ bkrol te khri'i steng du khyil la 'dug pa ltar byas te/ lag gnyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ bha dra ā bzang po'i gdan gyi sa na maṇḍal/ sogs brjod pa bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang*/ bkrol te rkang gnyis bar du mtho gang tsam byas la tsog pur 'dug lag gnyis zhags pa'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ uṅku tsog pu'i gdan gyi ṭu ka ā sa na maṇḍal/ zhes sogs brjod pa tsog pu'i 'dug stangs dang*/ rkang g.yas sems skyil ltar bya/ g.yon cung zad brkyangs te/ lag gnyis lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ la li ta rol pa'i gdan gyi ā sa na maṇḍal bhū mi/ sogs brjod pa rol pa'i 'dug stangs dang*/ bkrol te rkang mthil gnyis sbyar la pus mo gnyis phyir bkyed cing lag gnyis dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ maṅga la ā sa na maṇḍal bhū bkra shis kyi gdan gyi mi badzra swa bhā waṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pa bkra shis can te gdan bcu'o// 'di rnams kyang mkhas par sbyangs nas so so'i nyams dang ldan pa byas te/ nyams dang bral ba ni shin tu mdzes pa ma yin no// bcu dgu pa dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi mchod pa ni/ slar yang dpon slob thams cad sngar ltar pad skor gsum gyis langs la/ lus g.yo ba dang bcas pas pad skor gnyis byas la g.yon gzhi dang mnyam pa la pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ rkang g.yon g.yon du cung zad bkyed la g.yas pa'ang de'i phyi zur du bzhag cing rked pa cung zad smad nas/ sgeg pa dang bcas pas snying gar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin du rkang g.yas g.yas su bkyed la/ g.yon pa'ang de'i phyi zur du bzhag cing lus smad nas sgeg pas mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas mchod la se gol bya zhing*/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha mchod yon so sor bzhes shig swā hā/ de bzhin du res mos kyi spel la mchod pa so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod de bsdu'o// nyi shu pa bzlas pa ni/ pad skor dang bcas pas sa gzhi la skyil krung gis 'dug la/ lag gnyis sa la reg ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan bdun bzlas la/ lha'i 'khor lor spro zhing bsdu bas/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bya ste/ sa yongs su bzung ba'i cho ga'o// de nas bgegs la phur bu gdab pa'i don du/ sa yongs su bzung ba'i rjes thog de nyid dam/ yang na nang par snga bar langs la dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su 'dug ste/ lcags sam seng ldeng ngam mi rus las byas pa'i phur bu tshad ldan bcu/ snod gsar pa 'du byas pa rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms pa'i dbus su rang nyid sngar ltar hūm̐ mdzad du bskyed la g.yas brkyang dang hūm̐ mdzad kyi stangs stabs bya zhing hūm̐ drag tu brjod/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las khro bo bcu spros la phyogs bcur bzhugs par bsam zhing bskyed do// de nas phur bu rnams kyang stod hūm̐ mdzad kyi gzugs can/ smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can du bsgom mo// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug ste khro bo bcu la gtad pas de rnams kyis rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol lam dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du hūm̐ ring po las byung ba'i khron pa bcur bcugs par bsams la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i 'gros kyis slob dpon dbang ldan du song la/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btsugs par bsgoms nas g.yon gzhi dang g.yas brkyang zhing*/

pus mo g.yon btsugs la phur bu g.yas g.yon du bsgril zhing*/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta sdungs shig ya/ ghā ta sdungs shig ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ phaṭa gdug pa can thams cad khos khos phaṭa/ kī la phur bus ya/ kī la phur bus ya/ sarba sdig pa thams cad pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la rdo rje phur bus ya/ badzra dha rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rod ādzñā pa ya bka' bsgo bar byed do// ti/ sarba bgegs thams cad kyi bighān/ kā ya lus wā ngag ktsi yid ttaṃ/ kī la ya phur bus thobs shig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod la phur khung du btsugs te/ g.yon gyis bzung la g.yas rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje tho bas kun nas rdungs shig oṃ badzra muṅga rā ko ṭa ya/ ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐/ rdungs shig zhes brjod la bsdu'o// de bzhin du/ phyogs thams cad du byas pas 'gro ba rnams bgegs dang bral bar bsams te/ bgegs la phur bu gdab pa'i sbyor ba'o// 'di ni lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro yin pas sa bzung ba la mi gtogs so// kha che mkhas pa'i grong gi chu gter nas// ded dpon mtshungs med paṇa chen shākya shrī// gar gyi lag len yid bzhin nor bu 'di// bod yul blo yi dbul ba sel phyir blangs// de yi rjes 'brang bdud las rnam rgyal 'di// gsal bar bris las byung ba'i dge ba des// gdug pa kun 'dul rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi// rnam 'phrul gsum gyis bgegs kun 'joms gyur cig /dpal rdo rje phreng ba'i sa yongs su bzung ba'i cho ga 'di ni kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po'i phyag bzhes/ mang 'gar lotstsha ba byang seng gis phyag len du mdzad pa ltar/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa bzhin 'ongs nas/ rtsod dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun sa bzang pa chen po 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi zhal snga nas ji ltar phyag len du mdzad pa ltar yi ge snga ma dang gzhung las btus te dag par bgyis pa 'di don gnyer gyi slob ma dag gi ngor shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen no//

// ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi rgyud la brten nas char dbab pa'i man ngag bzhugs so// ༈ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud las gsungs pa ltar char dbab pa'i cho ga nyams su len par 'dod na don bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ las sbyor dngos dang*/ ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ slar bcad pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ dpal dgra nag gam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ hrīḥṣṭ-iḥ'abum phrag bco lnga'i bar du bsnyen pas las thams cad 'grub par gsungs la/ bye ba lnga bzlas pas ni the tshom mi za bar 'grub par bshad pa ltar bzlas so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ thog mar ku ru kulle'i rnal 'byor gyis klu dbang du bya ba dang*/ de nas char 'bebs dngos bya ba'i man ngag go /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pa gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ kham phor so ma btang ba zlum po kha sbyar zhig byas pa'i ga'u 'og ma'i nang du/ rams kyi khu bas dbus su padma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du mtshon cha 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bris/ padma'i lte bar/ oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥ kṣarko ṭa wa shaṃ ku ru dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la yig 'bru re re bri/ 'khor lo la yig 'bru brgyad mgo nang bstan g.yon skor du bris/ de'ang dbyar zla tha chungs la char 'bebs na karko ṭa dbang du sdud pa ltar/ ston zla ra ba la shaṃ kha pā la dang*/ ston zla 'bring po la takṣa ka dang*/ ston zla tha chungs la 'char 'bebs na/ bā su ka'i ming bris la de dag dbang du bsdu'o// de nas ga'u steng ma ci yang ma bris pa dang kha sbyar la skud pa sngon pos rgya gram du dkris nas ras la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag rang ku ru kuller bsgom/ 'khor lo la bris pa'i sngags ci nus bzlas/ de nas 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo bris pa ltar bskyed pa'i gsang sngags yig 'bru brgyad pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/

lha mo ku ru kulle klu thams cad skrag par byed pa ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ g.yas 'og mas lcags kyu/ g.yon 'og mas utpal bsnams pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po bsgom/ de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyis rgyas gdab la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ bcom ldan 'das ma klu che ge mo dbang du bsdus nas char 'bebs pa'i dgongs pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i hṝḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po nas/ karko ṭa la sogs pa'i klu rnams bkug nas ming gi yi ge la thim pas klu de dag gi gzugs su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang sgrub pa po'i bka' nyan par bsam mo// de nas thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer dmar po 'phros klu la phog pas/ des tsha gdungs ma bzod par dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa khri phrag gcig gi bar du bzlas so// thun so so'i mthar bcom ldan 'das ma la mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa sngar ltar bya'o// de nas kham phor de klu gnas pa'i mtsho 'gram du sbas pas klu dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas dben par rdul tshon gyi phyi rol me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po dang*/ de'i dbus su rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam dang*/ de'i dbus su chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dang*/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad bris la/ dbus su baṃ dkar po/ 'dab ma brgyad la naṃ brgyad klu so so'i kha dog ltar bri'o// de'i mthar mchod yon dang*/

zhabs bsil dang*/ me tog sngon po dang*/ nā ga ge sar dang*/ ka ra bsres pa'i spos dang*/ mar dkar gyi mar me dang*/ bu ram/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi rnams dang sbyar ba'i zhal zas rnams kyang bsham/ chu sngon pos bkang ba'i bum pa brgyad dang*/ dar gyi 'phan sngon po brgyad/ 'o mas bkang ba'i kham phor brgyad phyogs mtshams su bsham/ gos sngon po'i lda ldis mtha' bskor de'i steng du bla re sngon po bri/ thun re re zhing sngar gyi zhal zas kyi rgyu las byas pa'i gtor ma dgu dgu bsham/ gzhan yang dngul snod la sogs par kun du ru ste/ spos dkar dang*/ chu srin sder mo dang*/ yungs kar ser po dang*/ nā ga ge sar rnams mar dkar dang sbyar ba bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang sgrub grogs dang bcas pa kha nub tu phyogs par 'khod nas/ dgra nag gam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom/ bzlas pa ci nus bya'o// de nas mdun gyi mchod rdzas rnams trīḥṣṭṛḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams bskyed/ arghaṃ sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun du bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bris pa ltar skyes pa'i padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su baṃ las chu bdag dkar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ skyes bu'i cha byad can/ g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ shar gyi 'dab mar klu dga' bo ljang gu/ lhor nor rgyas kyi bu dkar po/ nub tu takṣa ka dmar po/ byang du karko ṭa nag po/ mer padma dkar po/ bden bral du padma chen po dkar skya/ rlung du dung skyong ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan sna tshogs mdog thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod mi'i lus can sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka lnga dang ldan pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du nor bu 'dzin par bsgom/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

rgya mtsho chen po nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang*/ dzaḥnaṃ dzaḥzhes pas bkug spro na/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// zhes sogs kyi tshig gis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bskyed pa la bstims nas/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par bsam mo// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams re re nas 'bul zhing*/ oṃ nā ga rā dza pa sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas/ arghaṃ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ rol mo yang dbul/ de nas gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// de nas gtor ma rnams 'o ma dang chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bhyo/ zhes sogs lan dgu brjod la dbul/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas klu chen po khyed rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang*/ bdag la brtse bar dgongs nas char chen po dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo// de nas rang gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis klu rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams kyi char 'bebs pa'i las byed par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā gā nāṃ/ nā gā nāṃ barṣa pa ya swā hā/ zhes tshigs gzhan smra ba spangs te 'bum phrag gcig bzlas so// thun so so'i mthar mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar bzhin byas pas char 'bab par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes ni/ klu rnams la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rgya chen po phul/ gzugs brnyan rnams dang rdul tshon/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams rol mo dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor/

rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bkra shis kyi tshig brjod cing las kyi rjes bsdu'o// gsum pa spogs chog ni/ cho ga de lta bus ma grub na/ slar spogs pa'i man ngag drug bya ste/ de'ang sngar bzhin gtor ma phul ba yan chad tshar ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su zhi ba'i thab khung byas la/ der dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin bris/ mchod rdzas dang*/ yam shing dang*/ mar dang*/ bu ram 'o ma rnams 'du byas/ thab khung du klu rnams bskyed pa nas bstod pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ klu rnams kyi lce dang gzar bu'i kha la yi ge naṃ bsams nas/ bu ram dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ mar gyi sreg blugs gsum phul la/ oṃ naṃ swā hā/ zhes pas sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad du bsreg go /de nas lha rnams rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ sbyin sreg gi rjes bsdu/ de ltar byas pas 'bab par 'gyur ro// des ma babs na sngar ltar gyi dkyil 'khor las me dang rlung go brjes pa bris la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngar bzhin byas rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin par bsgoms la/ klu thams cad kyi mjug ma mnan pa'i steng du/ rang nyid dgra nag gam rdo rje 'jigs byed g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lus la bskal pa'i me 'bar bas klu thams cad 'jigs par byed par bsgoms la/ oṃ naṃ hrīḥnaṃ/ ṣṭ-i naṃ/ bi naṃ/ kṛ naṃ/ tā naṃ/ na naṃ/ na naṃ/ hūm̐ naṃ/ hūm̐ naṃ/ phaṭa naṃ/ phaṭa ces drag tu bzlas/ de'i tshe 'og gi rlung g.yos pas me sbar/ des padma rnyings shing gdung bar byas/ steng nas sngar bzhin khro bo'i mes gdung pas klu rnams skrag pas chu skyug par bsams na char 'bebs so// yang des ma babs na/ dur khrod kyi ras sam/ mtshon gyis phog pa'i gos la dug dang*/ tshwa dang*/ ske tshe dang*/ tsha ba'i mar nag gis phyi mtshon cha 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ nang padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la/ baṃ hūm̐/

naṃ baṃ hūm̐/ zhes pa re re bri/ de nas klu gnas pa'i mtsho 'gram nas 'jim pa blangs la/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang*/ shing gcig pa'i rtsa ba'i sa dang lhan cig klu'i gzugs byas la/ de'i snying gar sngar gyi 'khrul 'khor de bcug rdza'i 'brub khung gi nang du bzhag nas sngar bzhin bkug la bstim/ de rang gi rkang 'og tu bzhag la/ rang gshin rje gshed kyi sku las me 'bar bas klu'i gzugs gdungs pas/ des ma bzod nas klu thams cad kyis char phab par bsams la sngar bzhin du sngags drag tu bzlas na char 'bab bo// yang des ma babs na/ gzugs de la tsha ba gsum dang*/ ske tshes byugs la/ thab khung khru gsum par dur khrod kyi shing la me sbar ba la/ cung zad gdung ba'am/ yungs kar brdeg cing sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na 'bab bo// yang des ma babs na/ ske tshe dang lan tshwa dang*/ dug dang*/ dha du ra rnams kyis byugs pa'i seng lding gi phur bu sor dgu pa sngar gyi gzugs brnyan de'i snying gar gdab cing*/ rang g.yon brkyang gis kha lho'am/ nub tu phyogs pa'i rkang 'og tu mgo mnan la/ mtshon rnon pos mjug ma nas dum bur gtubs shing sngags drag tu bzlas/ de nas me thab gru gsum du ro bsregs pa'i shing la me sbar te/ de'i dbus su dgra nag gam/ rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rnam pa can zhal gdangs shing ljags brkyang bar bsgom pa'i zhal du brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du phul la/ sngags drag tu bzlas na char 'bab bo// des ma babs na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la gnad du bsnun te/ bdag nyid dgra nag ltar na/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang*/ 'jigs byed ltar na 'jam dbyangs su bsgoms la/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ grog mkhar gyi sa la sogs pa la/ dgra nag gam/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku gzugs byas la/ de'i snying khar sngar gyi 'khor lo bcug pa rkang pas mnan te/ lag tu rdo rje bzung bas zhabs g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas rim pa bzhin bcad cing phyogs thams cad du 'phangs la/

hrīḥṣṭiḥkhri phrag gcig bzlas na nges par char 'bab par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa slar bcad pa'i man ngag ni/ ha cang char ches bar gyur na/ zhi ba'i thab khung du dgra nag ltar na/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dang*/ 'jigs byed la rdo rje 'jigs byed dkar po bskyed la/ mar dang 'o ma dang*/ sbrang rtsi'i sreg blugs khri phrag gcig phul na chod par 'gyur ro// des gal te ma chod na/ drag po'i thab khung du ras bal gyi sa bon bsreg cing drag po'i sbyin sreg byas pas nges par chod par 'gyur ro// 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas char 'bebs na/ sngags thams cad hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥ'i yi ge bcu pa 'ba' zhig tu bya zhing*/ spogs chog gi sngags kyang hūm̐ naṃ/ phaṭa naṃ ces pas chog go /dpal dgra nag gi rgyud las gsungs pa'i char 'bebs kyi cho ga 'di ni/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa dang zhang lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag la brten nas shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos gsal bar bris pa'o// //'dir sbyar dge ba gang thob des// gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa// ldong ston dkon mchog bzang po yi// lam gyi bar chad zhi gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma'i cho ga phrin las char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma'i cho ga phrin las char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo// kun rdzob spros pa'i bdud dang gshin rje rnams// don dam spros bral ngang du mthar mdzad pa'i// bden gnyis zung 'jug gshin rje gshed po la// gus pas btud de gtor ma'i cho ga bshad// 'dir rang ngam gzhan gyi don du gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud rnams las 'byung ba'i gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa bya ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par ba byung dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs la/

der rtsa thig brgyad btab nas mda' gang gi tshad kyi maṇḍal gru bzhi pa re khā nyis rim dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su chos 'byung rtse mo lhor bstan pa bri/ der padma 'dab ma bcu byas la me tog gi tshom bu bkod do// de la padma dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung ni nag po'o// de'i phyi rol gyi ngos gsum ni dmar po'o// re khā gnyis kyi bar ni nag por bya'o// de'i phyi rol gyi rang gi g.yon maṇḍal gyi g.yas nas thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du/ khrag gi mchod yon dang*/ dbang po lnga'i me tog dang*/ tshil chen gyi spos dang*/ zhun chen gyi mar me dang*/ mkhris pa'i dri chab dang*/ sha sna tshogs kyi zhal zas dang*/ rkang gling gi rol mo rnams bsham/ rang gi g.yas maṇḍal gyi g.yon du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma phud las chung bar byas pa dang*/ g.yas su las gshin gyi gtor ma lhag ma las che bar byas pa bsham/ de gnyis ka sha khrag dang*/ sgog btsong dang*/ ba dan sna tshogs pas brgyan no// chos 'byung gi steng padma'i mdun du gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa bzhag ste/ de'ang zan leb gru bzhi pa la tshangs thig rgya gram du btab nas dum bu bzhi bya/ de re re'ang sngar bzhin bzhi bzhir byas nas gru bzhi pa bcu drug 'byung la/ de dag gi zur bzhi nas rgya gram du bcad pas gru gsum drug cu rtsa bzhi byas nas/ de gtor snod du nang chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i rnam pa/ phyi lcags mkhar zur dgu par byas pa'i phyi ngos gsum du gsum gsum bdun brtsegs su brtsigs/ de'i nang du dgra'am bgegs kyi liṅga la mgo mjug bzlog la gzhug sha khrag dang sgog btsong sogs drug cu rtsa bzhis brgyan no// gtor ma 'di dag maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhag pa ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin no// zhes kun mkhyen gnyis pa dag 'chad mod kyi/ dgra nag gi bka' 'grel las/ dkyil 'khor gru gsum du byas la/ der phyi rol gyi lha rnams kyang tshim par byas shing*/

gtor ma'ang der sbyin par bya'o// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa la dgu las/ dang po bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya'o// gnyis pa mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyangs/ bris pa bzhin bskyed pa'i dbus su/ gtso bo bdag bskyed ltar bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa mang po spros pas phyogs skyong ba rnams spyan drangs par bsams la/ lus kyi lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ ngag tu/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ind+ra duṣṭāṃ sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ shar du brgya byin dkar po mig stong dang ldan pa glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis bgrang phreng dang mchog sbyin g.yon gnyis na dbyug gu rtse gsum pa dang gundhe 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa gundhe bsnams pa/ 'og tu sa lha ser po phag la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gzhan yang zhing skyong dang ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ khro bo rnams bdag la bsdus nas/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas khro bo stod gshin rje'i gshed dang*/ smad phur bu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa spros par bsam zhing*/ phyogs skyong bcu'i sngags kyi rjes su badzra kī la ya kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod de/ spyi bo nas phur bu btab pas/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsam mo// gsum pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang*/ mig sogs dbang po drug tu sa'i snying po sogs drug sgrub thabs bzhin bkod do// bzhi pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ hūm̐ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// srin po'i gzugs su rnam sprul pa// gdug pa can rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i khro rgyal gshegs su gsol// tshur byon tshur byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs// khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs// 'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa// mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hye hi ma hā kro dha ā gatstsha ya ā gatstsha ya/ a sma pū dza pra tī gṛhtā pa ya tott+ra mo mant+ri ku ru sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod do// lnga pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya zhing*/ phyogs skyong ba rnams la'ang mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab la/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du bstims nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan pa'i bar bya'o// drug pa liṅga la 'gugs 'dren bya ba ni/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas zhabs 'og gi gdong brnyan rnams spros te bsgrub bya bkug par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥrje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= /chos kyi bka'= /dge 'dun gyi bka'= /khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed phyogs skyong ba bcu/ las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/

dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra/ dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra/ sems can rnams la 'tshe ba/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mtho btsams shing chos sgrub pa'i bgegs byed pa'i dam nyams sdig can thams cad dam/ che ge mo zhes bya ba liṅga 'di nyid la myur du mchis par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod pas liṅga de bsgrub bya gcer bu sgo rnams nas khrag 'dzag pa/ lus 'dar zhing bred pa/ dbang po'i mdangs shor ba/ rgyu ma nar bzhin par bsams la/ sngar spros pa'i gdong brnyan rnams kyis lus la rma btod cing*/ gzhan yang las kyi gshin rje mdog nag cing mi sdug pa/ lag na dbyug pa dang zhags pa thogs pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i mgul pa zhags pas bcings/ lus thams cad dbyug tos brdungs par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad pa// khro rgyal khyod kyi dus la babs// bstan pa bshigs pa'i dgra bo 'di// myur du khug la las mdzod cig /hūm̐ dzaḥgaza' bzhin spros nas ni// ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥmyur du khug /rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros pas// khu gcig badzra aṅku sha /rdo rje zhags pa'i tshogs spros pas// drongs shig badzra pā sha hūm̐// rdo rje lcags sgrogs tshogs spros pas// sdoms shig badzra spho ṭa baṃ// rdo rje dril bu'i tshogs spros pas// phob cig badzra ghaṇḍe ho// rdo rje tho ba'i tshogs spros pas// rgyob cig badzra muṅka ra// rdo rje dgra st+wa'i tshogs spros pas// khos shig badzra pa ra shu// rdo rje rtse gsum tshogs spros pas// gzir cig badzra tri shū la// rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros pas// thob cig badzra kī la ya// rdo rje ral gri'i tshogs spros pas// gtubs shig badzra khaḍga ho// zhes brjod la mchod pa lngas mchod/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bas mig rgyen la yun ring bar gtad do// de nas rnam smin gyi lus de pho nya rnams kyi mchod gtor dang rgyun du byas par bsam mo// bdun pa mchod pa bya ba ni/

mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag zhag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha sna tshogs kyi zhal zas/ rkang dung gi rol mo/ gzhan yang g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang*/ keng rus kyi phreng ba/ rus pa'i rgyan rnam pa drug la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi// khrag zhag arghaṃ la sogs pa'i// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs la// gus pa'i tshul gyis bdag 'bul na// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro ba'i don// ma lus par ni grub par mdzod// oṃ badzra bhai ra wa maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' rnams kun la sbyar bas/ dbang po lnga yi puṣpe sogs/ me tog ji snyed dang*/ badzra puṣpe/ tshil chen dhū pe la sogs pa/ bdug spos ji snyed/ dhu pe/ zhun chen dī paṃ la sogs pa/ snang gsal ji snyed/ ā lo ke mkhris pa'i gandhe la sogs pa/ dri chab ji snyed/ gandhe/ sha rus bza' ba la sogs pa/ zhal zas ji snyed/

nai wi te/ rkang dung gling bu la sogs pa/ rol mo ji snyed/ shapta/ zhes pas rol mo 'bul te phyi'i mchod pa'o// de nas/ g.yang gzhi bla re nam mkha'i rgyan// rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan// keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan// phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan// 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i// bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*// zhes pa man sngar bzhin sbyar ba dang*/ a laṃ kṛ ta zhes dbul te rgyan gyis mchod pa'o// de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa// lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan// bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar ba// ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs pas// dngos grub padmo 'byung ba'i gnas// mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi// gsang ba bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*// zhes pa man dang*/ a mṛ tas 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs la 'bul/ de nas dkyil 'khor gzhan dang*/ lus kyi lha rnams mchod nas/ chos skyong dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ rigs drug rnams la'ang byin nas/ mthar rang gis kyang myangs la/ gzugs sgra la sogs pas mchod do// brgyad pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ mi'u thung sgeg po sogs sam/ dur khrod rgyan gyi la sogs pas bstod do// dgu pa gtor ma 'bul ba la gsum las/ dang po 'das pa'i gtor ma dbul ba ni/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas gzugs sgra sogs kyis mchod pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas/ phrin las bskul ba'i phyir/ hūm̐ 'jam dbyangs khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// mtshon cha chen po'i me ri 'bar// gsod pa'i khro phreng nag po dkrigs// chos dbyings pho brang nam mkha'i dbyings// gru gsum nag po e yi dbyibs// bskal pa'i me ltar ye shes kyi// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor te// mkha' 'gro rol pa'i dur khrod nas// keng rus khog pa phub pa yi// thod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni// dbang drag rlung gi dkyil 'khor du// nad dang gdon dang srin po'i tshogs// bsnol ba'i dbyings nas bzhengs pa ni// gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor te// 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed// srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa 'dul// sangs rgyas khros pa kun bdag nyid// mi thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog

/gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag /rkang mthil sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang*// tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon// mun nag 'bum gyi gzi brjid kyis// nam mkha'i khams kun zil gyis gnon// ye shes me 'bar chen po yis// dus mtha'i me yang rmugs par byed// rags pa'i sku chen yan lag las// 'jigs pa'i sha tshugs bres shing 'bur// gtum po'i dbu dgu bsgyur ba yi// srin po'i zhal nas khrag chen 'dzag /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong*// lhag par klu dang 'chi bdag bsdigs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i ma rungs spyan// nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar po bzlog /phyag mthil dmar po sum cu bzhis// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bcu drug zhabs// bsgyings pas bgegs dang log 'dren mnan// mtshams kyi sprin dmar 'thibs pa bzhin// ser nag 'tshubs pa'i dbu skra 'khyil// srin po'i gdong yang sdigs pa yi// keng rus mgo bo'i cod pan can// rngams pas mnan pa ma he'i rwa// brdar bas ri rab dbyings nas bsgyel// gar dgu'i dbyings las ma g.yos phyir// spyi gtsug rdo rje 'dzin pas brgyan// dregs pas khros pa'i khro gnyer stong*// rgya mtsho bskyod pa bzhin du gnyer// sdang mig rtsub pa'i lta stangs kyis// gza' dang rgyu skar sa la ltung*// khros pa'i spyan dmar me dpung bzhin// 'khrugs pa'i zer gyis nyi 'od rmugs// rngams stabs pa yi rkan gyi sgra// pheṃ dang hūm̐ sgras 'brug stong 'gems// gtum po'i mche ba gtsigs pa yi// gad rgyangs ha has sa gzhi g.yo// gdugs pa brngubs pa'i ma he'i shangs// phud sgras dus mtha'i rlung yang bcil// za byed ljags dgu bsgril ba yis// glog stong 'gyur ba 'thib par byed// brdabs pa'i phyag dang se gol gyis// ri rgyal rdul phran bzhin du rlog /bsgyings pa'i gar gyi stang stabs kyis// zhabs kyis rgya mtsho gnam du gcol// zad pa'i dus kyi me 'bar ba// zhal gyi dbugs kyis btab pas bcil// dus gcig sku yi cha gcig las// drag po'i 'brug bzhin gnam lcags 'phro// bskal ba'i me 'bar rgya mtsho skems// 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'phro zhing 'du// rngams pa'i khro tshogs dbyings nas sprul// btsan dang srin po zer bzhin 'phro// gshin rje rngams pa pho nyar 'gyed// lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol// phyogs skyong bcu po mngags par sprul// bgegs dpung rdul du bshig nas sdud// drag po thal bar brlag nas gso// khrag zhag chen po'i rgya mtsho brngubs// sha rus chen po'i ri bo za// bdud sde ma lus phur nas 'gams// khams gsum ma lus ril por mid// 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub mdzad// sangs rgyas khros pa'ang za bas sdigs// stong gsum chen po yungs 'brur sdud// rdul phran gcig gis 'jig rten 'gengs// chu bo chen po lugs las bzlog

/ri rab chen po rgyang tu 'phen// rgya mtsho chen po gnam du gcol// zhing lpag slang po'i bsnam dkres gsol// dug sbrul tshangs skud mchod phyir thogs// mgo phreng rgyu zhags rus rgyan can// khrag zhag thal ba'i thig ris tshom// 'phro 'du 'khyil pa'i khro mos brgyan// gtum chen khro bo'i rngam stabs kyis// 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor nas ni// rang gi yan lag za byed na// ma lus dgra bgegs myur du zo// rdo rje khro bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs// mthong na lag cha lhung bar 'gyur// gzhan rnams smos kyang ci zhig dgos// dgra bgegs ma lus myur du bsdigs// dregs pas khros pa khro bo'i bka'// bsgos pa gal te mi byed na// rgyal ba'ang za bas bsdigs byed cing*// dgra bgegs ma lus myur du zo// 'jig rten gshin rje khros pas kyang*// pham par byed na 'jam pa'i dbyangs// khros pas smos kyang ci zhig dgos// dgra bgegs rdul phran bzhin du mdzod// rgyud sde kun gyi dus gsum gyi// sangs rgyas mtshan nas thos pa bas// 'jam dpal lan cig ches mchog tu// gsung gis bdag la byin gyis rlob// sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi// gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes// rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang*// snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms// khug cig drongs shig dbang du bsdus// sod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis// phyes shig non cig rmugs par gyis// phug cig gtubs shig rnam par rgyob// thul cig choms shig rnam par shig /dkrugs shig g.yeng cig rnam par choms// rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi gtor ma ni/ sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/

rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ind+ra ya hriḥ ya mā yaṣṭ+rīḥ wa ru ṇā ya wi/ ku be rā ya kṛ/ ī shwa rā ya ta/ agna ye ā/ nair ṛ tyā ya na/ wā ya we na/ brahma ṇā ya hūm̐/ pṛ thi wi bhyaḥphaṭa/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ zhes pa drug cu rtsa bzhis dbul/ mchod bstod bya/ de nas phrin las bskul ba'i phyir/ hūm̐ gshin rje gshed kyi rnam 'phrul las// 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul 'dzin pa'i// phyogs bcu'i srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs// bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras// gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir// bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan// rgyu ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang*// gzi byin sku gsung thugs kyis bskyed// don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don// las ni sangs rgyas kun gyi las// bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi// zhes pa man chad sngar ltar sbyar ro// gsum pa las kyi gshin rje'i gtor ma ni/ byin gyis brlab pa nas phrin las gzhol ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa nas lhag ma'i gtor ma gtong ba'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du byas la/ gtor ma mtha' nas rim gyis phyir byung nas lho phyogs kyi grong zad pa'i sa'am dgra phyogs su go mtshon dang bcas pas khyer la/ der las kyi gshin rje la gtad par bsam zhing*/ bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed pa'i bka'// chos kyi rgyal po dgongs su gsol// de ring drag po'i phrin las ni// khyod kyi las su 'os pa yin// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa khyod// gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' 'khor na// bka' nyan dam tshig srung ba khyod// las dang rkyen gyis 'chi ba la// srog la dbang byed bdag po khyod// de phyir las 'di khyed la gtad// khyed kyi 'khor ni mi srun te// tha mal sems can nyes med cing*// gzhan gyis bskul bar ma byas par// glo bur phrad pa'ang 'dzin byed na// nga yis gtad pa'i las 'di rnams// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i bka' bzhin du// dam tshig phyag rgya mig la bstan// dam tshig snying po rna bar bsgrags// rdo rje'i tha tshig snying la bzhag

/dam rdzas mchod pa phul nas kyang*// dam tshig phrin las gnyer du gtad// las 'di mngon du bsgrub par rigs// khyod kyis las 'di ma bsgrubs na// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yang bcag /gshin rje'i gshed po'i dam yang dral// rang gi tha tshig rang gis bslus// dam tshig grogs po bdag cag gi /re ba'i bsam pa gting nas bcad// de bas las 'di bsgrub par gyis// khyod kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na// ya ma dā dhi zhes bya ba// lag na lcags kyu nag po thogs// gang zhig gzung bar 'dod pa de// g.yug pa tsam gyis 'dzin par byed// khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni// che ge zhes bya'i yul khams na// che ge mo zhes bya ba'i ming*// rus ni che ge mo zhes bya// 'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa kun// de ring khyod kyis gzung bar gyis// gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na// kā la pā sha zhes bya ba// lag na dus kyi zhags pa thogs// gang zhig bcing bar 'dod pa de// btab pa tsam gyis 'ching bar byed// lhag ma snga ma bzhin no// gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na// ya ma daṇḍī zhes bya ba// lag na be con nag po thogs// gang zhig gsod par 'dod pa kun// 'phyar ba tsam gyis 'chi bar byed// lhag ma snga ma bzhin no// gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na// ya ma daṃṣṭ+ṝ zhes bya ba// za byed mche ba 'bar ba can// gang zhig za bar 'dod pa de// gtsigs pa tsam gyis za bar byed// lhag ma snga ma bzhin no// gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na// kā la rā tri la sogs pa'i// gsod pa mo dang nag mo dang*// nam gru sha ka li la sogs// bud med tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// la la las kyi me long dang*// la la nad kyi rkyal pa dang*// la la mtshon gyi gru gu dang*// la la bdud kyi khram shing dang*// la la rde'u dkar nag can// la la lcags kyi dre'u rta can// la la bong bu gwa pa zhon// la la rlung nag 'tshubs ma zhon// la la chu bya nag mo zhon// la la nam gyi gung la rgyu// la la chu bo'i gzhung la rgyu// la la nyi ma'i zer la rgyu// kun kyang gzhan srog phrog par byed// khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni// lhag ma snga ma bzhin no// gzhan yang nang gi dkyil 'khor na// ya ba ti dang phya sangs dang*// rmig pa ral pa tshar dgu sogs// la la rgyal po'i tshul du gnas// la la blon po'i tshul du gnas// la la dag ni sde dpon tshul// la la pho nya'i tshul du gnas// la la be con 'khor lo dang*// gsal shing mdung rnon mtshon cha thogs// so so'i sde dpon mngags pa dang*// pho nya phyag brnyan bcas pa la// phrin las myur du gtad pa ni// che ge zhes bya'i yul khams na// che ge mo zhes bya ba'i ming*// rus ni che ge mo zhes bya// 'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa kun// khyed kyis de ring gzung bar bgyis// zhes bskul/

dmar gyi arghaṃ lan gsum du bsgreng zhing arghaṃ gyi sngags brjod de/ de nas mna' chu blud par bya ste/ dri chab kyi nang du bdud rtsi lnga blugs la/ nang du rdo rje bcug ste/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐ ṭha/ zhes ci rigs pa brjod la/ de nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi khar blugs par bsams la/ steng nas dri chab blugs te/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi snying gar ye shes kyi rdo rje me 'bar ba re rer gyur par bsam zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsis chu 'dis 'grub// gal te dam tshig 'das gyur na// 'jam dpal rdo rje khros nas kyang*// snying ga nas ni gshegs par 'gyur// oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐ ṭha/ sngon gyi tha tshig dran pa'i phyir// rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di bsnan pas// mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di// khyod kyi snying la gnas par 'gyur// oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha zhes brjod do// rdo rje gshin rje'i snying gar bzhag par bsgom/ de nas gtor ma btang la/ khro bo'i tsham rngams dang bcas pas stangs stabs bya zhing rang gi gnas su ldog gtor ma bskyel mi rnams la/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥbazlas te bsrung ba bya/ bkra shis brjod/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// gtor ma 'di ni dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su phyi rol pa'i gtor ma yin zhing*/ sgrub pa'i dus su byang gi gtor ma'i bsad las yin la/ rgyun du bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ byad bzlog gi mchog yin zhing*/ yi ge bcu pa'i las kha tshar ba yin zhes gsung ngo*// tshogs spel gegs sel phrin las kun 'grub pa'i// gtor ma'i cho ga phrin las char 'bebs 'di// rgyud 'grel rgya gzhung rnams dang mi 'gal zhing*// rwa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa bzhin// lag len shin tu gsal bar bris shig ces// 'gro kun dga' byed dge legs dpal yon can// bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' yis bskul ba'i ngor// rgyud sde 'dzin pa kun dga' bzang pos sbyar// de yi dge ba yid bzhin nor bu de// rim gnyis mthar son ded dpon gyis blangs te// dad dang 'dun pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag nas// phrin las rnam bzhi'i gzi 'od 'bar bar shog
