rgyas pa'i las rnams kyang bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan nges na/ dbang gi 'khrul 'khor yang lan re tsam bya'o// gang yang mngon spyod kyi 'khrul 'khor bya bar gsungs pa ni/ mngon spyod bya ba'i yul/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gnod nges pa dang*/ drag las ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang mi thul ba dang*/ yul de tshe ring na bstan pa spyi 'jig pa la sogs pa'i las mi dge ba mang po bsags pas/ 'chi khar ngan song gsum du ltung nges shing*/ rang nyid la yang zhe sdang cung zad kyang med cing*/ snying rje chen po rgyun chags su ldan pa/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' shes pas bya bar bshad pa yin gyi/ rang kho na'i don nam/ rang gi bdag tu gzung ba'i dgon gnas tsam re'i ched du byed pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje dmyal bar ltung nges pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du mi bya zhing*/ mngon spyod kyi gdams ngag rnams kyang bstan par mi bya'o// de'i phyir bdag legs su 'dod pa dag gis/ thog ma med pa nas phan btags pa'i ma drin can du gyur pa rnams la/ bsam sbyor ngan pa skad cig kyang bskyed par mi bya ste/ rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa las/ sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems// nam yang dor ba nyid mi bya// zhes rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi par bshad pa'i phyir ro// mchog thun mong gi las gang bsgrubs kyang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du/ gshin rje'i gshed lhan cig skyes pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bya dgos la/ de'i don yang slob dpon blo gros bzang pos lhan cig skyes pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bdag nyid kyi gzugs kho na rang bzhin du grub pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal brjod de/ bdag gshin rje'i gshed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa nyid du rang bzhin gyis grub pa nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur te/

gzhung chung ba las/ rim pa 'dis bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa dang dam tshig sngon du 'gro ba can des/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi bka'o// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// rgyal bas rnam mang rgyud sde gsung rnams las// 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje'i gshed po zhes// rab 'byams las la bsngags par bshad pa'i phyir// 'phags yul mkhas rnams 'di la gtso bor mdzad// deng dus mi mkhas ded dpon 'ga' zhig gis// nor bu spangs te mching bu len pa ltar// 'di don rnam par 'chad pa mang na yang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gzhung dang mthun pa nyung*// de phyir bdag blo man ngag gru rdzing las// mang thos brtson pa'i rlung gis rab bskyod nas// rgyud 'grel gdams pa'i rgya mtshor phyin pa'i mthus// rmad byung mngon rtogs yid bzhin nor bu blangs// de yi dge bas mtha' yas skye dgu rnams// las nyon gshin rje'i tshogs rnams rgyun bcad de// srid gsum chos dbyings bde chen ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed du 'grub gyur cig /dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bdud rtsa'i bum pa zhes bya ba sngar sbyar ba las/ slar yang shes byed kyi lung dang sbyar ba 'di ni mtha' yas pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen pa can rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor pa kun dga' bzang po dang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa grags pa dpal bzang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag gi rgyud 'grel rgya gzhung bod kyi bla ma so so'i gzhung la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas shing bye brag tu lha lnga'i sgos kyi chos skad spyi dang ma 'dres par byas nas rnam 'phyang gi lo snron gyi zla ba'i tshes gcig la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen no// i daṃ shā sa na shtsa sarba satā hi to bha wantu//

// ༄༅/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la 'dud lha mchog de'i// dkyil 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bri// 'dir ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdo rje slob dpon la/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas gsol ba 'debs na/ de rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ gnas dben par sgrub thabs ltar lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms te/ gtso bo'i sngags 'bum dang*/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzlas nas sam/ lhas rjes su gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug par bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par skyang nul byas la/ mchod gtor dang nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bshams nas/ slob dpon sa'i dbus su 'dug la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams te/ lha'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar byas la/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ zhes pas/ sa nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang*/ hūm̐ lam hūm̐ zhes pas/ sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ oṃ me di ni badzri bha wa bandha hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa ni sa sbyang ba'o// de nas slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa la/ slob mas phyogs bzhi nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ gti mug rdo rje la sogs pas bstod la/ gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni// sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa// mgon pos dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab/

slob ma med na rang gis brjod cing bsam mo// de nas/ hūm̐ badzra u ttiṣṭha/ zhes pas bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ rang gi mig g.yon pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yas pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar bsams la/ g.yas g.yon du bltas pas/ bgegs bskrad cing gsod par bsam/ rkang pa hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil zhing rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bskor la/ ngag tu hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥbarjod cing*/ dbang ldan du gnas pas bgegs la bka' bsgo ste/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// srung ba'i 'khor lor sbyor ba po// rdo rje'i gzugs ni 'bar ba yis// lus gsum las skyes dwags par byas// gal te kha cig bdag la 'das// 'jigs par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min// zhes dang*/ shar du/ rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo dang*/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gri bcug pas bka' bsgo zhing*/ thams cad du rol mo drag po'i sgra dang*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥbazlas pas bgegs bskrad par bya'o// de nas phur bu gcig bsang sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ stod phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dang*/ smad phur bu'i rnam par bsgoms nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bkug la/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btsugs shing tho bas brdungs par bsams la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha rod adzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bighnān/ kā ya wāktsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing brdungs pas/ bgegs kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar phug nas sa gzhi dang sbrag par bsams la/ dngos su phur bu dbang ldan du btab pa ni sa yongs su bzung ba ste/

nub dang po'i bya ba'o// de nas sang nang par sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar sngon du song bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu byas la/ der mtshams bcing pa'i phyir srung 'khor bsgoms te/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa 'og nas baṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lus phyed 'thon pa/ phyag g.yas pas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa spyan drangs nas bdag la phyogs par bzhugs pa la/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pa la arghaṃ sogs btags pas phul/ nang mchod kyis kyang mchod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ a kā ros phul la/ g.yas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*// bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin pa la/ slar yang mchod nas/ sa de nyid du thim par bsams te sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir lha gnas mi 'chor bar bya ba'i phyir/ thig chen brgyad tsam btab la/ de'i mthar mchod pa rnams bshams te/ bsang sbyangs pa'i ngang las srung 'khor nas gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgoms la/ dri bzang gi chus gtso bo lnga'i gnas su thig le gru bzhi dang*/ bum pa'i gnas su zlum por byugs la/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod nas de rnams gdan du bsgoms la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

sngar btegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ dri'i thig ler bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ mtshams bcing ba'i phyir srung 'khor gsal btab nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje// rig pa'i rgyal mchog khyod la 'dud// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo// de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus pas// bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs// sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha// lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// 'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*// sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba// gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams// bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol// rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /gshin rje'i gshed dmar dkyil 'khor ni// ci ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis// 'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bgyi// deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bar nyer bzung nas// 'dus pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// nye bar gnas pa mdzad par rigs// zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btab ste/ gnang ba byin par bsams la/ slar yang mchod cing sngar gyi sngags rgyas nam mkhar bteg ste/ lha lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis/ rdo rgyus la sogs pas dkar por byugs te/ rnam rgyal bum pa la/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbyug pa lnga bum pa dang bcas pa dang*/ las thams cad pa la rdo rje'i dbyug pa bri/ ras bzang pos mgrin par dkri/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥbazlas pa'i yungs kar gyis brdeg gu gul gyis bdug tsu ta la sogs pa'i shing gis kha brgyan/

rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga rnams dang*/ srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang mas dgang*/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dri bzang gis bkang ba'i dung chos dang*/ rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bzhag la/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par bskyed pa'i nang du/ sa bon las lha lnga bum pa dang bcas pa dang*/ las bum du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed bskyed la/ thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ me tog gi phreng ba nas bzung ste/ so so'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ las bum la hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥdang*/ hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas la/ slar yang phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod nas/ mchod yon phul nas lha rnams zhu nas/ chu'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams te/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas grub na sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇḍal dbul ba la/ chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed par bya ste/ rang gis slob ldan 'khor bzhi po// theg chen blo chen rnams la ni// de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi// yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang*// kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer// dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par 'gyur// de bzhin gzhan gyi bsod nams 'dod// gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol// blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug /'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas ni// 'jig rten pha rol 'bras gnyer na// gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub// 'di yi 'jig rten pha rol min// de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi// don du yid ni brtan par gyis// zhes pa'i don bshad la/

sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed du gzhug go /de nas bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ slob ma rnams slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs su gnas pa la slob dpon gyis snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang gi zhal nas zhugs shing*/ byang sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur pa rnams kyis dbang bskur te/ hūm̐ zhes pas padma nas phyir phyung nas gdan la 'khod par bsams la/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig sbyor// bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin no// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i can// dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje sngags kyis mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// gang gis shākya seng ge sogs// mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde// mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod pas spro ba bskyed nas/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs bsrungs nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg cing*/

hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje dang*/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dang*/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo bsgom/ yang yas rim gyis reg cing oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyag mtshan de rnams yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par bsam mo// de nas mgo bor me tog mdun du spos/ snying gar dri/ mdun du mar me rnams kyis mchod/ a shwattha la sogs pa'i so shing*/ me tog gi rtse mo can rnams dri bzang gis byug cing*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥbazlas pas slob ma la sbyin/ des kyang kha shar du bltas te/ so shing 'chos nas maṇḍal gyi steng du dor bas/ rtse mo shar lho nub byang steng 'og tu bltas na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag mkha' spyod sa 'og rnams 'grub cing*/ dkyil 'khor du ma lhung na/ dngos grub med par go bar bya'o// de nas/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa sya saṃ sho dhā ya/ sarba bi kalpā na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa'i chu khyor ba gsum 'thung du bcug hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan gyi don du byin gyis brlabs la/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥbazlas shing sbyin/ srung skud dmar po lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum sgril du byas la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor te/ slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon par bcing zhing*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥbazlas pas bsrung ngo*// de nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid// u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni ras 'ga' 'byung*// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis// de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod kyi// spyod tshul gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams kyis// blo gros shin tu dri med pa// de rnams kyis ni sdug bsngal kun// 'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// de ring rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed// gang gis khyed rnams rgyal ba kun// bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyis// bstan pa 'di la thams cad ni// yongs su bzung zhing skye 'gyur ba// de yis khyed rnams theg chen las// legs par skye ba nyid du 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// gang la khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur ba// de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin// zhes pas chos bshad la/

ku sha'i stan la nyal du bcug ste/ rmi lam gang cung zad mthong ba/ snga dro nga la smros shig ces brjod la/ rmi lam bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na bsrung ba bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyi sdom pa gzung ba'i phyir/ maṇḍal phul nas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni// sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir// slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsung du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum// dge ba dang ni chos sdud dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims ni// bdag gis so sor brtan por gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum mchog bla na med// sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung*// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus pa// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// de nyid kyi ni rab tu gzung*// slob dpon dag kyang gzung ba bgyi// rin po che yi rigs mchog ni// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin// padma chen po'i rigs dag pa// byang chub chen po 'byung ba la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las chen rigs ni bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bzhin// kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa yang dag bskyed bgyi zhing*// sdom pa ma lus gzung bgyis nas// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma dbyung ba dbugs dbyung bgyi// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod pa ni slob ma lhag par gnas pa ste/

nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o// de nas nangs par snga bar langs la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar byas nas/ ras bal gyi srad bu lnga tshon sna lngas kha dog bsgyur la dri bzang pos byug rang phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed du bsgoms pa'i lag par bzung la/ dkar po kṣe las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed/ de bzhin du ser po ma/ dmar po me/ ljang gu da/ sngon po ya rnams las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed sogs su bskyed do// rang gi mig gnyis dza las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi mar bsgoms la/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang*/ oṃ dīpta dṛṣṭa aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mdun du spyan drangs la/ oṃ āḥpra yatstsha mo ha ya ma a ri swa tsakra su tra na ma hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ mo ha'i gnas su pi shu na dang*/ rā ga dang*/ irṣ+ya na dang*/ dwe ṣa rnams bcug la gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes kyi srad bu rnams lag par gnas pa'i dam tshig gi srad bu la thim par bsams la/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma dang lhan cig oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmāḥspha ra spha ra a nu ga taḥ sarba dharm+maḥ.argyanta a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ dang po so so dang*/ de nas gcig tu bsgril zhing*/ dri bzangs kyis byugs la/ gser gyi snod du bzhag me tog la sogs pas mchod/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥbazlas pas bsrung ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i nub tu slob dpon dang*/ shar du slob ma 'dug la/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis lte bar thig skud bzung*/ dzdzaḥdzdzaḥdzdzaḥzhes brjod cing*/ slob ma la thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzdzaḥgasum brjod cing drangs la/ lte bar bzung ba la slob dpon gyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ oṃ āḥbadzra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ thig gi sgra dang*/ sems can don la khyed rnams kyis// dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig

/ces pas bskul/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thig la thim par bsgoms la/ tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du g.yas skor gyis/ slob dpon lho dang*/ slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon me dang*/ slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon rlung dang*/ slob ma bden bral du gnas pas/ nub gyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas/ byang gi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon me dang*/ slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho'i rtsa thig dang*/ de nas gzhung du ma bshad kyang lag len la/ slob dpon de nyid dang*/ slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang*/ slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas/ zur thig gnyis pa ste/ thams cad kyang nam mkha' dang*/ sa gzhi gnyis ka la btab nas/ las thig gi cha dbye ba'i phyir/ bskor phyogs dang go rim sngar dang 'dra bar/ las thig lag len ltar btab la/ thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ hrīḥlas mig g.yas g.yon gnyis nyi zla dang*/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rjer bskyed la/ hi hi zhes brjod cing*/ khro bo'i lta bas bltas pas/ khro bo'i rdo rje 'phros/ thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa'i bgegs rnams bcom par bsams la/ dri bzangs kyi chus sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig dbyi ste/ thig gi cho ga'o// de nas rdul tshon kha dog lnga la yakṣe ma med bris te/ phyogs ma 'dzol bar bkod la/ bsang sbyangs/ gshin rje'i gshed rigs lngar bskyed/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi rdul tshon sngar ltar 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang sngags kyis bkug la/ mchod cing bstod de/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdul tshon du bltas la/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ lha so so'i sngags bdun bdun bzlas pas/ byin gyis brlab/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas/

oṃ badzra be ga a kra ma ho/ zhes brjod la/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed// 'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// 'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas// zhes brjod cing dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis re khā lngas/ sgo tshad gcig gi bar bris la/ snod la sogs pas bkab cing rdo rje bzhag pas bsrung ngo*// phyis sbrel ran pa dang*/ snod bsal la rtsig pa gzhan dang sbrel lo// de nas rang ngam gzhan gyis kyang rung ste/ dbus kyi sna tshogs padma ni// phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser// bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo// lte ba ljang gu ge sar ser// phyogs mdog shar dkar lho phyogs ser// nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba'o// sgo dang rta babs me ri'i bar// dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bri// padma'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbyug pa dkar po rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir/ mer bum pa sngon po/ srin por ser/ rlung du dmar/ dbang ldan du dkar po rnams kyi steng du/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba re bri/ de ltar legs par bris zin pa dang*/ tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod nas/ ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la tshon gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bzhag ste/ tshon gyis bri ba'i cho ga'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dri bzangs kyi chus byug cing*/ mchod rdzas rnams bzang bar bsham/ rnam rgyal bum pa shar sgo'i thad dang*/ las bum dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dgod/ gdugs dang*/ ba dan dang*/ gos zung la sogs pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sogs/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshang bar bshams te rgyan dgram pa'o// de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug la/

rdo rje shugs kyis 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par mos la/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par bsgoms pa'i ngang las/ srung 'khor nas gdan bskyed pa'i bar/ sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ bris pa'i mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lha so so dang*/ bum pa rnams kyang bskyed/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bar/ sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ de yum gyi mkhar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su gyur par bsam/ de nas so so'i sngags kyis phyung la/ rdul tshon gyi lha dang bsres nas gsal gdab/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur/ ye shes pa gzhug pa rnams bdag bskyed dang 'dra bar byas la/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs bgegs bskrad/ sta gon gyi lha la mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstims te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ so so'i tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar/ sgrub thabs ltar phul la/ dzambū'i gling dang gling gzhan rnams// lha rdzas na bzas bkang ba yang*// bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po la// zhum pa med par byas te 'bul// hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥdang*/ oṃ badzra was sya swā hā/ zhes pas gos zung dang*/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur la/ gzugs mchog tshogs kyis bkang ba yang*// oṃ āḥrū pa badzra hūm̐/ de bzhin du sgra snyan dang*/ shabda/ dri mchog dang*/ gandhe/ ro mchog dang*/ ra sa/ reg 'jam dang*/ sparṣe zhes pas 'bul zhing*/ nag po ra ri med pa yi// bum pa lto che bre tshad pa// mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan pa// snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris// 'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang*// dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can// bdud rtsi ldan pa yis kyang mchod// gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni// bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*// ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis// gus pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod// ces pas mchod cing*/

nang bdud rtsi dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ gtor ma'i mchod pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ sgrub pa'i grogs dkyil 'khor srung du bcug nas rang phyi rol du phyin nas/ phyogs skyong rnams la gtor chog ltar gtor ma byin la/ nang du 'ongs te rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas la/ lhag chad zhi ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'o// de nas slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas par mos la/ dbang bskur gyi skabs ltar dbang thams cad rdzogs par blangs la/ slob dpon gyis las thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par bsam pa ste/ bdag 'jug go /de nas khrus byas pa'i slob ma rnams yol ba'i phyi rol du sta gon ltar 'khod nas/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul la sngar ltar/ mā ma kī dang lhan cig sbyor// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du bskyed// ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ gdong g.yogs dmar po bcings/ las thams cad pa'i chu dang*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs bsang nas/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed dang*/ maṇḍal phul te/ slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba rnams sngar ltar byas la/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dri/ des/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes lan gdab/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi mtshon byed dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can/ mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan par bsgoms la/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu sems bskyed pa'i bsams pas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ snying gar me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ

siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par bya'o// de nas a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes pas phan yon gyi sgo nas dang*/ 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste// khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems// zhes pas nyes dmigs dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes pas phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i dang*/ dung chos su dri bzangs po'i chu la/ oṃ badzra u da ka ṭhaḥbadun bzlas pas slob ma'i khar blugs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shing*// oṃ badzra u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥzhes pas mna'i chu blud pa dang*/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shigs ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs bar 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ slob ma 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du bsgom pa'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su haḥ

snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba'i dbus su āḥ rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de la dzhaiṃ drag cing bzod par dka' ba 'bar ba'i gzugs brnyan rlung gis bskyod pas/ rkang mthil gnyis nas zhugs te/ lte ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dang mnyam par phyin nas/ de'ang des bskyod nas shin tu drag tu 'bar bas snying ga'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ dpral ba'i oṃ las de las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs/ rgyud tshim par gyur pa'i slob ma rlung gis 'degs bzhin par bsams la/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas/ slob ma la thim zhing*/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu sgrogs bzhin pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ a we sha ya st+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsa la ya/ haḥdzhaiṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dbab bo// phebs pa dang*/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du dmigs pa'i lce la aḥdamar po bkod la/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod la/ mgon po rdo rje chos chen po// snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che// smros shig 'dod chags chos chen po// dge dang mi dge legs par dri// zhes brjod la dri bar bya'o// de'ang gsung babs pas dge ba dang mi dge ba smra'o// thugs babs na 'jig rten gsum du rtogs pa shes so// sku babs pas nam mkha' la 'phar ro// de'i tshe mgo bo'i steng du laṃ las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa des mnan par bsgoms na/ mi 'gul bar 'gyur ro// de nas sngar gyi me tog gi phreng ba de trāṃ las rin po che'i me tog du mos la/

pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes pas rang gi lha la phul/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la zhes pas me tog mgo la bcings/ mig tu oṃ bsams la/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa// thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad// ces pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ he badzra pa shya/ zhes brjod pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas maṇḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yi// rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar// bdag la'ang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing*// mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ las bum gyi chu dang*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs slob ma dang bum pa bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ ya dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed ro langs mas 'khyud par bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ dbang rdzas la ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas kyi lha snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur bltas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de rnams la mchod cing*/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la gnang bar zhu// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i yum rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya// zhes rnam rgyal bum pa nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis chu blangs la/

oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag ste/ dbang gi lha rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byas nas/ rang gi spyi bor dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la rang nyid la thim par bsgoms pa la/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes mchod// de ltar na zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag zhes rtog pa bskyed do// de rnams ni lha dang dbang rdzas kyi khyad par ma gtogs rdo rje slob dpon gyi bar thams cad la 'gres so// de bzhin du slob ma dang dbu rgyan bsang sbyangs/ me dang dbyug pa las ser sna gshin rje'i gshed yab yum du bskyed pa sogs bya/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du bltas la/ sngar gyi sngags kyis dbur brgyan cing*/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ gtso bos rgyas btab/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ mchod pas mchod/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor phung gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma dang rdo rje bsang sbyangs/ me dang dbyug pa las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed yab yum du bskyed pa sogs byas te/ zhu bas rdo rjer bltas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje rab tu grub phyir zungs// zhes brjod de/ rdo rje snying ga la sogs par reg la rdo rje lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ gtso bos rgyas btab/ ye shes pa bcug pa la mchod nas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/

'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma dang dril bu bsang sbyangs/ da dang dbyug pa las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed yab yum du bskyed pa sogs bya/ zhu bas dril bur bltas la/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas dril bu lag pa g.yon du sbyin chus kyang dbang bskur/ gtso bos rgyas btab/ ye shes pa bcug la mchod nas/ phrag dog gshin rje'i bshed kyi sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma bsang sbyangs/ kṣe dang dbyug pa las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed yab yum du bskyed pa la sogs byas la/ oṃ badzra satwa st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badzra nā ma badzra a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge rdo rje la sogs rigs dang mthun pa'i ming gdags so// chus kyang dbang bskur/ gtso bos rgyas gdab/ ye shes pa bcug la mchod nas/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs phung gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do// dbang bskur ba 'di dag gis/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang*/ sngags sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro// dbang lnga po 'di nyid cod paṇa gyi dbang ste/ thams cad du tsartsi ka la sogs pa rnams cod paṇa la dbang gi tshul du bya ba'i phyir ro// de nas slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du phyag dang maṇḍal phul nas/ gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab la/

dkyil 'khor gyi shar du rdul tshon dkar pos padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du/ shing stan la slob ma me tog gang phog gi nga rgyal gyis bzhag gang ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus pa bskur te/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas par byin la/ khams gsum pa yi ral gri che// sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa// las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu// bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zungs// zhes dang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o// zhes brjod pas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig go /aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu lag g.yon du byin la/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid// rdo rje dril bu rab grub phyir// bu yis yang dag gus pas zungs// khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis// zhes dang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yi// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod de dril bu gsung gi dam tshig go /de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bsgoms nas/ shes rab la 'khyud pa'i tshul byas la/ yid kyi lus rten de nyid kyis// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu bshad// gang gis lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags// zhes pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'gyur// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyis ni dbang du brjod// ces pa'i don ngo sprad la/ chu dbang rgyas pa bskur la/ lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid sgrub thabs ltar bshad do// de nas slob ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur bsgom du bcug la/ sems can kun la phan don phyir// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad na// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// rim pa bzhin du byin te rjes gnang ngo*// rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/

zhu ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha ai ṣa st+waṃ dha ra yā mi/ badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod de rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// de nas slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi snying gar chos gos kyi grwa nas 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin pas/ oṃ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bya// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa mchog tu grub bya'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas// kye che ge rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhūrbhū wa swaḥ zhes bya bas lung bstan nas/ gang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung bstan par byed pa de la/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad do// phyag rgya 'di nyid kyi mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so// zhes brjod par bya ste lung ston pa'o// de nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod kyi nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas nyan rang gi sa yid la byed kyi sems bcom par bsams te/ gsang ba brjod pa'o// de nas/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa yis// sdig pa kun las nges par grol// de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni// phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med// srid pa shin tu grub bya'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa// gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya// dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung*// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis// de yang nges par bsten mi bya// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams// nam yang dor bar mi bya ste// slob dpon smad par mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni// dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing*// ci bde bar ni bde bar zungs// 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas// da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kyang ni mthun par dgongs// sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// zhes pa'i don bshad de dbugs dbyung sbyin pa'o// rjes gnang la sogs pa lnga po 'di dag ni slob ma'i dbang tsam don du gnyer ba la cod paṇa gyi dbang lnga'i rjes sam/

skabs 'dir ram/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes la sbyar ba yang bshad do// de ltar phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim dang*/ mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de slob dpon gyi dbang ngam bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas slob mas rig ma dang maṇḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs sam/ e ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che// e ma chos dang tshogs kyi gtso// bdag la dam tshig de nyid stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bcing*/ bla mas rang gshin rje'i gshed dang*/ rig ma ro langs mar bskyed/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser brtan par byas pa de nyid srin lag dang mthe bong gis btsir te/ btung ba rin chen 'di de ni// lus kyi rdo rje rab gsal byed// bu khyod rtag tu shes nas kye// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung mdzod// ces dang*/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥs slob ma'i lce thog tu sbyin/ des kyang*/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod cing blangs nas myang la mgrin par mid do// shes rab kyis kyang rang gi padma la gnas pa'i thig le slob ma'i khar byin la/ sngar bzhin myangs bas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas rgyud gang zhing yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtogs pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la rgyas par bsgoms la/ gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ khyod kyis byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag

lam srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor dang rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas maṇḍal phul te/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yi// mgon la dbang ni bskur ba ltar// mgon pos bdag la'ang dbang bskur zhing*// bdag la'ang don mchog stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bcings te/ rig ma'i lag pa slob ma'i lag par gtad par bsams la/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di de ni// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin// de bas 'khor bar sbyor bral ni// khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces brjod la byin pa dang*/ de tsandan la sogs pas byug me tog gi phreng bas brgyan/ gos med par byas te padma rgyas par ston cig dri chen dri chu za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med gus mchog de bzhin du// bha ga padma tsumbha na// bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci// ji ltar bde bar bus smros shig /ces so// des kyang*/ dri chen dri chu sogs za ba// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// bud med rnams la rtag gus bya// bha ga nyid la tsambha ni// zhes lan btab pas mnyes te/ e ma nga yi padma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho ga bsten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa// padmar bya ba ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ zhes brjod par bsam/ de nas slob ma gshin rje'i gshed dang*/

phyag rgya ro langs mar bskyed/ rdo rje dang padma byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pas skad cig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa btsal te rdo rje dang padma snyoms par zhugs pas/ skad cig gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ rim gyis bsrubs pas byang chub sems kyi gsang gnas kyi bar gang ba khyad par gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ nor bu'i rtse mo'i mthar thug pa'i bar gang nas/ phyir ma 'dzag pa chags pa dang chags bral gyi mtha' spangs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes te/ de la ci nus su gnas par bya ba ste/ rnal 'byor pa yis ji srid du// byang sems 'byin par mi byed pa// de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi chad// dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci// dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa// byang chub sems ni ltung gyur na// phung po rnam shes brgyal ba la// ma smad dngos grub ga la yod// mkha' khams rdo rje kun sbyor dang*// reg byas kyang ni rmad byung che'i// bde ba skyed par byed pa gang*// de ni mchog dgar byed pa po// dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni// mtshon par ltos la bsten par gyis// padma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yi// lte bas mnan pa'i gnas dag tu// rdo rje'i skyil krung dag gi sems// nor bu'i nang du son bltas pas// ye shes skye ba gang yin de// ye shes ngo bo zhes pas brgyan// chags pa ma yin chags bral min// dbu mar dmigs pa ma yin no// gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong*// de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya// thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam// zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni// bskal pa bskal pa stong du yang*// ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya// zhes brjod la ye shes ngos bzung du bcug la/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi bstan nas/ lus thams cad bde bas khyab pa la sems gzung ngo*// de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol te/

phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag lam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas yon dang maṇḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcings sam ma bcings kyang rung ste/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su nyams su myong ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes des mtshon pa'i don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad na/ rgyud las/ de ltar bzhi pa de bzhin yang*// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su yum dang zhal sbyor gyi lha'i skur bsgoms pa de nyid goms pa'i stobs kyis/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal lha'i skur gnas gyur te/ rang dang snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can/ gsal la ma 'gags pa mngon du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku dang*/ dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su phyag rgya la brten pa'i bde ba de nyid rgyun goms pas sngar gyi bde ba las ches khyad par du 'phags pa/ 'dzag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po yang dag par rigs pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad bde ba chen po'i rnam par mngon du gyur pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su bde ba'i ngo bo stong par bsgoms pa'i don goms pa las gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang*/ thob bya 'bras bu dang*/ thob byed lam dang*/ lam de bsgoms pa'i sems la sogs pa'i rtog pa dang bral te/ khams bco brgyad dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes la sogs pa don dam par ma grub pa thams cad/ stong pa 'od gsal/

nam mkha' lta bu/ rtog pa thams cad bral ba mngon du gyur pa ni chos kyi sku dang*/ de gsum dbyer med zung 'jug tu 'dres nas/ lha sku bde ba dang bcas pa'i snang ba mi 'dor zhing*/ de dag gi ngo bo yang stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ chos rnams kyi yin lugs la zhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ 'bras bu'i dbang bzhi pa zhes bya ba yin no// de mngon du byed pa'i thabs ni/ lus mnyam gzhag gi spyod lam ldan zhing*/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems kyis lus yum dang bcas pa'i lha'i skur gsal ba dang*/ de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba dang*/ de dang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye 'jig 'gro 'ong*/ rtag chad/ 'khor 'das/ bde sdug la sogs pa gnyis snang thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/ de gsum dbyer med pa'i ngang las ma yengs par sems mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang*// rig pa de nyid ma 'gags pa// rang rig ye shes skad cig la// 'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa nyid// 'di las mtshon te shes par bya// 'di yi rang bzhin sku gsum dang*// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med// sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku// gzhan du btsal ba rnyed ma yin// zhes gsungs pas so// de nas gdong ras bcings pa bkrol/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam shin tu spros med dang*/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas/

zhes rtogs pa bskyed de dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas/ spro ba bskyed cing dam tshig bsrung bar bsgoms te/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na// sdig pa kun las rnam grol bar// de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di las ni// phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med// mi tshugs pa dang mi bcings pas// gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das// srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir// ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur// dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi mthun par gsung*// mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no// slob dpon smad par mi bya ste// bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya// de bzhin khros nas spun rnams la// nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o// sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems// nam yang nges par spang mi bya// byang chub sems ni dor mi bya// rang bzhin chos la mi smad do// yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya// bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya// chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung*// gdug la byams pa rtag tu spangs// chos la tshad gzung mi bya'o// dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya// rtag tu dam tshig bstan par bya// shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams// skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do// rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing*// rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya'o// rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas// rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bstan// gal te bla ma smad de bzhin// dam tshig bag med par gyur na// de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la// bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags// deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas// gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas// dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par// gnas par 'gyur ba the tshom med// sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pas// kun gyi tshe ldan de dbang bskur// khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che// rgyal srid bdag por brtan pa yin// de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal// grong khyer mchog tu rab zhugs so// de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid// thob pa 'di la the tshom med// 'di ltar yid ni rab dwangs rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster bsten par gyis// de ring 'gro la bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur// zhes brjod la don bshad de/

dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung mtshams phyed par bya'o// de nas slob mas/ gtso bos ci ltar bka' bsgo ba'i// gsung ni de ltar bdag gi bgyi// zhes dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar khas blangs so// 'byor na sbyin sreg yang bya zhing yon phul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo cho ga bzhin byas la/ slar yang dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gis mchod cing*/ bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs te bzod par gsol te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// zhes bya ba la sogs pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pas/ chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o// chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o// zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i rtses/ dbang ldan gyi rtsigs pa dang po bshig cing*/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams shar nas rim gyis bsdus la/ don du gnyer ba yod na cung zad sbyin/ tshon lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor nas/ sngar bshad pa'i sngags dang*/ skam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu phyung la/ phur khung 'o mas sgang zhing thig rjes dbyi ba sogs las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o// gshin rje mthar byed dkyil 'khor gyi// cho ga gzhung bzhin sbyar ba las// byung ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal bar shog /ces pa 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs pa chen po chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bstan pa dang chos smra ba rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs phyogs kun tu rgyas par mdzad pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ sbyin bdag chen po rgyal mtshan dpal ba'i gsung gis bskul ba dang blo gros kyi lus rgyas shing tshul khrims kyi nor gyis phyug pa slob dpon dpal ldan rin chen gyis 'phral du bskul ba la brten nas grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen no//

// ༄༅// shin tu spros pa med pa'i khrid yig gi zhal shes dang gsung sgros rnams bris pa'i spros med mdzes rgyan bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log pa thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/ man ngag gi tshul shes shing zang zing la ma chags pa/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ dad pa dang ldan zhing nyung ngu'i rnal 'byor la mos pa mchog gi dngos grub kho na don du gnyer ba'i slob ma dag yang dag pa'i lam la bkri bar 'dod pas/ thog mar mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gtam gyis/ 'khor ba la yid phyung nas de'i 'og tu thar pa dang mya ngan 'das pa'i phan yon gyi gtam gyis spro ba bskyed de/ gdod rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bkri bar bya'o// de la rgyud so so'i dgongs pas 'phags pa'i yul gyi slob dpon rnams kyis tshul mi 'dra ba mang po gsungs kyang*/ 'dir rtsod med kyi grub thob chen po dpal birwa pa'i zhal snga nas gdul bya skal ba dman pa/ rim gyis 'jug pa rnams bkri ba'i thabs ston pa gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i man ngag dang*/ gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa cig car du 'jug pa rnams bkri ba'i thabs ston pa shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag gi de kho na nyid de/ gnyis gsungs pa las/ 'dir cha phyi ma'i sgo nas khrid par byed pa la gnyis te/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ grol bar byed pa'i lam bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log pas bskur bar bya'o// 'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin zhing*/ rten 'brel thams cad 'di nas bsgrig pa'i phyir sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa gal che'o// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis/

bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag pa dang*/ 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba ltar skyabs su 'gro ba nas ye shes kyi tshogs kyi bar zhag mang po'i bar 'bad pas nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa la gsum/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ snang ba byin gyis brlab pa/ zung 'jug byin gyis brlab pa'o// dang po ni/ rim pa'am yang na cig car du// sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom bya ste// gong bur gnas pa'i bdag nyid kyi// lus 'di gshin rje'i gshed dmar po// 'di ni bem po ma yin la// sha dang khrag kyang de ma yin// bden min rdzun pa ma yin no// tha mal ma yin ye shes sku// dwangs shing gsal la rnyog pa med// phun tshogs yon tan kun gyi rten// 'di ni bdag la tha dad med// yang zhing bsnan du cung zad med// ma 'khrul bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// gdod nas grub pa'i shes bya ste// lus can kun gyi de mthong dang*// gang gis thos dang dran tsam gyis// bsam pa rdzogs mdzad zung 'jug sku// de ltar bdag gis gsal bar blta// zhes pa ltar nyams su blang ba la man ngag dgu ste/ sems 'jog pa dang*/ rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/ blan te 'jog pa dang*/ nye bar 'jog pa dang*/ dul bar byed pa dang*/ zhi bar byed pa dang*/ nye bar zhi bar byed pa dang*/ rtse gcig tu byed pa dang*/ shin tu mnyam par 'jog pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa rim gyis bskyed pa'am/ yang na cig car du dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor tshang bar byas la de la sems cung zad 'jog pa'o// de'ang las dang po pa la myur ba gnad du che'o gsung*/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'am/ ma bsdus kyang rung ste/ thog mar spyan dbu ma la sems bzung*/ de nas gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/

mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ 'phro bcad kyang rnam pa wal wal byung na bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas/ bum pa'am snam bu la sogs pa dngos po gzhan la shes pa yengs su bcug yang de bzhin bsgom zhing 'phro bcad/ dug dbyung*/ de ltar yang dang yang du goms par byas kyang dmigs pa gsal bar ma byung na/ thog mar rang gi spyan dbu ma spyan rtsa 'khro zhing dmar ba zhes brjod cing bsgom/ des kyang mi gsal na/ gzhan cig la brjod du bcug nas bsgom/ des kyang mi gsal na spyan dbus ma shin tu mdzes pa cig bris la de la blta zhing bsgom/ 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ba rnams bya/ gsum pa ni/ shes pa phyir 'phro na nga'i shes pa rgod por song snyam pa dran pas myur du blan te dmigs pa la blo 'jog pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ dmigs pa gcig gis sems skyo na dbu'i gtsug tor ram/ phyag mtshan nam/ zhal gyi mche ba lta bu la thun re tsam bsgoms la/ de nas sngar gyi de nyid bsgom mo// lnga pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin la yon tan dpag tu med pa yod par shes pa'i blos spyod lam thams cad du/ dmigs pa gsal ba med kyang lha'i rnam pa rtag tu dran pas sems 'dul ba'o// drug pa ni/ rnam rtog 'phro bas yid mi dga' na/ dmigs pa'i steng du sems klod de zhi bar bya'o// bdun pa ni/ mi dge ba'i sems skyes na/ dmigs pa la brtan pas zhi bar byed pa'o// brgyad pa ni/ sems phyir mi 'phro na de nyid kyi steng du rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa'o// dgu pa ni/ dmigs pa de dag brtan nas ched du ma bsgrubs par yang ting nge 'dzin 'byung ba yin no// de dag kyang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas// de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya// rnam g.yengs myur du rtogs byas nas// de la slar yang blan par bya// blo ldan gong nas gong du yang*// sems ni nang du bsdu bar bya// de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir// ting nge 'dzin la sems 'dul lo// rnam g.yengs nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir// de la mi dga' zhi bar bya// brnab sems yid mi bde la sogs// langs pa de bzhin zhi bar bya// de nas sdom brtson can gyi ni// sems la mngon par 'du byed bcas// rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba thob// de goms pa ni 'du mi byed// ces gsungs so// de ltar sems gnas pa'i thabs dgus sku'i phyogs gcig la sems brtan par zin pa dang*/

phyogs gzhan la dmigs pa spo bar bya ste/ de'ang thun dang po la spyan dbus ma/ gnyis pa la spyan gsum ka gsum pa la khro gnyer/ bzhi pa la shangs rnams bsgom/ de tsam mi gsal na thun bzhi ka la spyan gsum gsal btab pa'am/ nyi ma gsum la spyan gsum gsal btab pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms te/ mdor na spyan gsum gsal bar 'dod pa'am/ gsal ba med par 'dod na/ med pa'i bar du dmigs pa brtan par byas te 'og ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du bsgom mo// de nas nyi ma gnyis pa'i thun dang po la zhal gyi mche ba/ gnyis pa la spyan/ gsum pa la rtsa zhal/ bzhi pa la dbu skra rnams gsal btab/ de bzhin du phyag mtshan dang rgyan la sogs pa rnams thun re re zhing gsal bar bsgom/ gtso bo'i dmigs pa brtan pa dang*/ 'khor rnams kyang rim pa bzhin gsal btab/ mthar gzhal yas khang dang srung 'khor dang*/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad kyang rten dang brten pa'i rnal 'byor gsal btab bo// de ltar bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gsal bar gyur pa dang*/ de nyid la zhen pa spang ba'i phyir rang gi lus lha'i skur snang ba 'di 'byung ba dang*/ 'byung 'gyur gang du yang mi 'dug pas bem po ma yin/ de ma yin pas sha khrag gi lus ma yin zhing*/ de'i phyir phyi rol du bden par ma grub la/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis lha'i sku rdzun pa ma yin zhing*/ de ltar bden rdzun gyi spros pa dang bral bas/ dwangs shing gsal ba'i zung 'jug gi skur gsal bar dmigs la/ sems bzung yang de lta bu'i lha'i sku de nyid tha mal ma yin pas ye shes kyi sku/ gzhan ma yin pas bdag las tha dad med/ gdod ma nas grub pas tha mal spang du yang med/ ye shes log na btsal du med pas rang nyid yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin no// zhes bsgom zhing sems bzung*/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las// sa gsum 'od zer rab spros nas// mthong thos dran pa'i spyod yul du// ma lus lus pa med pa yi// brtan g.yo'i dngos po ji snyed pa// dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed dmar po// khams gsum min pa'i gzhal yas khang*// srog chags min 'di rgyal ba rnams// phung po khams dang skye mched min// khams rnams min 'di dkyil 'khor pa// zhes pa ltar nyams su blangs te/

rang bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khams gsum khyab pa'i 'od 'phros/ mthong thos dran pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas gdod ma nas grub pa de dag gsal bar byas te/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gsal bar bsgoms nas 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas yin pa la su zhig su la chags shing sdang*/ blang dor dang bde sdug dang skye 'chi sogs su la yod snyam du bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ me long la ni gzugs brnyan ltar// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin// rmi lam ci bzhin goms byas te// bar ma'i srid par rab sbyor ba'o// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob// zhes pa ltar nyams su blangs te/ bdag dang snod bcud thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba de yang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa srid pa bar do ltar gsal la thogs pa med pa/ de'ang ngo bo ma grub pa'i phyir bden pa ma yin zhing*/ gsal snang mi 'gag pa'i phyir/ rdzun pa ma yin pas gsal stong zung 'jug tu bsgom mo// de ltar bskyed rim gyi khrid ni rdzogs rim gyi rten yin pa'i phyir nges par sngon du 'gro dgos la/ gzhan dag bskyed rim rtogs pa'i bsgom yin pas 'dir ci zhig bya zhes 'chad pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad ma rig pa ste/ 'bras bu sku gnyis mngon du byed pa la rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag dgos la/ de la bskyed rim ni bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ bla ma glo bo lotstsha bas mdzad pa'i khrid yig thor bu nyid byin rlabs che zhing khungs btsun pa'i phyir bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas kyang de'i thog nas mdzad la/

der ma tshang ba'i gsung sgros gal che ba rnams bri bar bya'o// sngon 'gro'i skabs su sgrub pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu lnga bkod la/ de bde ba can nam 'og min chen po lta bu zhing khams rnam par dag pa rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen por bsgom/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang gi bdag nyid/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa na bzas mdzes par bklubs shing rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ sku gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par bzhag par bsgom/ mdun du dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa'i steng na sna tshogs padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dang dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa lha'i sku dpag tu med par bsgom/ g.yas su rin po che'i khri dang padma dang zla ba'i gdan du ma la sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ shākya thub pa la sogs pa sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgom/ rgyab tu rin po che'i khri lha'i gos sna tshogs kyis bkab pa'i steng na chos dkon mchog gi rang bzhin mdo sde rin po che la sogs pa posti glegs bam dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgom/ g.yon du rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i steng du dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgom/

de rnams la mos gus drag po byas nas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum thams cad maṇḍal tshom bu bdun par dmigs nas dbul ba sogs bya gsung*/ gsol ba btab pa'i skabs su/ spros med kyi ye shes rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang byung gi lhan cig skyes pa'i/ zung du 'jug pa'i/ rang rig gi bde stong gi mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa mdzod/ byin rlabs kyi skabs su bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar tshar bar byas nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar cho ga bzhin bya/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis maṇḍal dang sngon 'gro'i maṇḍal phul ba'i me tog rnams phul nas gsol ba gdab pa sogs bya'o// bla ma la sangs rgyas su yid ches bskyed pa'i skabs su/ 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ sems kyis gzhan ni mi bsam par// sems dpa' chen po mnyes par gyis// rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// dang po sku yi rdo rje ni// gzugs phung la ni rab tu bzhugs// rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje ni// tshor ba yi ni phung por bzhugs// bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni// 'du shes kyi ni phung por bzhugs// mchod pa kun gyi rdo rje ni// 'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs// bcom ldan thugs kyi rdo rje ni// rnam shes phung por yang dag bzhugs// 'di yi sha sogs sa khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum spyan ma bzhugs// khrag sogs chu yi khams la ni// bcom ldan 'das yum mā ma bzhugs// dro ba la sogs me khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum gos dkar bzhugs// spyod pa la sogs rlung khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum sgrol ma bzhugs// de yi mig gi dbang gnyis la// de bzhin gshegs pa sa snying po// de yi rna ba'i dbang gnyis la// bde gshegs phyag na rdo rje'o// de yi sna yi dbang gnyis la// de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' snying bzhugs// de yi lce yi dbang po la// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang*// khams bzhi'i rang bzhin gong bu ni// rang gi lus shes bya ming la// sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel// de bzhin gshegs pa 'dir bzhugs so// de yi yid gyi dbang po la// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs bzhugs// lus kyi tshigs ni thams cad la// de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang*// lus kyi rtsa rgyus thams cad la// de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa bzhugs// lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ni// de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje'i gshed// lag pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar ni// de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o// kha yi padma la bzhugs pa// de bzhin gshegs pa rta mgrin no// gsang ba'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil// dpung pa g.yas pa la bzhugs pa// de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo ba// dpung pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i rgyal// pus mo g.yas par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa dbyug sngon po// pus mo g.yon par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa stobs po che// rang gi spyi bor bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor lo sgyur// rkang pa'i mthil du bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa gnod mdzes te// lus 'di de nyid bzhugs pa ni// sku yi dkyil 'khor zhes brjod pa// rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi lus// sangs rgyas kun kyi sku rdzogs pa// 'di dag ma lus rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje legs byas bsten pa ni// mya ngan 'das la 'jug par 'gyur// bcom ldan mya ngan 'das myur thob// khyed kyis dge ba yongs su smin// de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi// lus la rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs// nyon cig mthong ba don yon gyis// phyi ma'i dus na sems dpa' che// dang po'i las kyi sems can gyis// rab tu 'bad de bla ma bsten// de tshe mthong ba don yod bcas// byang chub sems dpa' grags pa che// dga' zhing mgu la rab dwang bas// phyi rol nas ni mchi ma blag

/ces bshad pas/ phung po dang ni skye mched sogs gsung*/ bla ma la yid ches te/ sangs rgyas la dngos su mjal yang chos bstan nas thar pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa las/ thabs gzhan ni med la de ni bla mas bsgrub par nus pa'i phyir ro// gal te de gnyis mi 'dra ste sangs rgyas kyis chos bstan pas rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti lta bu skad cig la grol ba dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa la sogs pa byung ba/ bla mas ni chos bstan kyang de ltar mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ ma yin te/ ind+ra bhū ti sa bcu'i byang sems rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba la gsang sngags pa bstan pas skad cig la grol ba yin gyi/ so so skye bo phal pa la chos bstan pas grol ba ma yin te/ gsang ba'i sgron me'i rgyud las/ gsol pa/ rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti de/ sa du'i dbang phyug lags/ bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje ye shes kyi sku sa bcu pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku ste sa bcu'i dbang phyug go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na skye ba mang pos nas tshogs bsags shing 'dir yang brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i gang zag la ni bla mas chos bstan pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur te/ ti lo pas nā ro pa la byin rlabs tsam byas pas grol ba dang*/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la mchog thob pa'i slob ma gsum dang*/ bzod thob bdun byung ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod la/ tshogs ma bsags shing bag chags dang bral ba legs pa'i skar ma lta bu la ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad byon nas chos gsungs kyang grol bar mi 'gyur te/ chos dbyings bstod par/ ji ltar sa bon thams cad la// rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*// sa bon med pa'i 'bras yod pa// shes ldan gang gis bsgrub par nus// zhes gsungs so// 'o na sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang bla ma'i gsung khyad par med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ 'dod de/

ye shes thig le las/ bla ma ye shes bla ma ste// bla ma ston pa bla ma mgon// bla ma'i rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las// mchog gi gnas ni rnyed par 'gyur// tshe 'di yi ni phyag rgya che// dngos grub rnyed par the tshom med// sa bcu yi ni dbang phyug bdag /de yi bka' drin gyi ni bla// de bas bla ma las lhag gzhan// ston pa chen po ga la yod// gang gis bla mas bstan 'chos ni// mdzad dam bshad pa gang yin yang*// de ni bstan 'chos de tshad ma// de ni de nyid 'khrul pa med// slob dpon gsung dbang bdag gis smras// de la bye brag mi dbye'o// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud shes// bla mas mdzad pa'i bstan 'chos gang*// de la sgra dang sgra ngan du// lha yi dbang phyug rtag mi bya// snyan ngag zlos gar bstan 'chos la// sgra dang sgra ngan brtag bya yi// sngags kyi bstan 'chos gtan la dbab// ci yi phyir na brtag par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong na sogs gsung*/ spros pa bcad pa'i skabs su sha khrag gi lus 'khor 'das rnams la mchod par phul nas 'od kyi lus su gyur par bsam gsung*/ ye shes ngos gzung ba'i skabs su/ rnam rtog gi sems rang rig pa 'di smin mtshams kyi thad nas gyen du mda' gang tsam gyi sar yi ge hūm̐ sngon por gyur/ de nas hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de yang je phrar song nas rim gyis nam mkha'i mthar thug ste/ nam mkha' la thog mtha' med pa bzhin/ sems la thog mtha' med/ nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi tshugs pa bzhin/ sems glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'jigs/ nam mkha' snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa bzhin/ sems kyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab/ nam mkha' kha dog dang dbyibs la sogs pa dang bral ba bzhin/ sems gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i rnam rtog ma lus pas stong par bstan to// mdor na/

rang rig pa 'di nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar sogs bya/ de'i tshe bla mas rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ khyad par mthu stobs dbang phyug birwa pas// bdag gis slob ma rnams la byin brlabs nas// spros med ye shes da lta nyid du phob// ces brjod la rol mo drag tu bya/ hrīḥṣṭ+ṝḥshub bur bzlas/ gu gul bsreg pa rnams mdzad/ ngo sprod kyi skabs su/ de ltar bla ma'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i dbang bzhi pa'i don mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes cung zad rgyud la skyes pa des mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes/ tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad na/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ de ltar 'gro ba ma lus rang gi sems las byung ba ste/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems la ma brten par 'byung ba med la/ sems de'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ slob dpon sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas/ sems de'i ngo bo ci lta bu zhe na/ de ni rang rig pa tsam mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba dmigs su med pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ kun rdzob tu gsal zhing rig pa don dam par kha dog dang*/ dbyibs la sogs pa gang du yang ma grub pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ sems de ni rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba yin te/ de ni nang na'ang med/ phyi rol na'ang med/ gnyis kyi bar na yang mi gnas so// gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur te/ sngon po yang ma yin/ ser po yang ma yin/ dmar po ma yin/ dkar po ma yin/ le brgan du ma yin/ shel gyi kha dog tu ma yin/ thung ngur ma yin/ ring por ma yin/ zlum por ma yin/ gru bzhi ma yin/ snang bar ma yin/ mun par ma yin/ bud med du ma yin/ skyes par ma yin/ ma ning du ma yin/ gsang ba'i bdag po sems de ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin du ma yin/

gzugs kyi khams kyi rang bzhin du ma yin// gzugs med pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin du ma yin no zhes gsungs so// des na gsal ba de bor nas/ stong pa logs nas tshol ba ni ma yin te/ gsal ba nyid sems kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir ro// de bor nas gsal ba logs nas tshol ba'ang ma yin te/ stong pa de nyid sems kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro// na gsal ba'i dus nyid na stong*/ stong pa'i dus nyid na gsal bas/ gsal stong gnyis po dper na me dang tsha ba bzhin du/ gnyis su med pa'i brjod bral de nyid la spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes kyang bya ste/ lhan cig skyes grub las/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes par shes// zhes gsung zhing*/ de nyid thub pa'i gsung rab kyi brjod bya yin te/ mdo las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung thams cad ni/ de kho na nyid la gzhol/ de kho na nyid la 'bab/ de kho na nyid la mngon du phyogs zhes gsungs pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsung*// de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag /zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab skyed// ces gsungs pa dang*/ sambu ṭa las/ 'di ni gnyis su med par brjod// 'di ni byang chub sems mchog nyid// rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dpal// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub nyid// 'di nyid shes rab pha rol phyin// pha rol phyin pa kun gyi dngos// mnyam nyid bsam bya nyid du gsung*// sangs rgyas kun mchog bsgom pa nyid// ces gsungs pas ming gi rnam grangs bcu bzhi bstan pa yin te/ de yang lta ba stong pa nyid de nyid la gnyis su med pa zhes brjod de/ sambu ṭa las/ gnyis med gnyis ni rnam spangs pa'i// de nyid la ni ji bzhin ston// zhes bya ba dang*/ rim lnga las/ de ltar gang gnas rnal 'byor pa// zung 'jug rim la gnas pa ste// de nyid gnyis med ye shes te// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'ang min// zhes gsungs so// de nyid la byang chub kyi sems zhes brjod de/

brtag gnyis las/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems zhes rab tu brjod// ces gsung*/ de nyid la rdo rje zhes brjod de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// bcad dang gzhig par bya ba med// bsreg pa nges med 'jig med pa// stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer bshad// ces gsung*/ de nyid la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod de/ brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod// ces gsung*/ de nyid la dpal zhes brjod de// shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// zhes bya ba dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ theg pa chen por 'byung ba yi// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// zhes gsung*/ de nyid la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes brjod de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ de bzhin nyid ldan shin tu brtan// de kho na nyid gang rtogs nas// chos kun rtogs pa zhes bya gang*// de nyid rtogs pa sangs rgyas brjod// ces gsung*/ de nyid la byang chub zhes brjod de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs// zhes gsung*/ de nyid la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes brjod de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ nyan thos rang rgyal phyi rol gyi// shes rab las ni bla mar brjod// de bzhin nyid zhi pha rol phyin// shes rab pha rol phyin zhes bshad// ces gsung*/ de nyid la pha rol tu phyin pa kun gyi dngos zhes bya ste/ ma chags pas sbyin pa/ nyes pa med pas tshul khrims/ mi 'khrugs pas bzod pa/ mi gnas pas brtson 'grus/ mi g.yo bas bsam gtan/ ma rmongs pas shes rab ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// rnyog pa med cing mi gnas pa// mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la// spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsung*/ de nyid la mnyam pa nyid ces brjod de/ brgyad stong pa las/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do// zhes gsungs so// de nyid la bsam par bya ba zhes brjod de/

a bhi dha na las/ bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams nas// dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs// zhes gsungs so// de nyid la sangs rgyas kun dngos zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ ye shes sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /ces gsungs so// de nyid la mchog ces bya ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang sngags ye shes las byung ba// 'di ni de nyid ye shes mchog /ces gsungs so// de nyid la bsgom par bya ba ces brjod de/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ gzugs bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ ming bcu bzhis mtshon la/ de nyid la kye rdo rje dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshan du ma btags pa yin la/ de nyid thog ma med pa nas sgro skur gyi bag chags goms shing*/ nges don la rgyab kyis phyogs pa 'ga' zhig ni chad stong du 'dod la/ kha gcig ni 'gyur med kyi rtag brten du 'dod mod/ yod med du 'dzin pa ni spros pa'i mtha' yin pas/ lta ba mtha' bral du mi 'gyur la/ mu bzhi dang bral ba'i dbu ma zung 'jug gnyis med ces btags shing zhen na yang*/ phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba yin te/ 'phags pa lhas/ yod ces rtog pa ci snyed pa// de ni rtag pa'i lta ba ste// brtags par mngon par zhen pas na// de ni rgyu ma'i mtshan nyid min// med ces rtog pa ji snyed pa// de ni chad pa'i lta ba ste// chad par mngon par zhen pas na// de'ang sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid min// yod ces pa dang med ces pa'i// dbus su gang zhig rtogs pa na// dbus su mngon par zhen pas na// de'ang sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid min// zhes bshad do// mdor na da ltar gyi shes pa gang gis kyang ma bsgribs gang du yang ma grub pa de nyid ma 'gags pas rtsal gang du'ang 'char la/ rang rig pa'i ye shes skad cig ma de'i gnas lugs thog ma skye ba med/

dbus su gnas pa med/ mthar 'jig pa med/ skye 'jig gnas gsum gyi stong pa'i phyir srid pa 'khor ba med/ de med pa'i phyir 'khor ba pa zad pa'i myang 'das med/ 'jig pa thams cad bral ba'i phyir bdag gzhan med/ sdug bsngal gyi bdag nyid gyur pa'i rtog pa med pas na mchog tu bde ba chen po ste shes pa gsal stong ma 'gags par shar ba 'di nyid sku gsum ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gnas te/ sems stong pa mi rtog pa chos sku sogs gsung ngo*// rjes kyi bya ba'i skabs su/ sngon nor bzang gis bla ma kha cig rgyal po dang shan pa'i cha byad du mthong ba dang*/ drang srong skar ma la dga' bas/ sangs rgyas mu stegs kyi drang srong du mthong ba dang*/ slob dpon thogs med kyis byams pa spyi bor bzhag nas grong khyer ba rnams la bstan pas sus kyang ma mthong*/ rgan mo cung snang ba dag pas khyi mor mthong ba dang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag rdzir mthong ba dang*/ dzñā na pa'i bla ma/ zhes pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam dbyangs khyim btsun nyo tshong dang zhing las byed par mthong ba la zer ba 'dra gsungs/ nā ro pas/ te lo pas nya gson por bsregs pa la sogs mi 'tshams par byed pa'i smyon pa lta bur mthong ba dang*/ mai tri pas/ ri khrod dbang phyug ri dwags dang bya la sogs pa rngon par mthong*/ des na rang gi snang ba dag ma dag gi sangs rgyas la bzang ngan sna tshogs su mthong ste/ sangs rgyas nyi ma gdul bya yi// ri la ji ltar 'os par 'bab// ces gsungs pa ltar bstan pa yin sogs gsungs/ rgyun gyi nyams len gyi skabs su me tog sogs thun mong gi mchod pa gzugs sogs drug phyi'i mchod pa/ nang bdud rtsi/ gsang ba snyoms 'jug de kho na nyid ni mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa po rnams mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas mchod pa'o gsungs so// ye shes mngon du bya ba'i skabs su/
