lus skyil krung phal pa bya/ lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag la mthe bong lto sbyar/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mgrin pa cung zad dgu/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig bar snang la 'byed 'dzums med par bzhag la/ rlung ro rnams g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas dal bus dgu phrug gcig bus/ de nas ting nge 'dzin bskyed cing sbyang ba la lnga/ thog mar sems gzung ba/ bar du de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa/ mthar nyams skye tshul/ de dag gi gegs bsal ba/ bogs 'byin pa rnams so// dang po ni/ thung ngur bslab pa dang*/ ring du bslab pa gnyis/ de re re la'ang tshar bcad pa'i tshul du bslab pa dang*/ phan gdags pa'i tshul du bslab pa gnyis gnyis/ de la thung ngur bslab pa ni/ sna rtse nas sor bzhi tshun chod kyi nam mkha' la rang gi shes pa yod par dmigs te lus sems gnyis ka grims par byas te bsgoms te tshar bcad pa'i tshul du bslab pa'o// de nas lus sems gnyis ka glod la bsgom pa ni phan gdags pa'i tshul lo// yang sor brgyad tshun chad kyi nam mkha' la tshul de nyid kyis bslab/ yang sor bcu drug nas 'dom gang tshun chad kyi nam mkha' la'ang tshul de nyid kyis bslab/ sems gnas pa'i nyams ci byung de bzhin du bskyang*/ phal cher rang bzhin stong nyams su skye'o// de nas bogs dbyung ba'i phyir ring du bslab pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi sngon 'gro'i yan lag tshang bar byas te/ rang rig pa'i sems nyid shar phyogs su 'dom do la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ ji srid nam mkha'i mthar thug gi bar rtog tu btang*/ de'ang tshar bcad pa dang*/ phan gdags pa'i tshul gyis bslab pas mtha' bral gyi nyams/ shugs chad kyi nyams/ gzigs chad kyi nyams gsum gang skyes kyang de bzhin du bskyang ngo*// de bzhin du'ang bogs dbyung ba'i phyir lho la sogs pa'i phyogs thams cad du bslab bo// de ltar bslabs pas nyams gsum skye la/ de'i mtha' bral gyi nyams brtan nas/

de nas nam mkha' stong pa/ khyab pa brtag pa'i nyams te chos bzhi ldan du bskyed par 'gyur te/ de bzhin du bskyang ngo*// ring du bslab pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sngar byin brlab kyi skabs su bstan pa ltar/ de kho na nyid kyi don la blo bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ dang po rnam rtog gcig rting la gcig breng ma chad par 'jug pa'i shugs drag cing rnam pa gsal la/ shin tu myur bas blo rags pas tshad gzung mi nus pa skye ba mthong ste/ sngar nas rgyus yod med kyi yid mnyam par ma bzhag pas ma rig pa yin la/ da rig nas rnam rtog sngar bas mang du song 'dug sgom mi skye ba yin nam/ snyam pa 'byung ste/ de ni nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu dang 'dra ba ste/ dngul chu me dang 'phrad na 'phrad ma thag tu du bar byas 'bros pa dang 'dra'o// de'i dus su rlung nyams su res 'ga' rlung bzung ba bzhin du 'thums pa dang*/ res 'ga' rlung shugs ring nar nar ba 'byung*/ rlung nyams su ro stod khengs nas mi bde ba dang*/ lus gnad gcig la 'dug mi zug pa nad zug dang bcas pa 'byung ngo*// yang sngar gyi bzhin la rtog pa bcad cing mnyam par gzhag pas rnam rtog gcig rting la gcig che re rgyu 'phro la ci zhig ltar la ma tshor bar zhi mal song ba snyam yang byed/ yang de'i 'phro la rtog pa rgyu/ yang rgyu zhing skabs skabs su gnas pa snyam byed pa 'byung te de ni nyams gnyis pa rong khung dog mo'i chu dang 'dra ba yin/ nyams gzhan snga ma dang 'dra'o// dper na dngul chu 'ching byed kyi rdzas cung zad kyis bcings pa de me dang phrad na tseg tseg ces pa'i sgra 'byin cing 'bros pa lta bu'o// de nas de'i rgyun la mnyam par bzhag cing bsgoms pas ci zhig ltar la rnam rtog gi rgyu 'phro chad nas/ hab khri bo sdug pa ltar lhan tshom gyis mi rtog pa la 'gro zhing*/ de la'ang rig pa'i ngar bton zhing bsgoms pas de'i rmugs shing blong pa'i cha de bsal nas/

skabs skabs su shes pa dang cha dang bcas pa'i mnyam gzhag tu 'gyu ba med kyang skabs rer rnam rtog thol thol skye ste/ nyams gsum pa phu gsum gyi rdzing chu dang 'dra'o// bcings pa'i dngul chu sbal pa mchong ba bzhin du mchongs te 'bros pa dang 'dra'o// de'i dus su rlung nyams res rlung rnal du gnas/ res rlung rgyu ba zhi gnas la gnod pa snyam byed pa 'byung*/ lus nyams lus gnad la sogs la mi bde ba med par nyal gyis 'gro/ ro stod mgo bo cung zad lci zhing khengs pa 'byung ngo*// de nas sngar gyi rgyun la mnyam par gzhag pas rnam rtog gi 'jug pa phal cher nyal gyis song nas rtse gcig tu nyal gyis gnas pa 'byung ngo*// de'i ngang nas rnam rtog thol thol skyes kyang gnyis mthud gsum mthud tsam byung na/ de nyid kyi ngang du zhi bar 'gyur te/ de ni mtsho chu rlung gi bskyod pa lta bu'i nyams zhes bya ste/ bcings pa'i dngul chu me dang 'phrad na 'dar ba lta bu'o// de'i tshe rlung rgyu ba mi tshor/ tshor yang mnyam gzhag la gnod pa 'byung la/ lus nyams mnyam gzhag tu lus po yod par mi tshor/ tshor yang mnyam gzhag la mi gnod/ de las langs pa'i rjes thob tu lus kyi mi bde ba la sogs pa thams cad nyal gyis zhi'o// ma zhi yang cung bde ru song ba 'byung*/ yang sngar gyi rgyun la mnyam par bzhag nas bsgoms pas zhi gnas su mer song ste/ g.yengs pa'i rtog pa zhi ba'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung*/ de la sngon gyi 'phen pa'am/ 'phral gyi rkyen gzhan gyis sad par byas la/ mi rtog pa rnam rtog mi rgyu bar gnas pa zhig 'byung ste/ de ni mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu'i nyams zhes bya/ bcings pa'i dngul chu me dang 'phrad kyang mi 'dar ba lta bu'o// de'i dus su rlung nyams rlung rgyu ba brtags na tshor/ ma brtags na mi tshor ba dang*/ brtags kyang mi tshor ba 'byung*/ lus kyi nyams brtags na tshor ma brtags na mi tshor ba dang*/

brtags kyang mi tshor ba 'byung la/ de'i rjes thob tu lus kyi mi bde ba dang*/ na tsha thams cad nyams kyis 'gro'o// de ltar sems kyi nyams lnga po de la rnam rtog ngos zin gyi nyams/ rnam rtog ngal bso'i nyams rnam rtog thang chad kyi nyams/ rnam rtog gi rlabs dang bcas pa'i nyams/ rnam rtog zhi ba'i nyams zhes gsungs la/ zhi byed brgyu pa phyi ma dag g.yo ba dang*/ thob pa dang*/ goms pa dang*/ brtan pa dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i nyams zhes zer ro// de lta bu'i zhi gnas de la rnam rtog gi 'jug pa/ zhi gnas rtse gcig tu me re gnas kyang*/ rig pa'i rang gdangs ma shar ba/ shes pa'i dwangs cha ma rnyed pa de zhi gnas so// zhes bya ba don la rnam rtog kha 'khyams pa'i zhi gnas yin gyi/ mi rtog par lhag gis ma song ba yin no// mi rtog par lhag gis song ba la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i shes pa'i rang gdangs shar ba'i mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa ltar sal le rtse gcig tu gnas pa de thun gcig la sogs pa byung na'ang nyams kyi gsal snang mi 'char mi srid pas/ de ni nyams sna tshogs su skye ba'i zhi gnas zhes bya ste/ de 'dra zhig med kha med yin no// de ltar gnas cha ci rigs pa thob nas/ dngos gzhi de kho na nyid kyi don la blo bzhag pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma sna tshogs pa dang*/ nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ste/ gsung ngag rin po che las/ sa chu la thim na smig rgyu/ chu me la thim na du ba/ me rlung la thim na srin bu me khyer/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim na mar me 'bar ba/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim na nam mkha' sprin med lta bu/ sa chu me rlung dang rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na khams gsum kun du me lta bur snang ngo*// zhes dang*/ grub thob nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis/ sa chu la thim pa las smig rgyu'i rnam pa'o// chu me la thim pas du ba'i rnam pa'o// me rlung la thim pa las mkha' snang gi rnam pa'o// phra mo'i khams kyi snang ba gsum nam mkha' la sgron me dang 'dra bar snang ba'i phung po chos nyid kyi phyir sgron me'i rnam pa'o// rang bzhin gyi snang ba nub pa la sprin med pa'i nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i rtag tu snang ba'i ngo bo nyid ni sprin med pa'i nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

g.yas g.yon gyi rlung rnams dbu mar thim pas/ mthong snang dang nyams brjod kyis mi long skye bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rtags de rnams snga ma snga ma mthong ba la ma brtags par de kho na nyid la rtse gcig tu blo bzhag pas/ rim gyis snga ma snga ma dwangs shing gnas 'gyur te/ phyi ma phyi ma'i nyams rnams 'byung la/ de dag la dgag sgrub mi bya zhing*/ blo ma yengs par byas pas ci yang ma mthong ba'i tshul gyis de kho na nyid mthong bar 'gyur te/ shānti de bas/ zab mo'i chos mthong rmi lam ngan pa dang*// mun pa'i lam na ci yang mthong ba med// gal te nam mkha'i rtse mor me tog rgyas// shāntis smras pa de tsho 'khrul ba chad// ces dang*/ sa ra has/ rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil shar bhu su ku// stong pa'i gzugs 'dzin ltos shig bhu su ku// dpe med me tog rgyas so bhu su ku// rin chen rin thang med pa'i me tog long*// me tog 'di ni kha dog sna tshogs can// me tog 'di ni stong nyid dgon par skyes// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi gegs bying rgod gnyis bsal te/ de la ched du byas pa'i bying rgod/ rkyen gyis byung ba'i bying rgod/ rang shugs kyis byung ba'i bying rgod bsal ba'o// de la ched du byas pa'i bying ba ni/ mal stan la sogs pa bsod nams don du gnyer ba las byung ba'o// ched du byas pa'i rgod pa ni kha smras la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i bya ba don du gnyer ba las byung ba'o// de bsal ba ni ngo shes par bya ste zhag grangs ci rigs par de dag spang ba nyid kyis sel bar 'gyur ro// rkyen gyis bying ba ni/ ha cang zas bcud ches pa dang*/ chang mang ba dang*/ ngal dub la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis bying ba'o// rkyen gyis rgod pa ni/ nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu 'grul gyis ma dben pa dang*/ mtshan mo dgra'i glags cor kyis ma dben pa la sogs pas rgod pa'o// de dag bsal ba la yang rkyen de dag zhag grangs ci rigs par spang ba nyid kyis sel lo// rang shugs kyis byung ba'i bying ba dang rgod pa ni snga ma gnyis po de dag bsal yang rang shugs kyis byung ba'o// de yang thun stod la byung ngam thun smad la byung brtags la/

thun smad la byung na khams kyi skyon yin pas thun bstung ba nyid kyis rang sel lo// thun stod la byung na bsam gtan gyi gegs yin pas/ de bsal ba ni/ spyir gsum ste/ spyod lam gyis bsal/ kha zas kyis bsal/ sems kyi mthus bsal ba'o// de la spyod lam gyis bsal ba ni/ stan mtho sar bsdad/ des ma bsal na sa mtho sar bsdad/ mig ri thang mtshams su blta/ lus sems hur phyung la bya'o// rgod pa bsal ba ni/ sa dma' sar bsdad/ cung zad kos kos brang non par bya/ mun pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa la bsdad do// kha zas kyis bying ba bsal ba ni/ gong bsam gtan gyi sngon rol gyi kha zas bcag pa'o// rgod pa bsal ba ni/ bsam gtan la 'jug kha zas dang bcas pa'i chang snod che chung ci rigs pa btang*/ gom pa lnga bcur bcag des ma zhi na do btang*/ gom pa brgyar bcag de yang spyir nad gzhi dang sbyar/ na tshod dang sbyar/ nam zla dang sbyar ro// des nges par rgod pa dang bying ba sel lo// gsum pa sems kyi nus mthus bsal ba ni/ bying ba'i tshe steng du byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la bslab/ slar yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gnas su bslabs te/ de ni thog mar rang gi snying gar dran par bya/ de nas smin mtshams su/ de nas tshangs pa'i bu gar/ de nas spyi bo'i steng du sor bzhi la sogs pa nas mthar steng gi nam mkha'i mthar thug bar gtang*/ de ltar sems tshod bzung zhing bsgoms la/ yun ring na shes pa mi bde zhing*/ snying rlung la sogs par 'gyur bas slar mas rim gyis phab la snying gar dran par byas la gzhag go /rgod pa'i tshe na 'og tu byang chub kyi sems e las chos kyi 'byung gnas su bslab/ slar yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gnas su bslabs so// de ni bshang lam du chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba gcig bsams la/ de'i nang na mar sems kyis lta/ 'jog tsam na slar yang snying gar dran par bya'o// des kyang rgod pa ma zhi na 'phrang du bzung*/

rjes su 'brang*/ yongs su shes pas bsal lo// de la 'phrang du bzung ba ni lan gcig 'phros/ lan gnyis 'phros/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyis rgod pa'i grangs bzung bas 'phral du sel/ rjes su 'brang ba ni yul gang la 'phro ba'i yul de nyid la ched du gtad cing dmigs te/ des 'phral du sel/ yongs su shes pa ni/ rgod nas 'dug bya bar shes pa tsam gyi sel gsung*/ de dag gi ma zhi na mnan sbyor/ dpyang thag 'phrang gzhur zhes bya bas kyang sel lo// de la mnan sbyor ni/ rang gi spyi bor shing bu lji yang ran pa gcig gis mnan/ des 'phral du sel/ dpyang thag ni/ sa gzhi bstar zhing 'thas par byas la/ steng du thag pa gnyis kyis shing stegs gcig btags te/ de'i steng du rang gi rkang pa'i 'og tu rgyangs nas 'dug pas shing bu ril bu non par bya/ lag pa gnyis mdun gyi dpyang thag la 'ju ba'i sbyor ba bya ba'i man ngag go /'phrang gzhur ni/ g.yas g.yon gang rung gcig tu shing khru gang ba gcig gam/ tho gcig btsugs la/ de'i steng du rdo la sogs pa dkar po gcig bzhag la/ de'i yang steng du nag po gcig bzhag la/ de dag la smyug ma la sogs pas gzhur te mig mi 'dzums par byas la blta/ des kyang 'phral du sel gsung*/ yang gegs kha cig log non rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas bsal te/ 'khor lo ltar bskor ba/ gru gu ltar 'dril ba/ bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba/ steng 'og gi 'khor lo med pa la bslab pa/ rab tu dmar ba'i sbyor ba la bslab pa'o// dang po ni lus khengs pa snyam byed/ lus sbyin pa la sogs pa byung na/ lte ba'i gnas su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po gcig bsams la/ 'khor lo de dang po g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom/ des ma bde na g.yon du 'khor bar bsgom/ de ltar 'khor bas je che je cher song bas lus kyang cher song bar bsgom/ des shin tu cher song ba snyam byed na 'khor lo blos btang la/ lus nang stong yed yed nam mkha' la dengs shing yal te/

des 'phral du skyon las grol lo// gnyis pa ni/ snying ga la sogs pa dmigs kyi na ba byung na/ gang na ba de nyid du bu ga cig seng gis byung bar bsams la/ de nas dbugs phyir drag tu gtong zhing sems kyi rlung kha dog sngon po sbom phra rta rnga tsam cig thon nas phyi rol du dru bu ltar hri li li 'dril bar bsam/ de nas cung zhig dmigs pa de blos dor/ de nas yang bu ga dor zhing rlung yang sngar bas sbom du song bar dmigs te sngar bzhin du 'dril bar bsam/ des 'phral du skyon las grol lo// gsum pa ni/ lus thams cad khyab par na na/ lus thams cad la tshags se'i mig bzhin du bu ga mang po byung ste de dag thams cad nas rlung phyir sngo bun bun 'gro bar bsams shing*/ dbugs phyir drag tu bus la gtang*/ 'phral du skyon sel/ khams la cung zhig nod gsung*/ bzhi pa ni/ lus kyi stod du na zhing mi bde na mgrin pa yan chad har thad du stong par bsams la/ de nas yar rlung sngo bun bun 'gro bar bsam zhing*/ dbugs phyir drag tu gtang*/ lus kyi smad du na zhing mi bde na smad nyid har thad du stong par bsams la/ de nas mar rlung thur la sngo bun bun 'gro bar bsgom/ de dag gis 'phral du skyon las grol lo// lnga pa mchongs rgyug la sogs mi mtshams pa du ma byung na/ rang gi 'dug sa'i 'og de dong lta bu shin tu dma' bar bsams te/ de na mar rang gi lus bying bar bsam/ des mi sel mi srid gsung*/ lnga pa ni/ bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung ste/ sgrim klod gnyis res 'jog dbri bskyed gnyis res 'jog ste bzhi/ kha zas res 'jog spyod lam bag yangs sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bstan pa ste rnam pa brgyad kyis sems nyams dang sbyar te bogs dbyung ngo*// dang po bzhi ni/ lus sems gnyis ka sgrim pa dang thun dbri bar sbyar/

klod pa dang bskyed pa sbyar la/ dang por thun res 'jog tu bya/ de nas nyi ma res 'jog tu bya/ kha zas res 'jog kyis thun dang nyi ma gnyis ka la chang la sogs pa res 'jog tu bya'o// spyod lam bag yangs go sla/ sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba ni/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde la sogs pa rnams las bsgom byar gsungs pa thams cad la rim gyis bsgoms pas bogs dbyung bar gyur pa'o// yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa ni/ gzugs sdug pa la sogs pa rnams la longs spyad pas rgyud tshim par 'gyur la/ de'i stobs kyis rtogs pa bogs dbyung bar 'gyur ro// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bsgoms pas sems nyams kyi drod rtags 'byung ba ni/ thog mar sems gnas/ don gyi de kho na nyid la nges shes skye/ cung zad le lo che/ bya ba gang la'ang 'jug snying mi 'dod/ brjed ngas che/ bya ba thams cad la thug 'phrad tsam byed/ skabs skabs su dran pa gsal po khyad par can 'byung*/ kha zas la 'dod pa chung*/ gnyid rim gyis spong bar nus/ nyon mongs pa glo bur ba drag po ldog chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa'i blo rags rim ldog rmi lam mngon shes dang 'dra bar gsal po 'byung*/ phyi dang nang gi srin bu rim gyis spong nus/ de tsam na ngan song du mi 'gro ba'i gdeng thob bo gsung*/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi skabs su rtog pa bu ga dgu'i nang du bcug nas/ rang gi rnam rtog gi zug rngu thim pas de mar me'i rtse mo lta bu sogs gsung*/ bde ba can du phyin nas/ der/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ 'khor 'das rnams la yang mchod pa 'bul/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ 'di gcig pus skyon thams cad sel zhing yon tan thams cad bskyed pa yin zhes gsungs pa'i don gnas skabs su bla ma la brten nas phrin las 'grub ste/ zhi ba'i dngos grub 'dod na/ bla ma rnam par snang mdzad du bsgoms te/

'khor sa'i snying po la sogs pa dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams nas gsol ba btab na/ nad zhi ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub thob/ bla ma mi bskyod pa la/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje dang*/ dpal mgon po dang lha mo la sogs pas bskor bar bsams te/ gsol ba btab na dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa la sogs pa drag po'i dngos grub thob/ bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang*/ ku ru kulle la sogs pas bskor bar bsams te/ gsol ba btab na nor la sogs pa dbang du 'du/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ rnam sras dang*/ 'phags pa dzambha la dang*/ lha mo nor rgyun ma dang*/ gnod sbyin a pa ra dzi ta dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pas bskor bar bsams te gsol ba btab na/ dpal dang grags pa dang 'byor pa la sogs pa thams cad rgyas par 'gyur ro// bla ma don yod grub pa la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yod dang*/ rdo rje rnam 'joms dang*/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sogs pas bskor bar bsams nas gsol ba btab na/ phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// de dag la bla ma phrin las gang sgrub kyi 'od zer gyi rnam par byas nas rang la bstim pa ni man ngag go gsung*/ yang gnas skabs su/ ting nge 'dzin don du gnyer bar 'dod pas/ seng ge'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bla ma mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa skyil krung dang mnyam gzhag gis bzhugs pa/ ting nge 'dzin sgo du ma'i nang du bzhugs shing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rang nyid nyams nga zhing bag tsha na/ seng ges bteg pa'i gdan la/ bla ma shin tu dpa' ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par lta/ shes pa rmugs na 'od zer sna tshogs 'khrugs pa'i gdan bsam/ shes pa bying na gcan gzan sna tshogs kyi gdan la/ sku bzhengs shing gcer bu skra brdzes pa zhal 'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i mdangs can/

spyan bar snang du g.yo ba'i gzigs stangs can/ phyag gis brda sna tshogs mdzad cing gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur ba/ zhabs sa la rdebs shing brkyang bskum sna tshogs su mdzad pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing nam mkha' la drag tu 'phar ba/ thugs ka'i 'od zer sems can thams cad la phog pas de dag gi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ zhal nas ha ha dang hi hi'i sgra drag tu sgrogs par bsam/ shes pa rgod cing g.yengs na/ gter chen po'i bum pa dang nyi ma'i gdan la skyil krung 'khyil bas bzhugs shing*/ na bza' sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ phyag mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can la rdo rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa/ sku che zhing ri rab ltar brtan pa/ bkrag dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par bsam/ shes pa gtad sar mi gnas na/ dung gis chu srin nam/ thog gis dngos po 'bigs pa ltar bla mas rang gi lus phar thal tshur thal phug par bsgom/ rang ngam gzhan gyi bar chad sel bar 'dod na/ gang gnod sar sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ bla ma sku mdog nag cing dbu skra brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub me 'bar ba/ gnod byed gang yin pa la gtad par bsam/ 'byung ba 'khrugs nas sa stobs 'phel ba'i nad la rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rlung gi rang bzhin gyi bla ma nag po yang zhing g.yo bar bsam/ chu stobs 'phel ba'i nad la me'i rang bzhin gyi bla ma dmar po tsha bas bsreg par bsam/ me stobs 'phel ba'i nad la/ chu'i rang bzhin gyi bla ma dkar po bsil bas grang bar bsgom/ rlung stobs 'phel ba'i nad la/ sa'i rang bzhin gyi bla ma ser po lci bas mnan par bsgom/ de bzhin du yul dus rang bzhin nges med du/ bla ma bar gcod gang byung ba'i gnyen por bsgom gsung*/ mnyam med snying rje'i skabs su/ snying rje thod rgal dang rim gyis pa gnyis las 'di gong ma yin pas/ thog mar dgra la bsgom pa yin gsung*/ 'thad pa bsgom pa gsum pa'i skabs su/

dgra 'di bdag gi ma yin kyang*/ nga rang gi las 'di ma dag pas/ kho yi shes pa la rang dbang ma thob pas/ smyon pa dang 'dra bar spyir sems can sogs gsung*/ 'dir theg chen gyi rtsa ba snying rje yin tshul/ de bsgoms pa'i phan yon/ ma bsgoms pa'i skyon rnams lung mang po dang sbyar te gsung mod/ mang bas ma bris so// srog rtsol gyi skabs su/ bi shwa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngon 'gro stong ra zhag bdun bsgom pa ste/ phyi lus kyi dbyibs yi dam la/ nang phru ma phus btab pa ltar bsgoms te/ 'di rlung chud che ba'i rten 'brel yin gsung*/ ha gsum zhes pas na kha nas ha/ zhes dal la ring bar 'don pa lan gsum/ hūm̐ gsum zhes pas sna nas rlung g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas 'bud pa'o// bsrub cing bsrubs pa la 'og rlung mi 'then/ 'di dang gyen du 'dren pa/ 'og tu brdeg pa rnams la/ 'phongs stan las mi bskyod/ yan lag brkyang bskum gyi rkang pa sprug pa'i tshe/ rkang sor rnams bskum nas sprug gsung*/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ 'di'i sbyor ba bla mas ston zhes pa ni/ mar srang bdun/ bu ram srang bdun/ sga leb dgu/ sbrang srang gsum/ lug mkhur ma/ ba ru ra/ gser mu zi srang gang*/ sha dang sngo dad la sogs ma zos pa'i bzhi mnyam zhag gsum gyis bsags pa dug bton nas/ rdo leb gtsang ma'i khar brdal la/ dar dmar pos ma reg par bkab la/ skam pa dang zhib tu btags la/ sbrang dang bu ram dang mngar gsum gyis mgo bsdus la/ ril bu sha ba'am lug gi ril ma tsam byas la/ rkyal pa sabs med par blugs te sa la ma reg par mdun gyi bar snang la gdags/ rang smra ba bcad la yig 'bru gsum gyis sgrub pa zhag bdun bya'o// snga dro'i cha la bdun bdun bsten pas dmigs pa gsal/ khams rgyas/ spros med kyi ting nge 'dzin skye'o// dug 'don pa ni/ rdza ma'i snod gtsang mar bzhi mnyam dro bar blugs nas legs par gnur nas dwangs su gzhug

de nas khu ba bzhur la dbo/ yang gla rtsi blug cing dwangs pa dang dbo'o// de 'dra ba lan gsum byas pas dug bton la de nas skom mo gsungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skabs su/ rdo rje stong pa nyid dang 'jigs byed sdug bsngal thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste/ de gnyis zung du sbyor ba byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad rgyal ba yab yum gyi tshogs yin la/ de dag zhu bde'i mchod pas mnyes par byas te/ de'i tshul yang*/ lus rnam snang gi chos drug dang ldan pas steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung 'then/ de nas steng gi kun rdzob kyi sna rtse nas gyen du sor bzhi 'jal ba'i sa smin mtshams nas kha dog lnga'i 'od can gyi rlung byung nas rtsa dbu ma'i nang du zhugs par bsam/ rlung de spyi bo nas rdo rje nor bu'i bar gyi dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang bar bsam zhing*/ srog 'dzin rlung dal bus thub tshad du bzung*/ mi thub pa na rim gyis btang*/ de ltar goms pas 'khor lo lnga'i steng ma drug pa spyi gtsug gi haṃ la byang sems zin pa yin no// de ltar rlung la dbang thob cing byang sems zin pa des 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i phyir yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya sprul nas/ der lhan cig snyoms par zhugs par mos la/ rang gis phyag g.yon pas rdo rje gzung bar bya zhing*/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil dang rdo rje'i bug pa ste/ rtse mo dang sbyar zhing cung zad spyod pas dbab nas/ dga' ba bzhis nyams dran par byas la nor bu'i rtse mor slebs pa dang*/ mig gyen du bltas pas/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas shing thig le bzlog par bya'o// gcig shos byang sems nor bu'i phyir g.yo bar mi bya ste/ kunda ba thag tsam phyir mi 'byung ngo*// gal te phyi rol du lhung bar gyur na/

de'i tshe ḍā ki rnams kyis tshar gcad do// phan yon ni 'og rlung bsdams pas 'og gdon gyi dgra tshogs gzhi/ steng rlung mnan pas sna tshogs kyi bdud las rgyas/ dbus rlung sprugs pas thig le'i bar chad rnams sel lo// gzhan yang rnal 'byor 'di la nan tan byed pa'i sgrub pa pos du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang*/ lha'i mig la sogs pa'i mngon shes lnga thob cing*/ rnal 'byor de goms pa'i stobs kyis/ ma dag pa'i rtog pa'i drwa ba thams cad gcod cing spros med kyi go 'phang chos nyid bden pa mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ro// 'di ni glo bo lotstsha ba nas brgyud pa'i zhal shes chad nas/ spros med ston pa'i bla ma dang*/ bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang*/ yi ger bris pa'i zin bris sogs gang na'ang 'dug pa ma mthong zhing*/ thar pa lotstsha ba'i man ngag yin zer nas/ 'khrul 'khor du ma byas pa'i lag len dang*/ lam 'bras nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje chu 'thung gi sbyor ba sogs blangs nas 'chad pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang mi mthun pas rang bzor nges la/ man ngag 'di ni bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas/ gsang 'dus kyi rmi lam la thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe/ so ba na tha'i byang ngos kyi brag ri zhig gi dbus na/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bzhugs pa gzigs nas/ de la zhus pas gsung ngag rin po che'i zhal shes du ma dang bcas pa gnang ba'i man ngag bdag gis ma sbas par bris pa'o// lam gyi tho bsgrig pa'i skabs su/ dad pa chung na byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ snying rje chung na mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ zhe sdang che na rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor/ rnam rtog mang na srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor/ kha zas la sred pa che na rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor/ 'dod chags che na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o gsungs/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i sbyin sreg ni/

sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir dur ga ti 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga tshang bar bya/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya brgya phul nas til sngags dang bcas pa khri phrag gcig dbul/ de bzhin du thams cad 'gre gsungs/ snying rje dang byang sems gnyis/ bum dbang gi lam yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ spyir rgyud sde rnams nas bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim yin par bshad la/ de dang snying rje sogs khyad med pa yin te/ bskyed rim gyis snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang lhar bsgom pa dang*/ snying rjes sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig pa ltar bsam pa dang*/ byang sems kyis bdag gzhan brje ba rnams don la khyad par med pas so gsung*/ bar chad bsal ba'i skabs su/ rang gi lus kyis stong gsum thams cad khyab par dmigs nas gnod byed rnams la gang 'dod pa ster ba ste/ 'dir bdud rtsi byin rlabs sogs mi byed pa gnad yin gsung*/ bla ma'i man ngag bdun la sogs pa zhes khrid dpe thams cad la snang yang*/ bdud yin gyi/ bdud ma yin/ 'dir rnal 'byor bzhi nas bshad pa'i 'pho ba yang skabs kha cig tu gsung mod/ rgyun du mi gsung bas ma bris/ spros med kyi 'pho ba ni/ 'chi ltas brtags pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'chi mi 'chi nges par byas la/ nges par thob pa dang*/ longs spyod thams cad sbyin pa btang nas/ sngar nyams len dngos gzhi'i skabs su bstan pa ltar/ lus 'khor 'das rnams la mchod pa phul/ sems nam mkha' dang bsres pa'i ngang nas 'da' ba ste/ 'di ni 'pho ba rnams kyi mchog yin gsung*/ zhes pa 'di yang mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung bzhin gsal bar bris shig ces/ sde snod 'dzin pa chos rgyal dpal bzang gis// yang yang bskul nas kun mkhyen bla ma de'i// gsung las skyes pa rgyud gsum pa yis bris// 'di yi dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// rab zab lam bzang 'di dang phrad par shog/

// ༄༅// rgyud gsum lam gyi rim pa'i bsdus don bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum lam gyi rim pa la gsum ste/ lam rim la 'jug pa'i yan lag yan lag can gyi lam rim/ lam rim mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/

dpal ldan/ mod bshad par dam bca' 'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi rgyud sbyang ba/ sbyangs nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim dngos la 'jug pa'o// dang po la gsum/ spang bya 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ brten bya lam gyi rim pa bsgom pa/ de dag gi mjug bsdu pha rol ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ sdug bsngal gzhan bsam pa/ ngan pa'i grogs spang ba dben bstan pa'o// dang po gnyis/ sdug duḥkha bsngal gyi ngo bo/ de'i rgyu spang bar mi dge ba bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la mtho ris gnyis/ mtho ris mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ 'gyur ba'i dang po sdug bsngal bsam pa/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gnyis pa bsam pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ sbyor ba skyabs dkon mchog su 'gro ba'i rim pa/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i rim pa/ rjes thun mtshams su bya ba'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan bsgom pa/ don dam byang chub kyi sems don dam bsgom pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ mi rtag pa de ltar bsgom pa/ tshogs bsag byang chub pa'o// gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim dngos la gsum/ lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten tshul/ bsten nas lam gyi rim pas blo sbyang ba/ sbyangs pa'i lam gyi 'bras bu'o/ rdo rje/ /dang po la gsum/ gang gis bsten pa de dag slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ gang bsten pa bla ma'i rang bzhin/ bla ma/ de'i des de ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la gsum/ dbang gis smin par bya ba/ smin nas rgyud sbyang ba/ sbyangs nas lam bsgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ cho ga rdzogs dkyil 'khor pa smin byed rnam dag tu bstan pa/ de las gzhan byin rlabs pa smin byed du mi rung bar bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/

bsrung bya de nas dam tshig gis rgyud sbyang ba/ bsten bya bzlas de ltar brjod kyi rgyud sbyang pa'o// gsum pa la bzhi/ dngos po thams cad la zhen pa spang ba lta ba'i khrid/ rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor/ rim gnyis la gnas pas drod thob nas spyod pa bya tshul/ spyod pa la sa rnams gnas pas nye rgyu bsgom tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ de nas snang ba sems su/ sems sems de sgyu mar/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ rten 'brel sgyu ma du dang*/ brjod brjod bral du bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ rim gnyis de nas spyi'i rnal 'byor/ so so'i rnal 'byor/ 'di la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bskyed pa'i bstan// rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ las dang po pas dang po bsgom bya'i bskyed rim/ brtan pa thob pas bsgom gnyis pas bya'i bskyed rim mo// gnyis pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro sgo gsum sbyong ba/ rdzogs/ dngos gzhi'i lam sbyang ba/ rjes lta ba bskyang ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ lam gyi dngos gzhi/ de dag gi yan lag go de ltar/ /dang po la gnyis/ rang byin brlab/ las dkyil 'khor lo'o// dang po la gnyis/ khyab byed de nas kyi man ngag khyab bya'i man rang byin ngag go /gsum pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan nyams pa rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ rang lugs rang sems bzhag pa/ gzhan lugs 'ga' dgag pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ de ltar spyod pa'i sngon du 'gro ba drod/ drod thob spyod pa nas spyod par bya'o// gsum pa la drug gang zag dge bsnyen gang gis/ dgos rgyas min pa ci'i phyir/ gnas gang sa skyar du/ snying po tshul ji ltar/

grangs du tshig zhig brtsam pa/ brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo legs par ba'o// rgyud gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i bsdus don/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // ༄༅// dbang gi rim pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ra we/ dbang gi rim pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba/ lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma yi// zhabs kyi padmor rab btud de// rnal 'byor chen por gang gsungs pa'i// dbang gi rim pa bshad par bya// 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la/ lam rim pa gnyis zung sbrel du bsgom dgos la/ lam bsgom pa la smin byed kyi dbang sngon du 'gro dgos/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ dang po re zhig slob ma la// dbang rnams lan cig bskur ba yis// de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi// snod du nges par 'gyur ba'o// zhes so// de la'ang dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs/ dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dbang nyid bshad pa bzhi'i dang po ni/ dbang thob na rim pa gnyis bsgom pa dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod du rung ba ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe// blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la// de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sgron gsal las/ dngos grub thams cad dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nyid las 'byung ngo*// zhes so// de'ang bla ma cho ga tshad ldan las dbang thob na/ tshe 'di la ma grub kyang skye ba bdun tshun chad nas 'grub ste/ rgyud gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin 'dod ldan// skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur// de yi skye ba bdun du ni// ma bsgoms par yang dngos grub thob// ces so// ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/

dbang bskur ma thob pas bsgrubs kyang dngos grub kyang mi thob ste/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ dbang med par ni dngos grub med// bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin// zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ dper na/ pi wang sbyor ba kun 'tshogs nas// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes so// dngos grub phran tshegs thob cing rgyud kyi don cung zad shes su zin kyang*/ sngags la rang dgar zhugs pa'i nyes pas dmyal bar 'gro ste/ phyag chen thig le las/ gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis// dbang med par ni 'chad byed pa// slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye// zhes dang*/ phreng bar/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na// sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang*// slob dpon slob mar mtshungs par ni// mi bzad dmyal ba chen por 'gro// zhes so// dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro dgos te/ rdo rje dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// zhes pas/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor la dbye ba mang du gsungs kyang*/ bsdu na/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ dbye ba rang bzhin ting 'dzin dang*// gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum// zhes dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ lus lha'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas gsum du gsungs te/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor de rang bzhin// ci yin de ni 'di ltar bshad// ri mo gnas pa'i las dang ni// thig las tshon bkye'i rim pa bstan// 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// zhes gsung*/

phyi ma 'dis ni rang bzhin gyis dkyil 'khor bstan to// mngon brjod bla ma las drug tu gsungs te/ bri ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po ste// gnyis pa mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// gsum pa lag pa'i phyag rgya ste// bzhi pa gzugs su 'gyur ba'o// lnga pa me tog mchod pa ste// drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro// zhes gsungs/ klu'i byang chub kyis brgyad du'ang gsungs te/ slob ma'i don du bsgrub bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor rnam brgyad bri bar bya// rang bzhin de bzhin sa bon dang*// me tog tshon dang de bzhin du// bye ma g.yo dang phye ma ste// de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden// zhes sogs mang du gsungs so// bzhi pa dbang la/ dbang gi rab tu dbye ba/ nges tshig ngo bo nges par bya ba gsum gyi dang po la/ slob ma smin par byed pa rgyu'i dbang*/ smin pa nyams su len par byed pa lam gyi dbang*/ blangs pa 'bras bu mchog thob par byed pa 'bras bu'i dbang dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dang por dkyil 'khor du/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la dbang bskur bar byed pa'i smin byed kyi dbang de yin la/ de nyid phyis gzhan la yang len pa ni rgyu dbang lam du byed pa yin cing*/ de nyid rang gis bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa ni/ rgyu dbang ting nge 'dzin gyis lam du byed pa zhes bya'o// 'dir smin byed kyi dbang la dbye na/ bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ mjug gi bya ba ste/ bdun gyi dang po la/ rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa/ 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa/ tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa dang gsum mo// de re re la'ang*/ gsum gsum ste/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab yi dam gyi lha las dngos su gnang ba thob pa/ 'bring rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la 'jog nus pa/ tha ma rmi lam du snang ba thob pa'o// dus kyi bsnyen pa rab lo drug

'bring zla ba drug tha ma zhag bdun no// grangs kyi bsnyen pa rab gtso bo la bzhi 'bum/ 'khor la bzhi khri ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'khor lo'i bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum// dkyil 'khor can gyi de bzhin khri// zhes so// 'bring gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor la bzhi stong ngo*// tha ma gtso bo la bzhi stong 'khor la bzhi brgya yin gsung*/ de'ang dus bsnyen gyi tha ma dang*/ grangs kyi 'bring dang tha ma ni/ dus dus su bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i skabs yin gyi/ dang po gzhi'i bsnyen pa ma yin no// yang bsod nams kyi khyad par las kyang*/ 'grub pa myur bul yod de/ sangs rgyas thod pa las/ bsod nams chung ba rnams kyis sngags bye ba bzlas zhing*/ bsod nams 'bring gis sngags 'bum bzlas/ bsod nams che bas sngags khri bzlas pas 'grub ces kyang gsungs so// gnyis pa sa'i cho ga la/ sa brtag pa bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ gzung ba/ bsrung ba ste lnga'i dang po ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mdor na sa gzhi snyoms pa dang*// mdog snum shar du gzhol pa bzhed// chu mang ldan pa'i gnas dang ni// ljon shing bzang pos brgyan pa dang*// bdag gi yid ni mgu ba dang*// 'tshe med zug rngu spangs pa ni// dkyil 'khor gnas su shes pa ste// mi yi dngos grub kun thob byed// ces pa lta bu'i sa btsal bar bya'o// bslang ba la/ mngon pa las bslang ba ni/ sa'i bdag po mi nyid la bslang ba yin la/ mi mngon pa las bslang ba ni/ sa'i lha mo dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin te bslang ba'o// sbyang ba la/ las dang bya bas skyon sbyang ba ni/ 'jor gyis sa ni brkos nas kyang*// sa yi zug rngu dbyung bar bya// zhes pa lta bu/ de mi nus na/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis kyang rung ste/ spyi rgyud las/ zug rngu'i nyes pa thams cad ni// gal te dbyung bar mi nus na// der ni gsang sngags kho na yis// sbyangs pa legs par byas par 'gyur// zhes so// bgegs sbyang ba ni/

rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs tshar bcad pa'o// sa gzung ba ni/ nges med brgyad la sogs pa stangs stabs kyis bkod pas bzung ba'o// de mi nus na ni blos bzung bas kyang rung ste/ spyi rgyud las/ blos ni yongs su bzung bas kyang*// gnas kyi yongs su bzung ba yin// zhes so// bsrung ba ni/ slar bgegs mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar bsam gtan de bzhin 'dir// bsrung ba ji ltar bsrungs pa nyid// ces so// gsum pa sta gon la/ sa dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa dang*/ slob ma sta gon te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// zhes sogs ltar/ gnyis pa ni/ sam ṭir/ dkyil 'khor sta gon la gnas par bya'o// zhes pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ ji ltar re zhig rtsa ba'i bum pa la sogs pa lhag par byas nas zhes sogs ltar ro// bzhi pa ni/ slob ma sta gon la gnas par bya'o// zhes sogs ltar te/ de'ang sta gon gyi dus su bzung ba'i nang nas slob ma gcig ma tshang na'ang*/ bu la sogs pa tshab la bcug pas chog la/ sta gon byas nas dngos gzhi la ma tshang na bskyin pa gzhug tu mi rung ste/ spyi rgyud las/ slob ma yongs su bzung ba gang*// gal te rgyu rkyen 'ga' zhig gis// der ni 'ongs par ma gyur na// gzhan dag de yi bskyin par gzhug /sta gon gnas par byas pa la// gal te rkyen gyis ma 'ongs na// bla ma blo ldan mkhas pa yis// der ni slob ma gzhan mi bzung*// zhes so// bzhi pa bri zhing rgyan dgram pa la/ thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rgyan dgram pa dang bzhi'i dang po ni/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pas// gsang ba legs par bkal ba yi// shin tu tshad ma mdzes pa yis// srad bus shes rab can gyis gdab// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ rdul tshon sa yi tshon dang ni// yang na 'breng po nyid kyi ste// rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am// yang na 'bras la sogs pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa ni/

dbang ldan du ni sha ra ba// me yi mtshams su dge slong bri// bden bral du ni 'khor lo bri// ces so// phyag mtshan sna tshogs mtshan pas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nag po pa'i gzhung 'grel dkyil chog las/ zangs kyi gri gug sngon po bri'o// zhes pas/ phyag len la sna tshogs rdo rje dang gri gug gnyis ka bri'o// bzhi pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ me tog sna tshogs nye bar brgyan// bdug pa mar me de bzhin bri// bum pa brgyad la sogs pa ldan// de yang yal ga la sogs brgyan// mgrin pa gos kyis bkab pa dang*// rin chen lnga ni yongs su gzhug /rnam par rgyal ba shar du sbyin// zhes sogs lag len la shes so// lnga pa sgrub cing mchod pa'i sgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bdun bsres te/ de'ang sbyor tshogs gtso bo yis// zhes pas bdag bskyed dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis/ rdul tshon zhes dang*/ gnyis med ces pas mdun bskyed/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis mkhar gnas zhes pas/ sta gon dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis/ sprul pa zhes pas spro bsdu'i dkyil 'khor bdun bsres te/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ sbyor tshogs gtso bo'i bdag nyid kyis// dkyil 'khor sprul pa rdul tshon dang*// gnyis med mkhar gnas kyang der bzhugs// zhes so// mchod pa ni/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ yid las byung ba dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams kyis mchod pa'o// drug pa 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis kyi/ slob dpon 'jug pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' snyems byas nas// rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang byas te// phyag gnyis rdor dril gyi sbyor bas// slob dpon dkyil 'khor 'jug pa nyid// ces dang*/ sam ṭir/ dam tshig nyams pas de bzhin blang*// zhes so// slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ phyi nang gi 'jug pa ni/ gos kyis mig ni bkab nas su// der ni slob ma gzhug pa nyid// ces sogs so// dbang bskur ba la/

rje sa chen gyi dka' 'grel las/ dbang gi sngon 'gro bcu bzhi/ dngos gzhi bcu bzhi ste/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad du dbye ba/ nyi shu rtsa drug tu dbye ba/ sum cu rtsa gnyis su dbye ba sogs dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i dbang gi rab dbyer/ dbang bcu gcig dbye ba mdzad/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ nag po dkyil chog la sogs par dbang bcu bzhir dbye ba sogs mang du gsungs kyang*/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ ye shes thig ler/ chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs dang*// lung bstan pa dang skyabs sbyin dang*// phyag rgya sngags dang ye shes so// zhes bcu gcig tu gsungs shing*/ rdo rje gur las/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po la// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes te// bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes bzhir dbye ba mdzad de// thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbye bas so// de la'ang bum dbang bcu gcig dang*/ gsang dbang la dbye na lnga/ shes rab ye shes la gnyis/ bzhi pa la lnga ste/ nyer gsum du'ang 'gyur ro// mjug gi bya ba la/ bla ma la yon dbul ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang*/ bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ las kyi rjes bsdu ba dang*/ dga' ston bya ba ste lnga'o// gnyis pa lam gyi dus kyi dbang la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas/ zhes dang*/ a bha yas/ rtag tu yi dam byed pas ni// shes rab dang*/ thabs ro gcig pa'i rang bzhin rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i sbyor bas/ yid kyi ting nge 'dzin dkyil 'khor dbang phyug las/ chu'i dbang la sogs pa gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'i mthar thug pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba'i mthar thug pa blang bar bya'o// rang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// zhes so// gsum pa 'bras bu'i dbang ni/ 'gros bzhi thim pa nyid do// phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyi/

zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu'i dbang bzhis thams cad mkhyen to// zhes dang*/ dngos grub mtshan nyid mi phyed par// phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa dbang gi nges tshig ni/ bum dbang spyi bor gsang dbang lce// shes rab ye shes gsang ba'i gnas su/ bzhi pa rang gi sems la gtor zhing blugs pas na dbang ste/ a bhi ṣe ka ta/ zhes pa'i don to// de'ang ṣi tsa gtor ba ste/ chu gtor nas 'khrud pa dang*/ kun gzhi dang*/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la/ sku bzhi'i sa bon gtor bas na dbang zhes pa'am/ ṣe ka ta lugs su blugs pa ste/ rgyud dag pa'i snod gtsang ma ye shes kyi nus pa blugs pas na dbang bzhi ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya 'dis// des na dbang zhes brjod par bya// zhes so// yang*/ a bhi ka ra zhes pa dbang bar byed pa ste/ rgyud nyan pa dang*/ sta gon bshad pa dang*/ gsang sngags sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// sna na ste 'khrud par byed pa'i dbang ste/ bum dbang gis lus/ gsang dbang gis ngag shes rab ye shes kyis yid/ bzhi pas kun gyi dri ma 'khrud pa ste/ ye shes thig le las/ dbang gis dri ma med par byed// chu la sogs pas rab bkrus bzhin// zhes dang*/ sgron gsal las/ dri ma rnam rtog thams cad 'khrud pa'i ye shes skyed par byed pa'i phyir dbang bskur ba'o// zhes so// yang shag ti nus pa a ba kṣe pan 'jog pa ste/ sku bzhi'i nus pa 'jog pas na dbang ngo*// so so'i nges pa'i tshig ni/ gnas skabs thams cad du bum pa'i chu'i bya ba 'jug pa'i phyir/ bum pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor du/ gsang ba'i rdzas lce la 'jog pa'i phyir gsang dbang*/ shes rab phyag rgya la brten nas/ ye shes dga' ba bzhi'i nyams myong bskyed pas shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi'i mthar thug yin pas na/ bzhi pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// gsum pa dbang rang gi ngo bo nges par bya ba ni rdo rje gur las/

chu yi dbang ni dang po ste// cod paṇa dbang ni gnyis pa'o// rdo rje'i dbang ni gsum po ste// rang gi bdag po bzhi pa nyid// ming gi dbang bskur lnga pa ste// drug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// bum pa'i dbang ni bdun pa ste// gsang ba'i dbang ni brgyad pa'o// shes rab ye shes dgu pa ste// de nyid rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis// kun gyi de nyid brtul zhugs brjod// ston pa rang gis lung bstan te// de 'dir dbang gi cho ga'o// zhes 'byung bas ma rig pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa nyid du sgrub pa chu'i dbang*/ gtsug tor bskyed par nus pa'i phyir/ cod paṇa gyi dbang*/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i dgra rtsa ba nas 'don pas dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcing ba ste/ 'di ni cod paṇa gyi dbang gi 'khor lo yin no// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs par cod paṇa dang*/ dar dpyangs kyi dbang zhes tha dad du brjod do// 'dir ni dar dpyangs bcings pa dngos su ma gsungs te/ de ni bsam pa'i khyad par las/ cod paṇa gyi dbang gis kyang 'grub pa'i don to// dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes skye bar nus pa sgrub pa'i ched du rdo rje'i dbang*/ stong pa dang ting nge 'dzin dbyer mi phyed pa bla na med pa'i ye shes 'byung ba'i bdag po chos 'byung bar rtogs par bya ba'i ched du/ dril bu'i sgra dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'o// bdag po de'i ched du bdag po'i dbang bskur zhes kyang bya'o// ma 'ongs pa na/ thub pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang gi ming du 'os pa'i sa bon bkod pa'i don du ming gi dbang*/ chu'i dbang la sogs pa lnga po 'di rnams rim pa bzhin du/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi sa bon yongs su rgyas pa'i phyir/ de'i bdag nyid du mos par bya'o// yang na chu'i me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid du'ang*/ de nyid bsdus pa las gsungs te/

mi bskyod pa'ang me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pas so// der ma zad rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni/ mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi yin la/ de gnas gyur pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes te/ tsand+ra go mis/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gang yin pa// de ni me long ye shes 'gyur// zhes so// 'di nas brtsams te/ rnam par dag pa'i zung 'jug gi byang chub rtogs par bya ba'i ched du brtson par gyis shig ces so// de'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' la sbyor ba ni/ rdo rje'i bdag tshig gam/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ston pa'i nges pa ster ba/ de bzhin nyid rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i ched du/ sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu'i dam tshig shes rab dang*/ thabs kyi bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin du bstan par nus pa nyid du sgrub pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /de nyid kyi phyir/ rdo rje gur las/ dam tshig gnyis kyi 'khor lo can// phyag rgya'i dam tshig kho na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dbang du gsungs so// ji ltar sa bcu pa las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur ba bzhin du/ dam tshig gsum dang bcas pa 'di'ang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ bla mas sems can dpag tu med pa la/ gzhal du med pa'i chos ston pa'i slob dpon du bya ba'i ched du/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bas na/ slob dpon gyi dbang*/ phyir mi ldog pa dang 'dra bas na phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ngo*// dad pa dang shes rab kyi zhing du bya ba'i don nam/ dam tshig bsrung ba'i don dang*/ ngag dag pa'i don du gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// phul du phyin pa'i shes pa 'di la yod pas/ shes rab ni phyi rol gyi gzhon nu ma'o// de las ye shes ni/ sems yang dag pa dang bral bas rnam par dag pa ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// ye shes de nyid dri ma dang bral zhing yongs su dag par rtogs pa ni/

dbang bzhi pa'o// 'di dag ni bde ba chen po'i ros/ yid 'khrud pa'i phyir yang dbang ste/ de dag ni a bha yā ka ra'i bzhed pa dang mthun no// yang na/ phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga/ rigs lnga dang*/ ye shes lngar byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ chu cod paṇa/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming ste/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rigs drug pa'i ngo bor byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir thun mong gi brtul zhugs so// gzhan don gyi mthu dang ldan pa nyid du sgrub pa'i phyir/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// bdag nyid 'jug pa gzhan la rag ma lus par bya ba'i rjes gnang*/ me tog gang la phog pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bar bstan pa'i phyir/ lung bstan/ slan chad srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol bar bstan pa'i phyir/ dbugs dbyung*/ de las dga' ba khyad par can skyes te zhum pa'i sems dang bral ba'i phyir/ gzengs bstod de/ mtha' rten bzhi bsnan pas bum dbang bcu gcig go /gsang dbang la/ thob lugs kyi phye na/ yab las thob pa/ yum las thob pa/ grol ba'i stobs las thob pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bstan pa de las gang byung ba// slob ma'i khar ni ldung bar bya// zhes dang*/ sam ṭir/ gang zhig mchog rnams la ni sangs rgyas gcig pu'i bdag nyid kyis sbyin par bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa la dbye na/ dang por rab 'bring gsum gyi dbang du byas nas/ gsang dbang gi rdzas te/ dung dang nya phyis la sogs pa mngon du bya ste/ mtheb srin gyis lce la 'jog pa dang*/ zho dang chang la sbyar te sbyin pa dang*/ mgrin par thig le bya ba ste bzhi'o// de'ang rtsa rgyud las/ mthe bong srin lag dbang gis ni// slob ma'i khar ni ldung bar bya// zhes dang*/ sam ṭir/ mgrin par nyin bar gyi thig le bya'o// 'bring po la ni nya phyis gyis so// zhes so// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la gnyis las/ shes rab ni/ dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya gtad pa yin la/

ye shes ni dga' ba bzhi'i nyams myong bskyed pa'o// de'ang ye shes thig ler/ shes rab rnam pa gnyis su dbye// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bye brag go /zhes so// dbang bzhi pa la/ tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i bzhi pa ste lnga'o// dang po ni kha sbyor las/ slob ma'i mos pa shes bya ste// dbang bskur cho ga bzhin bya ste// zab cing rgya che la mos la// tshig gi rin chen dbang bskur bya// zhes gsungs pas/ gsum pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang 'dra ba'o// zhes tshig la brten nas rtogs pa bskyed pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ slob ma snying rje can mthong nas// rdo rje can gyis 'di skad smra// 'di nyid ye shes chen po nyid// thams cad lus la rnam par gnas// gnyis dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul// dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso// brtan dang g.yo ba khyab nas gnas// sgyu ma'i gzugs can nyid du 'dod// ces so// don gyi bzhi pa ni/ tshig gi bzhi pa/ de la brten nas bzhi pa'i ye shes phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang po sprin dang 'dra ba yin// grub pas sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur// gnyid log sad par mi phyed pa// rtag tu rmi lam 'dra bar 'gyur// zhes so// 'dis don gyi bzhi pa bstan par yang*/ dka' 'grel las/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa goms par byas pa las/ dang po sprin dang 'dra ba zhes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mi gsal ba tsam du rtogs pa ste/ drod chung ngu'i dus so// 'bring gi dus su grub pa zhes pa lhan skyes ye shes mnyam gzhag la gsal bar mngon du grub pas sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur zhes pa rjes kyi dus na'o// chen po'i dus na mnyam rjes med par chos thams cad lhan skyes kyi ngo bor rtogs pas/

nyal dang langs pa'i khyad par tsam las/ rtag tu rmi lam 'dra bar 'gyur zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ spros bral gyi ye shes skyong ba ni don gyi bzhi pa'o// zhes so// rigs pas kyang*/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa goms pa'i mthar don gyi bzhi pa nyid du 'grub bo// bzhi pa rten can ni/ gsum pa la ye shes ngos ma zin pa na/ padma can la brten nas tha mal gyi dga' ba bzhi'i mthar lhan skyes kyi nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa ste/ bolla kakko la sbyar bas// de yi bde ba shes par 'gyur// zhes so// lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa ni/ bzhi pa'i nyams myong de lta ba gso ba'i ched du/ lam dus su goms par byed pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ ston pas smras pa sems dpa' che// bde ba chen po rnam par zung*// ji srid byang chub bar du 'dir// sems can don gyi rdo rje 'dzin// zhes dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs kyi ni// rtag tu nges par 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes so// 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i bzhi pa ni/ drod thob nas spyod pa spyad pa'i mthar/ rgyud yongs su dag pa'i phyag rgya sa bcu la brten nas/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed la 'gros bzhi thim pas/ sku lnga 'char ba ste/ dngos grub mtshan nyid mi phyed pa// phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub// ces dang*/ gur las kyang*/ mi yi phyag rgya blangs nas ni// de dang lhan cig dngos grub 'gyur// phyag rgya'i dngos grub zhes su grags// zhes so// de yang dka' 'grel las/ nye rgyu mngon du byed pa ni/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i bzhi pa ste/ dngos grub mtshan nyid ces sogs gsungs so// de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches/ thog mtha' med cing skye 'gag med// dngos grub kun gyi chos nyid mchog /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes// ngo sprod tshig gi bzhi pa'o// de yi ye shes skyes pa ni// don gyi bzhi pa'o phyag rgya dang*// bcas pa rten can dus kun du// goms byed lam gyi bzhi pa ste// 'gros bzhi thim nas grub pa gang*// mngon du byed pa'i bzhi pa'o// zhes gsungs so// dbang de dag gi mtha' rten ni/

dbang bzhi nub gcig la rdzogs par bskur na/ bum dbang gi mtha' rten rjes gnang*/ gsang dbang gi mtha' rten lung bstan/ shes rab ye shes kyi mtha' rten dbugs dbyung*/ bzhi pa'i mtha' rten gzengs bstod do// bzang po yongs gzung gi rjes su 'brangs pa yin gsungs/ nub gcig rdzogs par mi bskur na// rdo rje slob ma'i rigs la ni// mtha' rten gang yang mi dgos gsungs// rdo rje slob dpon gyi rigs la/ mtha' rten bzhi ka bum dbang gi rjes la mdzad de ye shes thig le'i rjes su 'brang pa'o// a bha yās/ sngags dang mig smin dang*/ me long dang*/ mda' 'phang ba rnams ni rigs pa'i dbang gi rjes la yang*/ zhes pa/ slob ma'i dbang kho na'ang 'di tsam rigs par mngon no// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni// bsod nams ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs// de'ang rim pa gnyis las byung*// de'ang dbang la rag las pa// de phyir dbang bskur mchog tu gsung*// des na kun la phan don du// go don tsam zhig bris shig ces// brtson grus bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor// dge slong kun dga'i ming can gyis// dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba las// byung ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// rdo rje 'dzin par 'jug gyur cig /'di mthong tsam gyis skye bo rnams// chos la nan tan byed pa'i rgyur// gyur nas dbang lam gtsor byed cing*// sgrub la nan tan 'phel gyur cig /dbang gi rim pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba rje btsun gong ma'i phyag len lung gis cung zad brgyan pa 'di/ stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas shing rdo rje theg pa la lhag par mos pa'i dge bshes brtson 'grus bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ bla ma rnams kyi bran gyi tha mar gyur pa snyoms las can kun dga'i ming can gyis sgrol byed kyi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o//

// ༄༅// gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig bzhugs so// ༈ /klu sgrub snying po zhes bya ba dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim pa lnga'i man ngag gi khrid yig zung 'jug gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// yid 'ong sgyu ma'i mtshan dpes rnam par mdzes// gzhom med skad kyis dam chos sna tshogs rnams// rgyun chad med par 'gro la gsal mdzad pa// rdo rje 'chang bdag dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// rgyud dang klu sgrub dgongs pa ci bzhin du// ma nor thugs su chud pa 'phags pa'i lha// de yi gdams ngag mkhas mang las brgyud pa'i// rdzogs rim zab mo'i gdams ngag bshad kyis nyon// gnyis pa dngos gzhi rnal 'byor gyi zung 'jug gi ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa la gnyis/ rim lnga spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i rim pa zab mo rnams bshad pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ rim lnga bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag rim lnga'i rnal 'byor gyi dbye bsdu/ rim lngar grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi bshad pa/ bsgom pa'i gnas bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa nas brtsams te/ dran pa gcig pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi bar la tshul bzhin du bslab pa dang*/ sngar bskyed rim gyi sngon 'gror rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du thun mong gi dbang dgu dbang gong ma gsum dang bcas pa thob zin na des chog la/ sngar bum dbang yan chad las ma thob na/ 'dir ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zung 'jug gsal ba ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag go /gnyis pa ni slob dpon 'phags pas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sems la dmigs pa/ bdag byin gyis brlab/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ zung du 'jug pa dang lngar mdzad la/ rdor bzlas kyi sngon du lus dben ma bstan kyang*/ mi dgos pa'am mi bzhed pa ni ma yin te/

'bras bu rdor bzlas bstan pas de'i rgyur lus dben 'gro dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ rim lngar lus dang ngag dang yid rnam par dben pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// dper na pi wang gi skad 'byung ba la khog pa nges par dgos pa bzhin no// 'phags pa lhas rdzogs rim la drug tu mdzad pa ni/ lus dben nyams len la mi dgos kha med yin pas/ rdor bzlas kyi sngon 'gror sbyar ba snang ngo*// zla ba grags pas bskyed rim dang po/ dben gsum gnyis pa/ sgyu lus gsum pa/ 'od gsal bzhi pa/ zung 'jug lnga par mdzad pa ni/ rgyud dbu zhabs kyi brjod bya de lngar 'du ba la dgongs nas/ mdor bstan gyi tshul du mdzad pa yin pas yab sras thams cad kyi dgongs pa nyams len gyi go rim la mi mthun pa med do// gsum pa ni/ spang bya nyon mongs dang rnam rtog mngon gyur mgo gnon pa dang*/ sa bon drungs nas 'byin pa la rim pa lnga dgos te/ dben gsum ni/ sems rtse gcig pa zhi gnas kyi lam yin pas spang bya nyon mongs dang rnam rtog mngon 'gyur mgo gnon pa yin la lhag ma gsum ni shes rab gtso bor byed pa lhag mthong gi lam yin pas sa bon drungs nas 'byin pa yin no// dang po la yang*/ zhi gnas kyi rten dang*/ rkyen dang*/ mngon sum las/ sngon 'gro lus dben ni/ rten yin te/ des byin gyis brlabs pa'i lus la brten nas zhi gnas bsgom pa'i phyir ro// ngag dben ni rkyen yin te/ rlung dbang du 'dus pa las/ mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas skye ba'i phyir ro// sems dben ni dngos yin te/ phyag rgya'am grol lam la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i phyir ro// de dag gi spang bya mgo gnon du zin kyang*/ sa bon spang ba la lam phyi ma gsum dgos te/ sgyu mas yul stong nyid du rtogs pas gzung rtog spangs la/ 'od gsal gyis sems stong par rtogs pas 'dzin rtog gi sa bon spang zhing*/

zung 'jug gis bden gnyis dbyer med par rtogs pas bden gnyis tha dad du zhen pa'i sa bon spang ba'i phyir ro// de bas rim lngar grangs nges te/ lus dben ni ngag dben gyi sngon 'gro yin pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du go rim yang nges pa yin te/ snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma 'byung bas rgyu 'bras kyi go rim yin pas/ lus dben sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten nas ngag dben gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'byung gi gzhan du ma yin te/ dper na pi wang gi khog pa legs par sbyangs pa las/ skad snyan pa 'byung gi gzhan du ma yin pa bzhin no// ngag rnam par dben pas sems kyi bzhon pa rlung dbang du 'dus pa las rlung la zhon pa'i sems rnam par dben pa thugs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung ste/ dper na rta'i kha lo 'byongs pa'i skyes bus bgrod bya'i gnas su phyin gyi gzhan gyi ma yin pa bzhin no// sems dben gyi ting nge 'dzin med na sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'byung ste/ sgyu ma'i sku de ni rang rig pa bde ba tsam las grub pa'i phyir ro// kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu mngon sum du ma byas par don dam 'od gsal rtogs par mi nus te/ chos can sgyu ma mthar ma phyin na/ de bsam gtan gnyis kyis bshig pa'i chos nyid 'od gsal mngon du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa med na zung 'jug gi sku mi 'byung ste/ g.ya' dang bral ba'i me long med na me long nang gi gzugs brnyan snang stong zung 'jug mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// des na lam 'di dag la rim can du slob dgos pa yin te/ rim lngar/ bskyed pa'i rim par legs gnas nas// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// skas kyi gdang bu lta bur bstan// zhes bshad do// bzhi pa ni/ spyir sems can gyi khams la skye 'chi gnyis las/

skye ba kun rdzob kyi bden pa snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin la/ 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa bar do dang bcas pa ni rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin te/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus par/ skye ba kun rdzob bden pa zhes bya ste// 'chi ba yang ni don dam bden pa yin// bden gnyis 'di la rnam par nges byas nas// bshad pa gnyis kyi dbye ba gsungs pa yin// zhes dang*/ spyod bsdus las/ gang zhig skye ba kun rdzob bden pa ste// 'chi ba'i ming yang don dam bden pa yin// rim gnyis de dag bla ma'i drin gyis ni// rnyed pa 'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin// zhes bden gnyis kyi don ni rim pa gnyis la bshad do// skabs 'dir rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa'i tshul ltar bshad na bzhi ste/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed/ de dag phan tshun sbyar ba ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ rang gi lus 'di 'jig cing 'chi ba'i tshe phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad sa chu la thim pa sogs 'byung ba rim gyis 'gags pa nas bzung ste/ bar do yid kyi lus grub pa'i bar ni rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhir btsun mo can bzhed la/ mngon shes can gyis da ltar gyi lus ngag yid gsum rmi lam gyi snang ba dang bcas pa dang*/ 'chi ba bar do dang bcas pa thams cad rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhir bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ rdor bzlas kyi sngon 'gro lus dben nas brtsams te/ zung 'jug gi bar gyi rim pa lnga'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so// gsum pa ni 'chi ba'i tshe sa chu la/ chu me la/ me rlung la thim pa'i bar phung po dang khams dang skye mched rags pa 'gags pa ni lus dben gyi sbyang gzhi yin la/ rlung rnam shes la thim pa ngag dben gyi sbyang gzhi dang*/ rnam shes 'od gsal la thim pa sems dben gyi sbyang gzhi yin no// sgyu ma'i sbyang gzhi ni/

rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can bar do la bzhed/ btsun mo can rmi lam dang mngon shes can lus len kha'i sgro btags kyi shes pa tsam yin gsungs kyang*/ rje 'gos kyis de dag mi 'thad par bzhag nas/ nag po zhabs sgyu ma la sbyang gzhi logs pa med kyang*/ sbyong byed la nges par dgos te/ zung 'jug gi nyer len gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs zhing*/ 'od gsal gyi sbyang gzhi ni 'chi ba sher phyin yin la/ zung 'jug gi sbyang gzhi bar do yin no// zhes rje 'gos bzhed do// rngog nyi ma seng ge ltar na/ phung po khams dang skye mched ye shes lnga dang bcas pa zhib mor phye na dngos po brgyar gnas pa sogs ni lus dben gyi sbyang gzhi yin la/ lus kyi khong stong dbugs nyi khri tshig stong drug brgya/ yi ge 'bru gsum sgra rang bzhin gyis grags pa dang bcas pa ngag dben gyi sbyang gzhi dang*/ sems gsum rang bzhin dang bcas pa sems dben gyi dang*/ rmi lam gyi tshe rlung sems tsam las yid kyi lus mngon zhen dang bcas pa grub ste phyogs bcur rgyu zhing 'dod pa la longs spyod par snang ba sgyu lus kyi dang*/ 'chi ba'i tshe 'byung ba bzhi rnam shes dang bcas pa chen po lnga 'od gsal du thim ste 'chi ba sher phyin mngon du byas pa 'od gsal gyi dang*/ de las lugs bzlog gi snang ba gsum rlung dang bcas pa las skad cig gis bar do yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus grub pa ni/ zung 'jug gi sbyang gzhi yin no zhes 'dod do// 'o na bskyed rim dang lus dben sbyang gzhi gcig tu 'gyur ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ sbyang gzhi gcig yin kyang spang bya tha mal gyi rnam rtog rags pa bskyed rim gyis spangs la/ phra ba lus dben gyis spong bas mi 'gal lo// yang 'chi ba stong nyid dang bar do bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhir bshad pas/ rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhir 'gal ce na/ mi 'gal te/

bskal pa dang po'i mi brdzus skyes shi nas mngal du 'jug pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal dang*/ bar do ni bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin la/ mngal kha du ma brgyud pa'i 'chi ba 'od gsal dang*/ bar do ni rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi yin pas mi 'gal lo// bzhi pa ni/ gzhi gsum ni zag bcas zhi gnas kyi lam yin pas spang bya mngon gyur mgo gnon pa'i tshul gyis sbyangs la/ sgyu ma 'od gsal zung 'jug dang bcas pa ni lhag mthong shes rab kyi lam yin pas spang bya'i sa bon drungs nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis sbyang ngo*// spyir du na/ snod bcud tha mal gyi rnam rtog ni bskyed rim gyi spang bya yin la/ gzung 'dzin bya byed kyi rnam rtog ni rdzogs rim gyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir ro// dri ma rags pa gnyen po stobs chung bas spangs la/ phra ba ni gnyen po stobs che bas spang bas dngos po tha mal rnam rtog rags pa'i gnyen po ni bskyed rim yin la/ phra ba'i gnyen po ni lus dben no// gzung 'dzin bya byed kyi rnam rtog shes sgrib rags pa'i gnyen po ngag dben dang sems dben gnyis yin la/ shes sgrib phra ba'i gnyen po ni sgyu ma sogs gsum yin no// de yang gzung rtog phra ba'i gnyen po yul stong pa sgyu ma dang*/ 'dzin rtog phra ba'i gnyen po sems stong nyid 'od gsal dang*/ de gnyis kyi bag chags shin tu phra zhing phra ba'i gnyen po zung 'jug rnams yin par shes par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs ni// me tog 'bras bu sogs kyis brgyan// ri bo dben pa dag tu ni// dngos grub thams cad bsdus pas sgrub// ces gsung pa ltar/ ri'i phug la sogs pa'i gnas dben pa/ nyin bar skye bo'i rgyun lugs dang*/ sgra'i klag cor la sogs med pa/ mtshan mo gcan gzan dang*/ chom rkun gyi gnod pa dang bral ba'i gnas su thun bzhi'i rim pas rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya ba yin no//

༈ //spyi don gnyis pa dmigs pa'i rim pa zab mo nyams su blang ba la rim pa lnga ste/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sems rnam par dben pa/ kun rdzob bden pa sgyu lus/ don dam 'od gsal/ zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la/ sngon 'gro lus rnam par dben pa dang*/ dngos gzhi ngag rnam par dben pa'o// dang po la don bdun gyi/ lus dben bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ bskyed rim mthar phyin nas mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer bas lus dben sogs rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa shes bya ni/ de la slob pa'i tshe lus thams cad don dam par stong pa nyid las byung zhing stong pa nyid la thim pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin la/ kun rdzob tu dngos po rgyas bsdus pa'i lus thams cad sangs rgyas lnga'i phra rab sa las grub par shes par bya ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du/ sku yi rdo rje rdzogs byang chub// dngos dang dngos med rnam dpyad pa// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni/ kha dog gi gzugs la sogs pa tha mal pa'i rtog pa cha phra ba ste/ rags pa ni bskyed rim gyis sbyangs pas so// bzhi pa dbye ba so so'i mtshan nyid la bzhi ste/ gzugs kyi lus dben dang*/ rang bzhin gyi lus dben/ rnam par shes pa'i lus dben/ ting nge 'dzin gyi lus dben no// dang po ni/ rang gi lus 'di mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu so drug 'dus pa'i phyir/ tha mal pa rnams kyi gzugs kyi lus po gtsang ba dang bde ba la sogs par brtags pa las dben pa ste/ nyan thos dang shes bya thun mong ba'o// gnyis pa ni lus 'di phung po la sogs pa'i rang bzhin nyi shu rtsa lnga yin pa'i phyir/ mu stegs rnams kyis rang bzhin gcig tu brtags pas dben pa ste/ phar phyin theg pa dang shes bya thun mong ba'o// gsum pa ni/ rnam par shes pa ni phyi nang du nye bar mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro// rang gi sde pas btags pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis dben pa ste/

sems tsam dang shes bya thun mong ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ lus thams cad stong par shes par byas nas kun rdzob tu tha mal gyi dngos po brgya la sogs par gnas pa de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa rigs brgya la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du bsgom pa ste/ gsang sngags pa'i shes bya thun mong ma yin pa'o// lnga pa ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul la gsum las/ dang po rgyas par rigs brgyar bsgom tshul ni/ gzugs dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i lus gsum/ rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas/ phung po sogs tha mal gyi dngos po cha phra ba rnams de bzhin gshegs pa brgyar bsgoms te/ de yang gzugs kyi phung po spyi rnam snang du bsgoms la/ bye brag tu phye na/ gzugs rnam snang la phyi nang gnyis ka'i ring po sogs dbyibs kyi gzugs ni/ rnam snang gi rnam snang*/ bdag gzhan sogs rnam pa'i gzugs ni rnam snang gi rin 'byung*/ sngon po sogs kha dog gi gzugs ni rnam snang gi snang mtha'/ nyi zla sogs snang ba'i gzugs ni rnam snang gi don grub/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ni rnam snang gi mi bskyod par shes par byas la bsgom/ de bzhin du tshor ba spyi rin 'byung du bsgoms te/ de la 'dus mkhris pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rin 'byung gi mi bskyod pa/ bad rlung las byung ba'i tshor ba rin 'byung*/ tshor ba bde ba snang mtha'/ tshor ba sdug bsngal ba don grub/ tshor ba btang snyoms pa snang mdzad du bsam mo// 'du shes spyi snang ba mtha' yas su bsgoms te/ de la rkang gnyis pa'i 'du shes ni snang mtha'i mi bskyod pa/ rkang bzhi pa'i 'du shes ni rin 'byung*/ rkang med kyi 'du shes ni snang mtha'/ rkang mang gi 'du shes ni don grub/ mi g.yo zhing mi rgyu ba'i 'du shes ni rnam snang du bsgom mo// 'du byed kyi don grub tu bsgoms te/ de la lus kyi 'du byed don grub kyi rnam snang*/ ngag gi 'du byed snang mtha'/

yid kyi 'du byed mi bskyod pa/ khams gsum gyi 'du byed rin 'byung*/ thar pa'i 'du byed don grub tu bsgom mo// rnam par shes pa spyi mi bskyod par bsgoms te/ de la mig gi rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i rnam snang*/ rna ba'i rnam shes rin 'byung*/ sna'i rnam shes snang mtha'/ lce'i rnam shes don grub/ lus kyi rnam shes mi bskyod par shes par byas la bsgom mo// de bzhin du sa khams sangs rgyas spyan du bsgoms te/ de la/ skra/ rus pa/ phyi sa/ mchin pa/ snying rnams ni spyan ma'i rnam snang*/ spu/ sen mo/ rnag snying rnams ni spyan ma'i rin 'byung*/ so/ pags pa/ sha snying rnams ni spyan ma'i snang mtha'/ rgyus pa/ sha rtsib ma/ snying rnams ni spyan ma'i don grub/ dri ma/ rgyu ma/ mkhris pa/ snying rnams ni spyan ma'i mi bskyod par bsam mo// snying lnga ni/ spyod bsdus las/ snying ni lnga la nges gnas te// rgyun lngar rnam par 'byung ba ni// rlung lnga dang ni ldan pa ru// 'dod pa lnga rnams spyod par byed// ces bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las bshad pa khungs su drangs so// de bzhin du phyi rol gyi sa khams kyang rigs lngar bsgoms te/ ri rab ni rnam snang*/ lus 'phags po mi bskyod pa/ 'dzam gling rin 'byung*/ ba lang spyod snang mtha'/ sgra mi snyan don yod grub par bsam mo// chu mā ma kīr bsams te/ de yang bad kan dang mchi ma ni mā ma kī rnam snang*/ gcin mi bskyod pa/ rngul rin 'byung*/ khrag snang mtha'/ kha chu don grub tu bsam mo// de bzhin du phyi rol gyi chu khams la/ rgya mtsho'i chu mi bskyod pa/ chu bo'i chu rin 'byung*/ bkod ma'i chu snang mtha'/ lteng ka'i chu don grub/ 'bab chu'i chu rnam snang du bsam mo// me gos dkar mo la mgo bo'i drod gos dkar mo'i rnam snang*/ snying ga'i drod mi bskyod pa/ lte ba'i drod rin 'byung*/ rkang lag gi drod snang mtha'/

lte ba'i drod don grub rnams su bsgom zhing*/ phyi rol gyi me khams yang rgyun bzhag gi me mi bskyod pa/ rdo las byung ba'i me rnam snang*/ me shel gyi me rin 'byung*/ shing gi me snang mtha'/ nags kyi me don grub du bsam mo// rlung khams sgrol mar bsams te/ de yang srog rlung sgrol ma'i mi bskyod pa/ thur sel rin 'byung*/ gyen rgyu snang mtha'/ mnyam gnas don grub/ khyab byed rnam snang du bsams shing*/ phyi'i shar gyi rlung mi bskyod pa/ lho'i rlung rin 'byung*/ nub rlung snang mtha'/ byang rlung don grub/ steng gi rlung rnam snang du bsam mo// mig sa'i snying por bsams te/ de yang mig gi dbang po ni sa'i snying gi mi bskyod pa/ mig 'bras dkar po rin 'byung*/ zur gyis blta ba snang mtha'/ rnam par g.yo ba'i mig don grub/ gzugs gsum 'dzin pa rnam snang du bsam mo// rna ba phyag rdor du bsgoms te/ de la rna ba'i dbang po ni phyag rdor gyi mi bskyod pa/ rna ba'i rang bzhin rnam snang*/ rna ba'i bu ga snang mtha'/ rna ba'i rtsa ba don grub/ sgra gsum 'dzin pa rin 'byung du bsgom mo// lce sna nam mkha'i snying por bsgoms te/ de la sna'i dbang po ni/ nam snying gi mi bskyod pa/ sna'i rang bzhin rnam snang*/ sna'i nang gi dbus rin 'byung*/ sna'i bu ga don grub/ dri gsum 'dzin pa snang mthar bsgom mo// lce 'jig rten dbang phyug tu bsgoms te/ de la lce'i dbang po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi mi bskyod pa/ lce'i rang bzhin rnam snang*/ lce'i rtsa ba rin 'byung*/ lce'i rtse mo snang mtha'/ ro gsum 'dzin pa don grub tu bsgom mo// lus sgrib sel du bsgoms te/ de la rdul phran 'dus pa'i gzugs kyi lus dbang ni sgrib sel gyi rnam snang*/ rus pa'i rang bzhin rin 'byung*/ sha'i rang bzhin snang mtha'/ pags pa'i rang bzhin don grub/ reg gsum 'dzin pa mi bskyod par bsgom mo// yid kyi dbang po ste/

nang gi rnam shes gsum ni 'jam dpal du bsam/ ldang zhing rgyu ba'i rlung mig la brten nas/ gzugs lnga'i bya ba rdzogs par byed pa nyid gzugs rdo rje mar bsgoms te/ de la rkyen gsum 'tshogs pas mthong ba'i yul gyi gzugs ni rdo rje ma'i rnam snang*/ 'gying bag dang*/ rnam par rol la bteg pa'i gzugs mi bskyod pa/ chags pa'i gzugs rin 'byung*/ btang snyoms kyi gzugs snang mtha'/ lam thams cad sgrub pa'i gzugs don grub tu bsam mo// rnam par rgyu ba'i sgra'i rang bzhin sgra rdo rje mar bsgoms te/ de la rna ba'i nang gi dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ skra'i sgra ni sgra rdo rje ma'i rnam snang*/ glu dang rgyun gyi sgra ni rin 'byung*/ rkan dang mchu dang*/ ngag gi sgra ni snang mtha'/ nags tshal dang*/ chu bo dang*/ se gol dang*/ thal mo dang*/ rol mo'i sgra rnams ni don grub/ hūm̐ gi zhi drag gi sgra ni mi bskyod par bsam mo// yang dag par rgyu ba'i rlung dri'i rang bzhin dri rdo rje mar bsgoms te/ de la dri ma lus pa ni dri rdo rje ma'i rnam snang*/ yan lag gi dri rin 'byung*/ dri gsum 'dzin pa snang mtha'/ ro'i dri don grub/ dri mi zad pa mi bskyod par bsgom mo// rab tu rgyu ba'i rlung ro'i rang bzhin ro rdo rje mar bsgoms te/ de la ro mngar ba ro rdo rje ma'i rnam snang*/ bska ba rin 'byung*/ lan tshwa snang mtha'/ kha ba mi bskyod pa/ ro tsha skyur sogs ro drug gi bye brag rnams don grub tu bsgom mo// nges par rgyu ba'i rlung reg bya'i rang bzhin reg rdo rje mar bsgoms te/ de la stan gcig la gnas pa'i reg bya ni/ reg rdo rje ma'i rnam snang*/ 'khyud pa'i reg bya rin 'byung*/ 'o byed pa'i reg bya snang mtha'/ rngub pa'i reg bya don grub/ dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi reg bya mi bskyod par bsgom mo// ye shes lnga ni thams cad kyi dbye gzhi mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ste rigs brgya yin la/

ji ltar du bsgom pa'i tshul yang bskyed rim ltar lhar bskyed nas bsgom pa ma yin gyi/ sman pa mkhas pa nags su zhugs pas ci mthong sman du ngo shes pa ltar/ gang snang sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin du shes par byas nas bsgom mo zhes gsung yang*/ bskyed rim ltar mngon byang lnga sogs las bskyed nas mi bsgom pa yin gyi/ skad cig gis bskyed nas zhal phyag gi rnam par shar ba nges par dgos so// gnyis pa 'bring po rigs lngar bsgom pa ni/ de rnams thams cad bsdu na ni/ 'byung bzhi rnam shes dang lngar 'du ba'i phyir/ rnam snang du bsgom rgyu nyi shu sa'i khams/ rin po che'i rigs nyi shu me'i khams/ padma'i rigs nyi shu chu'i khams/ las kyi rigs nyi shu rlung gi khams/ rdo rje'i rigs nyi shu rnam shes kyi khams te/ gsang ba'am de kho na nyid lnga sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid du bsgom mo// gsum pa bsdus pa rigs gsum du bsgom pa ni/ de yang bsdu na rnam snang dang rin 'byung gnyis sku rdo rje/ snang mtha' dang don grub gnyis gsung rdo rje/ mi bskyod pa dang drug pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis thugs rdo rje ste/ de gsum rang gi lus ngag yid gsum du 'dus pa mos par byas la bsgom mo// nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ bsam gtan gyi khang par 'bol ba'i stan la rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mig thad kar 'byed 'dzums med pa/ so dang mchu mnyam par bya ste/ lus gnad de lta bu la gnas pas dmigs pa dang po/ rang nyid rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i mtshan nyid rang gi sems rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i bdag nyid du mos pa bsten pas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo gsang chen rigs gcig pa rdo rje 'chang chen po zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du skad cig gis gsal btab la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pas/ sngar bskyed rim goms pa'i stobs kyis rang nyid lha skur gsal bar 'gyur ro// gal te rnam pa mi gsal na/

rdo rje 'chang chen po'i tsa ka li'am thang sku rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ de la bltas shing gsal btab la brtan par gyur gyi bar du bsgom mo// de la brten nas sngar bshad pa bzhin rigs gsum gyi bdag nyid du bsgom/ de la brten nas rigs lngar bsgom/ de la brten nas rigs brgyar bsgom/ de rnams la brten nas khams gsum pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin du bsgom mo// drug pa mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/ mnyam rjes gnyis ka la khams gsum thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsang chen rigs gcig tu nga rgyal brtan par 'gyur ba'o// bdun pa phan yon ni/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog phra zhing phra ba spang ba dang*/ ngag dben bsgom pa la phyogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i dus su gzugs kyi sku thob par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa dngos gzhi ngag rnam par dben pa la drug ste/ dang po rten gyi gang zag ni/ lus dben sku rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin nas/ ngag dben bsgom pa la 'dod pa yod pa'o// gnyis pa shes bya ni/ sgra'i de nyid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang*/ rlung gi de nyid 'jug gnas ldang gsum dang*/ sngags kyi de nyid yi ge 'bru gsum dbyer med du gzhi dus na gnas pa ltar shes par bya ba ste/ de la rlung gi gtso bo lnga ste/ srog rlung snying ga na/ thur sel 'doms na/ gyen rgyu lkog ma na/ me dang mnyam du gnas pa lte ba na/ khyab byed tshigs thams cad na gnas so// de bzhin du yan lag gi rlung yang lnga ste/ rgyu ba'i rlung mig la gnas nas gzugs mthong ba'i bya ba byed la/ de bzhin du rnam par rgyu ba rna ba la gnas nas sgra/ yang dag par rgyu ba sna la gnas nas dri rab tu rgyu ba lce la gnas nas ro/ nges par rgyu ba mtshan ma la gnas nas reg bya thams cad rigs pa'i bya ba byed do// rlung bcu po 'di rnams bud med kyi padma dang*/ skyes pa'i rdo rje'i sna las byung nas steng du song ste/

kun rdzob kyi sna sgo nas dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rlung du 'gyur te/ sna g.yon nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor mdog ljang ser/ don grub kyi ngo bo dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu/ g.yas nas me rlung dmar po 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin/ sna gnyis ka nas sa rlung ser po rin 'byung gi rang bzhin/ dal zhing rgyu ba bul ba chu rlung dkar po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu'o// khyab byed kyi rlung ni dkyil 'khor bzhi char la khyab pa'i rlung ste/ da lta mi rgyu zhing 'chi ba'i dus su dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu'o// de ltar mgon po re re'i rlung rgyu ba na/ lha mo'i rlung nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga rgyu zhing*/ dkyil 'khor re re yang 'jug nas ldang gsum du yod la/ yi ge gsum gyi skad gdangs su gnas pa ni rlung gi de kho na nyid do// ā li kā li las byung ba'i sngags rnams kyi de kho na nyid mi shigs pa las byung ba'i yi ge gsum ni sngags kyi de kho na nyid do// sngags kyi sgra thams cad a'i rigs su gyur pa dang*/ a rgyur gyur pa dang*/ a las nges par byung ba ste/ ngag thams cad stong pa nyid las byung zhing*/ stong pa nyid la thim pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par shes par bya ba ni sgra'i de kho na nyid do// gsum pa spang bya ni phyi rol gyi ngag gi bzlas pa dang*/ tha mal pa'i dus kyi ngag dang rlung gi rgyu ba dang*/ rlung sngags yi ge tha dad du bzlas pa rnams so// bzhi pa gnyen po nyams len gyi rim pa la gsum ste/ rang bzhin gyi rlung la bslab pa/ thabs mgon po bzhi'i rlung la bslab pa/ shes rab lha mo rnams kyi rlung la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar gyi bsgoms pa'i gnas su rkang pa skyil krung sogs lus gnad sngar bzhin bcas/ de nas rang rdo rje 'chang gi nga rgyal gyis rlung sngags stong pa dbyer med du shes pa'i sgo nas rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/

nang du gnas pa āḥ phyir ldang ba hūm̐ gi sgrar shes pa'i sgo nas/ rang bzhin gyi rdo rje bzlas pa la skad cig kyang ma yengs par shes pa gtad la bsgom/ de ltar thun bzhir zhag bdun tsam bsgoms pas rlung gi kha dog dang*/ rgyu sa mthong ba dang*/ rlung g.yas nas g.yon du 'pho ba dang*/ mgon po bzhi'i rlung gang rgyu ba ngo shes pa 'byung ngo*// gal te 'bad pa chen po byas kyang rlung rgyu ba mi gsal na/ ras bal sob pos sna bug cung zad bkag na rgyu ba gsal gsung*/ kha zas bcud can dang*/ spyod lam dal bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar rang bzhin gyi bzlas pas rlung gi rgyu tshul dang*/ kha dog la sogs pa nges nas thabs kyi rgyu ba la bslabs te/ de yang sngar bzhin nang du 'jug pa oṃ dang*/ gnas pa āḥdang*/ phyir ldang ba hūm̐ gi sgrar shes pa'i sgo nas/ gyen rgyu me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar po padma mgon po'i rang bzhin du sna sgo g.yas nas dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu ba la bslab/ de nas thur sel rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po las kyi mgon po'i rang bzhin sna sgo g.yon pa nas dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu ba la bslab/ de nas me dang mnyam gnas sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po rin chen mgon po'i rang bzhin sna sgo gnyis ka nas dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu ba la bslab/ de nas srog 'dzin chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po rdo rje mgon po'i rang bzhin dal zhing mi gsal ba dgu brgya pa phrag gcig la bslabs pas rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog dang tshad dang rnam pa nges par 'gyur bas de ma byung gi bar du bsgom mo// gsum pa ni de ltar thabs kyi rgyu ba la bslab pa'i rjes su shes rab kyi rgyu ba la bslabs te/ de yang thabs mgon po re re rgyu ba na shes rab lha mo bzhi bzhi rgyu ba yin te/ sngar gyi g.yas pa nas me'i dkyil 'khor padma mgon po'i rlung dmar po dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu ba'i phyir de la/
